**SHA-256:** `eb7bbc3441ebb20abfd3b91ad7f8727e68798bf7c9b194b3c2e5a8eb9919259e`

```javascript
/**
 * ESE DIGITALS — G7 MAIN-GATE PROFILES / ALERTS ROLL-UP v1.0
 * Main gate: G7 Profiles/Alerts
 * Manual go condition: Lifecycle works.
 *
 * Verifies the manual checklist:
 * - Save/edit/reload
 * - Alert preference
 * - Alert lifecycle
 *
 * Uses G3.17/G3.18/G3.19 as supporting implementation evidence.
 * This roll-up does not perform production persistence, notification delivery,
 * ranking, eligibility, discovery, network access, or job application automation.
 */

var G7_CONTRACT_VERSION = '1.0';
var G7_ALGORITHM_VERSION = 'G7_PROFILE_ALERT_LIFECYCLE_ROLLUP_V1';

var G7_PROFILE_STATUSES = ['DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE'];
var G7_ALERT_STATES = ['DISABLED','READY','DELIVERED','ACKNOWLEDGED','SUPPRESSED'];

function G7_clone_(x) {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
}

function G7_normalizeProfile_(input) {
  if (!input || Object.prototype.toString.call(input) !== '[object Object]') {
    return {valid:false, errors:['INVALID_PROFILE']};
  }
  var p = G7_clone_(input);
  p.profileId = String(p.profileId || '').trim();
  p.version = Number(p.version || 1);
  if (!isFinite(p.version) || p.version < 1) p.version = 1;
  p.status = String(p.status || 'DRAFT').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (G7_PROFILE_STATUSES.indexOf(p.status) < 0) p.status = 'DRAFT';
  p.skills = Array.isArray(p.skills) ? p.skills.map(function(x){return String(x).trim().toLowerCase();}).filter(Boolean) : [];
  p.roleFamilies = Array.isArray(p.roleFamilies) ? p.roleFamilies.map(function(x){return String(x).trim();}).filter(Boolean) : [];
  p.country = String(p.country || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  p.timezone = String(p.timezone || '').trim();
  p.updatedAt = String(p.updatedAt || '').trim();
  return {
    valid: !!p.profileId,
    errors: p.profileId ? [] : ['MISSING_PROFILE_ID'],
    profile: p
  };
}

function G7_saveTransition_(before, proposed) {
  var b = G7_normalizeProfile_(before);
  var p = G7_normalizeProfile_(proposed);
  if (!b.valid || !p.valid) return {allowed:false, reason:'INVALID_PROFILE'};
  if (p.profile.profileId !== b.profile.profileId) return {allowed:false, reason:'PROFILE_ID_IMMUTABLE'};
  if (p.profile.version <= b.profile.version) return {allowed:false, reason:'VERSION_MUST_INCREASE'};
  return {
    allowed:true,
    action:'SAVE',
    profileId:p.profile.profileId,
    fromVersion:b.profile.version,
    toVersion:p.profile.version,
    persisted:false
  };
}

function G7_reloadContract_(saved, reloaded) {
  var a = G7_normalizeProfile_(saved);
  var b = G7_normalizeProfile_(reloaded);
  if (!a.valid || !b.valid) return {ok:false, reason:'INVALID_PROFILE'};
  return {
    ok: a.profile.profileId === b.profile.profileId &&
        a.profile.version === b.profile.version &&
        a.profile.status === b.profile.status &&
        JSON.stringify(a.profile.skills) === JSON.stringify(b.profile.skills),
    profileId: a.profile.profileId
  };
}

function G7_normalizeAlertPreference_(input) {
  if (!input || Object.prototype.toString.call(input) !== '[object Object]') {
    return {valid:false, errors:['INVALID_ALERT_PREFERENCE']};
  }
  var a = G7_clone_(input);
  a.enabled = a.enabled === true;
  a.channels = Array.isArray(a.channels) ? a.channels.map(function(x){return String(x).trim().toLowerCase();}).filter(function(x){return ['email','in_app'].indexOf(x)>=0;}) : [];
  a.frequency = String(a.frequency || 'none').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (['none','daily','weekly'].indexOf(a.frequency) < 0) a.frequency = 'daily';
  a.maxPerDay = Number(a.maxPerDay == null ? 5 : a.maxPerDay);
  if (!isFinite(a.maxPerDay) || a.maxPerDay < 0) a.maxPerDay = 5;
  a.maxPerDay = Math.floor(a.maxPerDay);
  return {
    valid:true,
    preference:{
      enabled:a.enabled,
      channels:a.channels,
      frequency:a.frequency,
      maxPerDay:a.maxPerDay
    }
  };
}

function G7_alertLifecycle_(input) {
  if (!input || Object.prototype.toString.call(input) !== '[object Object]') {
    return {status:'BLOCKED', reasons:['INVALID_ALERT']};
  }
  var x = G7_clone_(input);
  var profile = G7_normalizeProfile_(x.profile || {});
  if (!profile.valid) return {status:'BLOCKED', reasons:['INVALID_PROFILE']};

  if (x.preference == null) return {status:'BLOCKED', reasons:['INVALID_PREFERENCE']};
  var pref = G7_normalizeAlertPreference_(x.preference);
  if (!pref.valid) return {status:'BLOCKED', reasons:['INVALID_PREFERENCE']};

  var opportunityReady = x.opportunityReady === true;
  var delivered = x.delivered === true;
  var acknowledged = x.acknowledged === true;
  var suppressed = x.suppressed === true;

  if (!pref.preference.enabled || pref.preference.frequency === 'none' || pref.preference.channels.length === 0) {
    return {status:'DISABLED', deliveryAllowed:false, reasons:['ALERTS_NOT_ENABLED']};
  }
  if (profile.profile.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
    return {status:'SUPPRESSED', deliveryAllowed:false, reasons:['PROFILE_NOT_ACTIVE']};
  }
  if (suppressed) {
    return {status:'SUPPRESSED', deliveryAllowed:false, reasons:['OPPORTUNITY_SUPPRESSED']};
  }
  if (!opportunityReady) {
    return {status:'READY', deliveryAllowed:false, reasons:['NO_READY_OPPORTUNITY']};
  }
  if (acknowledged) {
    return {status:'ACKNOWLEDGED', deliveryAllowed:false, reasons:['ALERT_ACKNOWLEDGED']};
  }
  if (delivered) {
    return {status:'DELIVERED', deliveryAllowed:false, reasons:['ALERT_ALREADY_DELIVERED']};
  }
  return {
    status:'READY',
    deliveryAllowed:true,
    reasons:['READY_FOR_CONTROLLED_DELIVERY'],
    channels:pref.preference.channels.slice()
  };
}

function G7_buildLifecycleRollup_(fixture) {
  var profile = G7_normalizeProfile_(fixture && fixture.profile);
  var pref = G7_normalizeAlertPreference_(fixture && fixture.preference);
  var lifecycle = G7_alertLifecycle_(fixture && fixture.alertContext);

  var save = G7_saveTransition_(fixture && fixture.profile, fixture && fixture.editedProfile);
  var reload = G7_reloadContract_(fixture && fixture.editedProfile, fixture && fixture.reloadedProfile);

  return {
    contractVersion:G7_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion:G7_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    profileValid:profile.valid,
    preferenceValid:pref.valid,
    lifecycleStatus:lifecycle.status,
    saveEditReload:!!(save.allowed && reload.ok),
    alertPreference:pref.valid && pref.preference.enabled && pref.preference.channels.length > 0,
    alertLifecycle:lifecycle.status === 'READY' || lifecycle.status === 'DELIVERED' || lifecycle.status === 'ACKNOWLEDGED' || lifecycle.status === 'SUPPRESSED' || lifecycle.status === 'DISABLED',
    persistentWrite:false,
    deliveryAttempted:false,
    rankingTouched:false,
    eligibilityTouched:false,
    applicationAutomation:false
  };
}

function G7_buildAudit_(result) {
  return {
    contractVersion:G7_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion:G7_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    privateExposure:false,
    persistentWrite:false,
    deliveryAttempted:false,
    rankingTouched:false,
    eligibilityTouched:false,
    applicationAutomation:false,
    lifecycleStatus:result ? result.lifecycleStatus : 'UNKNOWN'
  };
}

function G7_getFixture() {
  return {
    profile:{
      profileId:'FIXTURE-PROFILE-001',
      version:1,
      status:'ACTIVE',
      skills:['SQL','Excel'],
      roleFamilies:['Data Analyst'],
      country:'NG',
      timezone:'Africa/Lagos'
    },
    editedProfile:{
      profileId:'FIXTURE-PROFILE-001',
      version:2,
      status:'ACTIVE',
      skills:['SQL','Excel','Power BI'],
      roleFamilies:['Data Analyst'],
      country:'NG',
      timezone:'Africa/Lagos'
    },
    reloadedProfile:{
      profileId:'FIXTURE-PROFILE-001',
      version:2,
      status:'ACTIVE',
      skills:['sql','excel','power bi'],
      roleFamilies:['Data Analyst'],
      country:'NG',
      timezone:'Africa/Lagos'
    },
    preference:{
      enabled:true,
      channels:['email','in_app'],
      frequency:'daily',
      maxPerDay:5
    },
    alertContext:{
      profile:{
        profileId:'FIXTURE-PROFILE-001',
        version:2,
        status:'ACTIVE'
      },
      preference:{
        enabled:true,
        channels:['email','in_app'],
        frequency:'daily',
        maxPerDay:5
      },
      opportunityReady:true,
      delivered:false,
      acknowledged:false,
      suppressed:false
    }
  };
}
```

```markdown
G7 is read-only. No production lifecycle state is changed by the roll-up.

On failure:
1. Stop.
2. Preserve logs.
3. Compare against known-good G7 version.
4. Restore if necessary.
5. Rerun preflight, tests and live verification.
```

```javascript
function G7_runTests() {
  var tests=[];
  function add(name,pass){tests.push({name:name,pass:!!pass});}

  add('001 contract version exact',G7_CONTRACT_VERSION==='1.0');
  add('002 algorithm exact',G7_ALGORITHM_VERSION==='G7_PROFILE_ALERT_LIFECYCLE_ROLLUP_V1');
  add('003 profile statuses defined',G7_PROFILE_STATUSES.length===3);
  add('004 alert states defined',G7_ALERT_STATES.length===5);

  var f=G7_getFixture();
  add('005 fixture profile valid',G7_normalizeProfile_(f.profile).valid===true);
  add('006 fixture profile active',G7_normalizeProfile_(f.profile).profile.status==='ACTIVE');
  add('007 edited profile version increased',G7_saveTransition_(f.profile,f.editedProfile).allowed===true);
```

### SOURCE FILE: `02_PHASE4_OPPORTUNITY/Ese_Digitals_G8_Main_Gate_Monetization_Rollup_v1_1_CORRECTED_2026-09-11__EXTRACTED/G8_Monetization_Rollup.gs`

```javascript
/**
 * ESE DIGITALS — G8 MAIN-GATE MONETIZATION ROLL-UP v1.0
 *
 * Main gate: G8 Monetization
 * Manual go condition: Entitlement/payment architecture works.
 *
 * Manual checklist:
 * - Free tier
 * - Pro tier
 * - Premium tier
 * - Services
 * - Payment test
 * - Webhook/entitlement
 * - No secrets
 *
 * This gate verifies architecture and state transitions only.
 * It performs no real payment, no live webhook call, no secret access,
 * no production persistence, and no entitlement mutation.
 */

var G8_CONTRACT_VERSION = '1.0';
var G8_ALGORITHM_VERSION = 'G8_MONETIZATION_ROLLUP_V1';

var G8_TIERS = ['FREE','PRO','PREMIUM','SERVICES'];
var G8_PAYMENT_STATES = ['NOT_STARTED','PENDING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED'];
var G8_ENTITLEMENT_STATES = ['NONE','PENDING','ACTIVE','EXPIRED','REVOKED'];

function G8_clone_(x){ return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)); }

function G8_normalizePlan_(input){
  if (!input || Object.prototype.toString.call(input)!=='[object Object]')
    return {valid:false,errors:['INVALID_PLAN']};
  var p=G8_clone_(input);
  p.tier=String(p.tier||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  p.name=String(p.name||'').trim();
  p.description=String(p.description||'').trim();
  p.enabled=p.enabled===true;
  p.amount=Number(p.amount==null?0:p.amount);
  if(!isFinite(p.amount)||p.amount<0) return {valid:false,errors:['INVALID_AMOUNT']};
  p.currency=String(p.currency||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  p.features=Array.isArray(p.features)?p.features.map(function(x){return String(x).trim();}).filter(Boolean):[];
  return {valid:G8_TIERS.indexOf(p.tier)>=0 && !!p.name && !!p.currency,
          errors:(G8_TIERS.indexOf(p.tier)<0?['INVALID_TIER']:[])
            .concat(!p.name?['MISSING_PLAN_NAME']:[])
            .concat(!p.currency?['MISSING_CURRENCY']:[]),plan:p};
}

function G8_normalizePayment_(input){
  if (!input || Object.prototype.toString.call(input)!=='[object Object]')
    return {valid:false,errors:['INVALID_PAYMENT']};
  var x=G8_clone_(input);
  x.paymentId=String(x.paymentId||'').trim();
  x.planTier=String(x.planTier||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  x.state=String(x.state||'NOT_STARTED').trim().toUpperCase();
  x.amount=Number(x.amount==null?0:x.amount);
  x.currency=String(x.currency||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  x.provider=String(x.provider||'SANDBOX').trim().toUpperCase();
  if(G8_PAYMENT_STATES.indexOf(x.state)<0)x.state='NOT_STARTED';
  return {valid:!!x.paymentId && G8_TIERS.indexOf(x.planTier)>=0 && isFinite(x.amount)&&x.amount>=0,
          errors:(!x.paymentId?['MISSING_PAYMENT_ID']:[]),
          payment:x};
}

function G8_normalizeWebhook_(input){
  if (!input || Object.prototype.toString.call(input)!=='[object Object]')
    return {valid:false,errors:['INVALID_WEBHOOK']};
  var w=G8_clone_(input);
  w.eventId=String(w.eventId||'').trim();
  w.eventType=String(w.eventType||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  w.paymentId=String(w.paymentId||'').trim();
  w.signaturePresent=w.signaturePresent===true;
  w.secretExposed=w.secretExposed===true;
  return {
    valid:!!w.eventId && !!w.eventType && !!w.paymentId,
    errors:[].concat(!w.eventId?['MISSING_EVENT_ID']:[])
      .concat(!w.eventType?['MISSING_EVENT_TYPE']:[])
      .concat(!w.paymentId?['MISSING_PAYMENT_ID']:[]),
    webhook:w
  };
}

function G8_buildEntitlement_(payment, webhook){
  var p=G8_normalizePayment_(payment);
  var w=G8_normalizeWebhook_(webhook);
  if(!p.valid||!w.valid)
    return {status:'BLOCKED',entitlement:'NONE',reasons:p.errors.concat(w.errors)};
  if(w.webhook.secretExposed)
    return {status:'BLOCKED',entitlement:'NONE',reasons:['SECRET_EXPOSURE']};
  if(!w.webhook.signaturePresent)
    return {status:'PENDING',entitlement:'PENDING',reasons:['WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED']};
  if(p.payment.state==='SUCCEEDED' && w.webhook.eventType==='PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED')
    return {status:'ACTIVE',entitlement:'ACTIVE',reasons:['PAYMENT_CONFIRMED']};
  if(p.payment.state==='FAILED')
    return {status:'FAILED',entitlement:'NONE',reasons:['PAYMENT_FAILED']};
  return {status:'PENDING',entitlement:'PENDING',reasons:['PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED']};
}

function G8_buildRollup_(fixture){
  var plans=Array.isArray(fixture&&fixture.plans)?fixture.plans.map(G8_normalizePlan_):[];
  var planNames=plans.filter(function(x){return x.valid;}).map(function(x){return x.plan.name;});
  var payment=G8_normalizePayment_(fixture&&fixture.payment);
  var entitlement=G8_buildEntitlement_(fixture&&fixture.payment,fixture&&fixture.webhook);
  var allTiers=G8_TIERS.every(function(t){
    return plans.some(function(x){return x.valid && x.plan.tier===t;});
  });
  var noSecrets=entitlement.reasons.indexOf('SECRET_EXPOSURE')<0;
  return {
    contractVersion:G8_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion:G8_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    tiersDefined:allTiers,
    planNames:planNames,
    paymentTest:payment.valid && payment.payment.provider==='SANDBOX',
    webhookEntitlement:entitlement.status==='ACTIVE',
    noSecrets:noSecrets,
    entitlementStatus:entitlement.status,
    entitlement:entitlement.entitlement,
    persistentWrite:false,
    paymentAttempted:false,
    webhookCalled:false,
    secretAccessed:false,
    productionMutation:false
  };
}

function G8_buildAudit_(result){
  return {
    contractVersion:G8_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion:G8_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    privateExposure:false,
    persistentWrite:false,
    paymentAttempted:false,
    webhookCalled:false,
    secretAccessed:false,
    entitlementMutation:false,
    status:result?result.entitlementStatus:'UNKNOWN'
  };
}

function G8_getFixture(){
  return {
    plans:[
      {tier:'FREE',name:'Free',description:'Free opportunity access',enabled:true,amount:0,currency:'NGN',features:['Browse verified opportunities']},
      {tier:'PRO',name:'Pro',description:'Enhanced opportunity intelligence',enabled:true,amount:5000,currency:'NGN',features:['Advanced filters','Profile alerts']},
      {tier:'PREMIUM',name:'Premium',description:'Advanced decision intelligence',enabled:true,amount:15000,currency:'NGN',features:['Priority intelligence','Enhanced guidance']},
      {tier:'SERVICES',name:'Services',description:'Human-delivered professional services',enabled:true,amount:25000,currency:'NGN',features:['Professional support']}
    ],
    payment:{paymentId:'SANDBOX-PAY-001',planTier:'PRO',state:'SUCCEEDED',amount:5000,currency:'NGN',provider:'SANDBOX'},
    webhook:{eventId:'SANDBOX-EVT-001',eventType:'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED',paymentId:'SANDBOX-PAY-001',signaturePresent:true,secretExposed:false}
  };
}
```

```markdown
# G8 Release Notes v1.1 — Corrected

This release corrects one test-dispatch defect found during authoritative Apps Script execution of G8 v1.0.

Root cause:
The Services-tier fixture was named `services present`, while the test dispatcher looked for
the phrase `services tier`. The underlying monetization logic correctly detected a missing
Services tier as INCOMPLETE; the test harness routed the case through the entitlement-state
branch instead.

Correction:
The test dispatcher now recognizes `services present` as a tier-architecture fixture.

Local revalidation:
- 120/120 tests PASS
- Failures: 0
- Package structure: complete
- ZIP integrity: PASS

No production payment, webhook, secret, persistence, notification, or application behavior
was introduced by this correction.

Do not use G8 v1.0. Use the corrected v1.1 package.
```

```markdown
# ESE DIGITALS — PHASE 4 GATE CONTROL REGISTER
## Controlling Manual Alignment — v1.0 — 11 September 2026

### 1. Purpose
This register is the working control surface for Phase 4 gate status. The controlling Phase 4 Master Build Manual remains authoritative. Detailed G3.x implementation gates are subordinate drill-down gates and do not replace the main Phase 4 gates G0–G12.

### 2. Main-gate rule
```

```javascript
/**
 * ESE DIGITALS — PHASE 4 / G3.8
 * GREENHOUSE SOURCE ADAPTER
 *
 * Contract Version: 1.0
 * Gate: G3.8 — Greenhouse Source Adapter
 *
 * PURPOSE
 * -------
 * Retrieve public Greenhouse Job Board records and return the frozen G3.1/G3.3
 * raw-record envelope. This adapter deliberately stops before normalization,
 * verification, eligibility, ranking, persistence, or application automation.
 *
 * ARCHITECTURAL BOUNDARY
 * ----------------------
 * USER / G2 QUERY PLAN
 *       |
 *       v
 * G3.8 GREENHOUSE ADAPTER
 *       |
 *       +--> HTTP retrieval only
 *       +--> source-native ID preservation
 *       +--> raw response parsing
 *       +--> common raw envelope
 *       |
 *       v
 * G3.4 NORMALIZER
 *       |
 *       v
 * G3.5 IDENTITY / DEDUPLICATION
 *       |
 *       v
 * G3.6 EVIDENCE
 *       |
 *       v
 * G3.7 INTEGRATED PERSISTENCE
 *
 * NON-NEGOTIABLES
 * --------------
 * - No direct JOBS writes.
 * - No direct JOB_EVIDENCE writes.
 * - No direct AUDIT_LOG writes.
 * - No G2 taxonomy/classification.
 * - No eligibility decision.
 * - No freshness decision.
 * - No ranking or matching.
 * - No automatic application.
 * - No credentials in returned records.
 * - Preserve raw source content; do not silently rewrite it.
 * - sourceRecordId must be the actual Greenhouse job ID.
 * - sourceId is the source-registry identifier supplied by configuration.
 * - public board token is supplied through backend source configuration; it is
 *   never embedded in a returned record.
 *
 * GREENHOUSE PUBLIC ENDPOINT
 * --------------------------
 * https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{boardToken}/jobs?content=true
 */

var G38_GREENHOUSE_CONTRACT_VERSION = '1.0';
var G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE = 'GREENHOUSE';
var G38_GREENHOUSE_DEFAULT_BASE_URL = 'https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/';
var G38_GREENHOUSE_DEFAULT_PATH = '/jobs?content=true';

var G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS = Object.freeze({
  SUCCESS: 'SUCCESS',
  PARTIAL_SUCCESS: 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS',
  NO_RESULTS: 'NO_RESULTS',
  SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: 'SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE',
  INVALID_STRATEGY: 'INVALID_STRATEGY',
  INVALID_SOURCE: 'INVALID_SOURCE',
  RATE_LIMITED: 'RATE_LIMITED',
  PARSE_ERROR: 'PARSE_ERROR'
});

var G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES = Object.freeze({
  INVALID_INPUT: 'G38_INVALID_INPUT',
  INVALID_STRATEGY: 'G38_INVALID_STRATEGY',
  INVALID_SOURCE: 'G38_INVALID_SOURCE',
  MISSING_BOARD_TOKEN: 'G38_MISSING_BOARD_TOKEN',
  MISSING_SOURCE_ID: 'G38_MISSING_SOURCE_ID',
  INVALID_HTTP_STATUS: 'G38_INVALID_HTTP_STATUS',
  HTTP_ERROR: 'G38_HTTP_ERROR',
  RATE_LIMITED: 'G38_RATE_LIMITED',
  PARSE_ERROR: 'G38_PARSE_ERROR',
  INVALID_RESPONSE: 'G38_INVALID_RESPONSE',
  INVALID_RECORD: 'G38_INVALID_RECORD',
  MISSING_JOB_ID: 'G38_MISSING_JOB_ID',
  MISSING_RETRIEVED_AT: 'G38_MISSING_RETRIEVED_AT',
  IMMUTABILITY_ERROR: 'G38_IMMUTABILITY_ERROR'

function g38GhIsObject(value) {
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function g38GhIsNonEmptyString(value) {

}

function g38GhClone(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return value;
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

function g38GhError(code, message, details) {

  return new Error(code + ': ' + message + suffix);
}

function g38GhNowIso() {
  return new Date().toISOString();
}

function g38GhUrlEncode(value) {
  return encodeURIComponent(String(value));
}

function g38GhGetConfig(context) {
  if (!g38GhIsObject(context)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_INPUT, 'context object required');
  }
  if (!g38GhIsObject(context.sourceConfig)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_SOURCE, 'sourceConfig object required');
  }

  var config = context.sourceConfig;
  if (!g38GhIsNonEmptyString(config.sourceId)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.MISSING_SOURCE_ID, 'sourceConfig.sourceId required');
  }
  if (String(config.sourceType || '').toUpperCase() !== G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_SOURCE, 'sourceConfig.sourceType must be GREENHOUSE');
  }
  if (!g38GhIsNonEmptyString(config.boardToken)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.MISSING_BOARD_TOKEN, 'sourceConfig.boardToken required');
  }

  return {
    sourceId: String(config.sourceId).trim(),
    sourceType: G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE,
    sourceName: g38GhIsNonEmptyString(config.sourceName) ? String(config.sourceName).trim() : 'Greenhouse',
    boardToken: String(config.boardToken).trim(),
    baseUrl: g38GhIsNonEmptyString(config.baseUrl) ? String(config.baseUrl).trim() : G38_GREENHOUSE_DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
    verificationStatus: g38GhIsNonEmptyString(config.verificationStatus)
      ? String(config.verificationStatus).trim()
      : 'VERIFIED'
  };
}

function g38GhValidateStrategy(strategy) {
  if (!g38GhIsObject(strategy)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_STRATEGY, 'strategy object required');
  }
  if (String(strategy.sourceType || '').toUpperCase() !== G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_STRATEGY, 'strategy.sourceType must be GREENHOUSE');
  }
  if (String(strategy.kind || '').toUpperCase() !== 'ATS_API') {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_STRATEGY, 'strategy.kind must be ATS_API');
  }
  if (!g38GhIsObject(strategy.retrieval)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_STRATEGY, 'strategy.retrieval object required');
  }
  if (g38GhIsNonEmptyString(strategy.retrieval.mode)) {
    var mode = String(strategy.retrieval.mode).toUpperCase();
    if (mode !== 'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API' && mode !== 'ATS_API') {
      throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_STRATEGY, 'unsupported retrieval mode');
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function g38GhBuildEndpoint(config) {
  return config.baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '/') + g38GhUrlEncode(config.boardToken) + G38_GREENHOUSE_DEFAULT_PATH;
}

function g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint) {
  return {
    sourceId: config.sourceId,
    sourceType: config.sourceType,
    sourceName: config.sourceName,
    endpoint: endpoint,
    verificationStatus: config.verificationStatus
  };
}

function g38GhReadText(response) {
  if (!response || typeof response.getContentText !== 'function') {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_RESPONSE, 'response.getContentText() required');
  }
  return response.getContentText();
}

function g38GhReadStatus(response) {
  if (!response || typeof response.getResponseCode !== 'function') {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_RESPONSE, 'response.getResponseCode() required');
  }
  return Number(response.getResponseCode());
}

function g38GhIsValidIso(value) {
  return g38GhIsNonEmptyString(value) && !isNaN(Date.parse(value));
}

function g38GhBuildEnvelope(config, job, retrievedAt) {
  if (!g38GhIsObject(job)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_RECORD, 'job object required');
  }
  if (job.id === undefined || job.id === null || String(job.id).trim() === '') {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.MISSING_JOB_ID, 'Greenhouse job.id required');
  }
  if (!g38GhIsValidIso(retrievedAt)) {
    throw g38GhError(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.MISSING_RETRIEVED_AT, 'retrievedAt must be ISO timestamp');
  }

  var sourceUrl = g38GhIsNonEmptyString(job.absolute_url) ? String(job.absolute_url) : '';
  var applicationUrl = sourceUrl;

  return {
    sourceType: G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE,
    sourceId: config.sourceId,
    sourceRecordId: String(job.id),
    retrievedAt: retrievedAt,
    sourceUrl: sourceUrl,
    applicationUrl: applicationUrl,
    rawRecord: g38GhClone(job)

}

function g38GhValidateEnvelope(envelope) {
  if (!g38GhIsObject(envelope)) return false;
  if (String(envelope.sourceType || '').toUpperCase() !== G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE) return false;
  if (!g38GhIsNonEmptyString(envelope.sourceId)) return false;
  if (!g38GhIsNonEmptyString(String(envelope.sourceRecordId))) return false;
  if (!g38GhIsValidIso(envelope.retrievedAt)) return false;
  if (!g38GhIsObject(envelope.rawRecord)) return false;
  return true;

function g38GhBuildResult(config, endpoint, requestedAt, retrievedAt, httpStatus, records, errors, warnings, durationMs) {
  var status = records.length === 0
    ? (errors.length > 0 ? G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.PARSE_ERROR : G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.NO_RESULTS)
    : (errors.length > 0 ? G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.PARTIAL_SUCCESS : G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.SUCCESS);

  return {
    status: status,
    source: g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint),
    retrieval: {
      requestedAt: requestedAt,
      retrievedAt: retrievedAt,
      httpStatus: httpStatus,
      requestMethod: 'GET',
      endpoint: endpoint,
      resultCount: records.length,
      durationMs: durationMs
    },
    records: records,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}

function g38GhClassifyHttpFailure(status) {
  if (status === 429) return G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.RATE_LIMITED;
  if (status === 404 || status === 410 || status === 401 || status === 403) {
    return G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE;
  }
  return G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE;
}

/**
 * Primary adapter interface.
 * @param {Object} strategy one validated G2 strategy
 * @param {Object} context execution context with sourceConfig and optional runId/planId
 * @param {Object=} dependencies optional test dependency injection; fetch(request) required only in tests
 * @return {Object} frozen common adapter result shape

function greenhouseDiscover(strategy, context, dependencies) {
  var requestedAt = g38GhNowIso();
  var config;
  var endpoint;

  try {
    g38GhValidateStrategy(strategy);
    config = g38GhGetConfig(context);
    endpoint = g38GhBuildEndpoint(config);
  } catch (error) {
    var invalidCode = String(error && error.message ? error.message : error);
    var invalidStatus = invalidCode.indexOf(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_STRATEGY) === 0
      ? G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.INVALID_STRATEGY
      : G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.INVALID_SOURCE;
    return {
      status: invalidStatus,
      source: config ? g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint) : {

        sourceType: G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE,

      },

        retrievedAt: requestedAt,
        httpStatus: 0,
        requestMethod: 'GET',
        endpoint: endpoint || '',
        resultCount: 0,
        durationMs: 0
      },
      records: [],
      errors: [{ code: String(error && error.message ? error.message : error), message: String(error && error.message ? error.message : error) }],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  var fetchFn = dependencies && typeof dependencies.fetch === 'function'
    ? dependencies.fetch
    : function(url, options) {
        return UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);
      };

  var startedMs = new Date().getTime();
  var response;
  var httpStatus = 0;
  var retrievedAt;

  try {
    response = fetchFn(endpoint, {
      method: 'get',
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      muteHttpExceptions: true,
      followRedirects: true
```

```javascript
function runG38GreenhouseAdapterTests() {
  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('ESE DIGITALS — G3.8 GREENHOUSE ADAPTER TESTS v' + G38T_SUITE_VERSION);
  Logger.log('Executing ' + G38_GREENHOUSE_TESTS.length + ' tests...');
  Logger.log('==================================================');

  g38tAssertEqual(G38T_EXPECTED_TEST_COUNT, G38_GREENHOUSE_TESTS.length, 'Test registry count drift');

  var passed = 0;
  var failures = [];

  G38_GREENHOUSE_TESTS.forEach(function(testFn, index) {
    try {
      testFn();
      passed++;
      Logger.log('PASS ' + (index + 1) + ': ' + testFn.name);
    } catch (error) {
      var message = String(error && error.message ? error.message : error);
      failures.push({ number: index + 1, name: testFn.name, message: message });
      Logger.log('FAIL ' + (index + 1) + ': ' + testFn.name + ' :: ' + message);
      if (error && error.stack) Logger.log(error.stack);
    }
  });

  var status = failures.length === 0 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL';
  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('Contract Version: ' + G38_GREENHOUSE_CONTRACT_VERSION);
  Logger.log('Tests Run: ' + G38_GREENHOUSE_TESTS.length);
  Logger.log('Passed: ' + passed);
  Logger.log('Failures: ' + failures.length);
  Logger.log('Status: ' + status);
  Logger.log('==================================================');

  if (failures.length > 0) {
    throw new Error('G3.8 GREENHOUSE ADAPTER TESTS FAILED: ' + failures.length + ' test(s) failed.');
  }

  return {
    contractVersion: G38_GREENHOUSE_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    suiteVersion: G38T_SUITE_VERSION,
    testsRun: G38_GREENHOUSE_TESTS.length,
    passed: passed,
    failures: failures,
    status: status
  };
}
```

```markdown
# G3.4 CANONICAL NORMALIZATION CONTRACT v1.1 — CORRECTED MIGRATION DIRECTIVE

**State at migration:** READY FOR EXECUTION; NOT YET EVIDENCED AS PASS.

## Purpose
Transform one frozen G3.3 raw source-record envelope into the canonical `JOBS` object plus provenance and deterministic fingerprint.

## Hard boundary
Pure in-memory transformation. No UrlFetchApp. No SpreadsheetApp. No persistence. No G2 dependency. No verification. No eligibility. No freshness. No ranking. No matching. No cross-source deduplication. No Job_ID assignment. No mutation of raw input.

## Canonical JOBS order
1 Job_ID
2 Source_ID
3 Source_Type
4 Source_Name
5 Title
6 Company
7 Department
8 Role_Family
9 Description
10 Location
11 Remote_Type
12 Eligible_Countries
13 Eligible_Regions
14 Excluded_Countries
15 Work_Authorization
16 Timezone
17 Employment_Type
18 Salary_Min
19 Salary_Max
20 Currency
21 Posted_Date
22 Updated_Date
23 First_Seen
24 Last_Verified
25 Application_URL
26 Source_URL
27 Active
28 Eligibility_Status
29 Eligibility_Reason
30 Freshness_Status
31 Verification_Status
32 Content_Hash
33 Match_Keywords
34 Created_At
35 Updated_At

## Mapping rules
- Job_ID = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Source_ID = raw.sourceRecordId; source-native ID, not source-registry ID.
- Source_Type = raw.sourceType.
- Source_Name = optional verified source configuration context.sourceName; otherwise null / NOT_AVAILABLE.
- Title = raw.rawRecord.title, trim only.
- Company = explicit rawRecord.company.name only.
- Department = rawRecord.departments[].name; one value SOURCE_DIRECT; multiple values joined in source order with `; ` and SOURCE_DERIVED.
- Role_Family = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED. Never import G2 roleResolution.
- Description = rawRecord.content, source content only; no AI summary.
- Location = rawRecord.location.name direct preservation.
- Remote_Type = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Eligible_Countries = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Eligible_Regions = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Excluded_Countries = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Work_Authorization = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Timezone = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Employment_Type = explicit rawRecord.employment_type only.
- Salary_Min / Salary_Max = strict numeric conversion. Whitespace, boolean, malformed text, currency-bearing strings and non-numeric values become null, never zero.
- Currency = explicit value trimmed and uppercased.
- Posted_Date = explicit rawRecord.posted_at only. Never use updated_at, created_at, retrievedAt or First_Seen.
- Updated_Date = explicit rawRecord.updated_at.
- First_Seen = raw.retrievedAt.
- Last_Verified = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Application_URL = raw.applicationUrl, preserve exactly.
- Source_URL = raw.sourceUrl, preserve exactly.
- Active = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Eligibility_Status = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Eligibility_Reason = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Freshness_Status = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Verification_Status = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED.
- Match_Keywords = null / DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED; never copy G2 keywords.
- Created_At = null / NOT_AVAILABLE.
- Updated_At = null / NOT_AVAILABLE.
- Content_Hash = SHA-256 derived from exactly 11 frozen fields.

## Fingerprint
Algorithm: SHA-256
Version: 1.0
Fields in exact order:
`Title, Company, Department, Description, Location, Employment_Type, Salary_Min, Salary_Max, Currency, Updated_Date, Application_URL`

Excluded from fingerprint:
Job_ID, Source_ID, Source_Type, Source_Name, Role_Family, Remote_Type, eligibility fields, First_Seen, Last_Verified, Active, Freshness_Status, Verification_Status, Match_Keywords, Created_At, Updated_At.

## Provenance vocabulary
Only:
`SOURCE_DIRECT`, `SOURCE_DERIVED`, `NOT_AVAILABLE`, `DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED`.

`Content_Hash` provenance = `SOURCE_DERIVED`.

## Expected Stripe fixture
sourceType `GREENHOUSE`; sourceId `SRC-002`; sourceRecordId `8172510`; retrievedAt `2026-09-09T20:41:36.658Z`; updated_at `2026-09-09T11:20:31-04:00`; location `Seattle, San Francisco, New York City`; URL `https://stripe.com/jobs/search?gh_jid=8172510`.

- Updated_Date `2026-09-09T11:20:31-04:00`
- First_Seen `2026-09-09T20:41:36.658Z`
- Last_Verified null
- Application_URL and Source_URL `https://stripe.com/jobs/search?gh_jid=8172510`
- Active/eligibility/freshness/verification/match fields null

## Correct test count
The prior draft was described inconsistently as 45 tests while containing 54. The corrected gate uses **60 tests** and must report exactly:
`Tests Run: 60`, `Failures: 0`, `Status: PASS`.

The 60-test suite must cover:
```

```markdown
# G3.11 Installation & Execution Guide

Install the G3.11 orchestrator, tests, and live-verification runner in the same Apps Script project that contains the frozen G3.8 Greenhouse, G3.9 Ashby, and G3.10 Lever adapters.

1. Run `runG311MultiSourceDiscoveryTests`. Expected: 61/61 PASS.
2. After the contract suite passes, run `runG311MultiSourceDiscoveryLiveVerification`. This is read-only and performs live GET retrieval through the three frozen adapters.
3. Do not add SpreadsheetApp, persistence, normalization, deduplication, eligibility, ranking, or application logic to G3.11.
4. Capture the complete execution logs for gate evidence.
```

```javascript
 *
 * Read-only orchestration test across the three frozen adapters:

 * no deduplication, no eligibility, no ranking, no application automation.

function runG311MultiSourceDiscoveryLiveVerification() {
  var plan = {
    sources: [
      {
        key: 'GREENHOUSE',
        strategy: {
          sourceType: 'GREENHOUSE',
          kind: 'ATS_API',
          retrieval: { mode: 'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API' }
        },
        context: {
          sourceConfig: {

            boardToken: 'stripe',
            verificationStatus: 'VERIFIED'
          }
        }
      },
      {
        key: 'ASHBY',
        strategy: {
          sourceType: 'ASHBY',
          kind: 'ATS_API',
          retrieval: { mode: 'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API' }
        },
        context: {
          sourceConfig: {
            sourceId: 'G311-LIVE-ASHBY',
            sourceType: 'ASHBY',
            sourceName: 'Ashby',
            jobBoardName: 'ashby',
            verificationStatus: 'VERIFIED'
          }
        }
      },
      {
        key: 'LEVER',
        strategy: {
          sourceType: 'LEVER',
          kind: 'ATS_API',
          retrieval: { mode: 'PUBLIC_POSTINGS_API' }
        },
        context: {
          sourceConfig: {
            sourceId: 'G311-LIVE-LEVER',
            sourceType: 'LEVER',
            sourceName: 'Lever',
            siteName: 'leverdemo',
            verificationStatus: 'VERIFIED'
          }
        }
      }

  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('Sources planned: ' + plan.sources.length);
  Logger.log('Mode: READ-ONLY');

  var result = runG311MultiSourceDiscovery(plan, {
    adapters: {
      GREENHOUSE: function(strategy, context) {
        return greenhouseDiscover(strategy, context);
      },
      ASHBY: function(strategy, context) {
        return ashbyDiscover(strategy, context);
```

```javascript
    companyExact: g313Exact(A.Company, B.Company),
    companyComparable: g313Present(A.Company) && g313Present(B.Company),
    locationExact: g313Exact(A.Location, B.Location),
    locationSimilarity: g313Jaccard(A.Location, B.Location),
    locationComparable: g313Present(A.Location) && g313Present(B.Location),
    departmentExact: g313Exact(A.Department, B.Department),
    employmentExact: g313Exact(A.Employment_Type, B.Employment_Type),
    employmentComparable: g313Present(A.Employment_Type) && g313Present(B.Employment_Type),
    applicationUrlExact: g313Exact(A.Application_URL, B.Application_URL),
    sourceUrlExact: g313Exact(A.Source_URL, B.Source_URL),
    urlExact: g313Exact(A.Application_URL, B.Application_URL) || g313Exact(A.Source_URL, B.Source_URL),
    descriptionSimilarity: g313Jaccard(A.Description, B.Description),
    sourceA: A.Source_Type,
    sourceB: B.Source_Type,
    identityA: g313GetIdentity(a),
    identityB: g313GetIdentity(b)
  };
}

function g313Score(s) {
  var score = 0;
  if (s.urlExact) score += 100;
  if (s.titleExact) score += 35;
  else score += Math.round(s.titleSimilarity * 25);
  if (s.companyComparable && s.companyExact) score += 25;
  if (s.locationComparable && s.locationExact) score += 20;
  else if (s.locationComparable) score += Math.round(s.locationSimilarity * 12);
  if (s.departmentExact) score += 5;
  if (s.employmentComparable && s.employmentExact) score += 5;
  if (s.descriptionSimilarity >= 0.85) score += 10;
  else if (s.descriptionSimilarity >= 0.65) score += 5;
  return Math.min(score, 200);
}

function g313AuditStamp() {
  return new Date().toISOString();
}

function g313Decide(a, b) {
  var va = g313ValidateRecord(a), vb = g313ValidateRecord(b);
  if (!va.valid) throw new Error('Invalid record A: ' + va.reason);
  if (!vb.valid) throw new Error('Invalid record B: ' + vb.reason);

  var sameSource = g313SameSource(a, b);
  var sameRecord = g313SameRecordIdentity(a, b);

  if (sameSource && sameRecord) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DUPLICATE,
      score: 200,
      reason: 'IDENTICAL_SOURCE_RECORD_IDENTITY',
      signals: {
        sameSource: true,
        sameRecord: true,
        identityA: g313GetIdentity(a),
        identityB: g313GetIdentity(b)
      }
    };
  }

  if (sameSource) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DISTINCT,
      score: 0,
      reason: 'SAME_SOURCE_DIFFERENT_RECORD_IDENTITY',
      signals: {
        sameSource: true,
        sameRecord: false,
        identityA: g313GetIdentity(a),
        identityB: g313GetIdentity(b)
      }
    };
  }

  var s = g313Signals(a, b);

  // Exact source/application URL is an explicit identity signal and may
  // override descriptive-field conflicts because it points to the same
  // source posting/application endpoint.
  if (s.urlExact) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DUPLICATE,
      score: 200,
      reason: 'EXACT_SOURCE_OR_APPLICATION_URL_MATCH',
      signals: s
    };
  }

  // Hard company safety guard: two populated companies that disagree are
  // distinct. When exactly one company is unavailable, do not inflate the
  // score enough to create an ambiguous result; evidence is insufficient.
  var companyAComparable = g313Present(a.jobs.Company);
  var companyBComparable = g313Present(b.jobs.Company);
  if (companyAComparable && companyBComparable && !s.companyExact) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DISTINCT,
      score: 0,
      reason: 'COMPANY_CONFLICT',
      signals: s
    };
  }
  if (companyAComparable !== companyBComparable) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DISTINCT,
      score: 0,
      reason: 'INSUFFICIENT_SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE',
      signals: s
    };
  }

  // Hard location safety guard: two populated locations that disagree are
  // distinct. This prevents same-title multi-location jobs being merged.
  if (s.locationComparable && !s.locationExact) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DISTINCT,
      score: 0,
      reason: 'LOCATION_CONFLICT',
      signals: s
    };
  }

  // Strongly dissimilar titles are distinct. High-similarity title variants
  // are allowed to proceed to semantic scoring/review.
  if (g313Present(a.jobs.Title) && g313Present(b.jobs.Title) && s.titleSimilarity < 0.55) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DISTINCT,
      score: 0,
      reason: 'TITLE_CONFLICT',
      signals: s
    };
  }

  var score = g313Score(s);
  var strongMatch = false;

  // Strongest non-URL duplicate evidence.
  if (s.titleExact && s.locationExact && s.companyComparable && s.companyExact) {
    strongMatch = true;
  }

  // Company may be unavailable at both sources. In that case require exact
  // title + location + very strong description similarity.
  if (s.titleExact && s.locationExact && !s.companyComparable && s.descriptionSimilarity >= 0.85) {
    strongMatch = true;
  }

  // Department/work type can reinforce a title/location match when company
  // information is absent at both sources.
  if (s.titleExact && s.locationExact && s.departmentExact && s.employmentExact &&
      (!s.companyComparable || s.companyExact)) {
    strongMatch = true;
  }

  // Conservative variant-title duplicate path: requires company/location
  // agreement plus strong description similarity.
  if (s.titleSimilarity >= 0.90 && s.locationExact && s.companyComparable &&
      s.companyExact && s.descriptionSimilarity >= 0.65) {
    strongMatch = true;
  }

  if (strongMatch) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.DUPLICATE,
      score: score,
      reason: 'STRONG_CROSS_SOURCE_SEMANTIC_MATCH',
      signals: s
    };
  }

  if (score >= G313_REVIEW_THRESHOLD) {
    return {
      decision: G313_DECISION.REVIEW,
      score: score,
      reason: 'AMBIGUOUS_CROSS_SOURCE_SIMILARITY',
      signals: s
    };
  }

  return {
    decision: G313_DECISION.DISTINCT,
    score: score,
    reason: 'INSUFFICIENT_SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE',
    signals: s
  };
}

function G313_compareNormalized(a, b) {
  var result = g313Decide(a, b);

    contractVersion: G313_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion: G313_ALGORITHM_VERSION,

    comparisonIdentityB: g313GetIdentity(b),

function g313ClusterId(identities) {

function g313ChooseSurvivor(records) {
  var sourcePriority = {LEVER:0, ASHBY:1, GREENHOUSE:2};
  return records.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    var A = a.jobs, B = b.jobs;
    if ((A.Active === true) !== (B.Active === true)) return A.Active === true ? -1 : 1;
    var av = A.Verification_Status || '';
    var bv = B.Verification_Status || '';
    if (av !== bv) return av < bv ? -1 : 1;
    var al = A.Last_Verified || '';
    var bl = B.Last_Verified || '';
    if (al !== bl) return al > bl ? -1 : 1;
    var au = A.Updated_Date || '';
    var bu = B.Updated_Date || '';
    if (au !== bu) return au > bu ? -1 : 1;
    var ap = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sourcePriority, String(A.Source_Type || '').toUpperCase()) ? sourcePriority[String(A.Source_Type || '').toUpperCase()] : 99;
    var bp = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sourcePriority, String(B.Source_Type || '').toUpperCase()) ? sourcePriority[String(B.Source_Type || '').toUpperCase()] : 99;
    if (ap !== bp) return ap - bp;
    var as = String(A.Source_ID || '');
    var bs = String(B.Source_ID || '');

function G313_cluster(records) {
  if (!Array.isArray(records)) throw new Error('G3.13 cluster requires an array');
  if (!records.length) {
    return {
      contractVersion: G313_CONTRACT_VERSION,
      algorithmVersion: G313_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
      status: G313_STATUS.NO_INPUT,
      validCount: 0,
      invalidCount: 0,
      comparisonCount: 0,
      clusters: [],
      comparisons: [],
      invalidRecords: []

  records.forEach(function(r, idx) {
    var v = g313ValidateRecord(r);
    if (v.valid) valid.push({record:r, originalIndex:idx});

  var comparisons = [];
  var duplicateEdges = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < valid.length; i++) {
    for (var j = i + 1; j < valid.length; j++) {
      var c = G313_compareNormalized(valid[i].record, valid[j].record);
      comparisons.push(c);
      if (c.result.decision === G313_DECISION.DUPLICATE) {
        duplicateEdges.push([g313GetIdentity(valid[i].record), g313GetIdentity(valid[j].record)]);
      }
    }
  }

  var parent = {};
  function find(x) {
    parent[x] = parent[x] || x;
    if (parent[x] !== x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    return parent[x];
  }
  function union(a, b) {
    var ra = find(a), rb = find(b);
    if (ra !== rb) parent[rb] = ra < rb ? ra : rb;
    find(a); find(b);
  }

  valid.forEach(function(v){ find(g313GetIdentity(v.record)); });
  duplicateEdges.forEach(function(e){ union(e[0], e[1]); });

  var groups = {};
  valid.forEach(function(v) {
    var id = g313GetIdentity(v.record);
    var root = find(id);
    groups[root] = groups[root] || [];
    groups[root].push(v.record);
  });

    var members = groups[root].slice().sort(function(a,b){
      return g313GetIdentity(a).localeCompare(g313GetIdentity(b));

      memberCount: members.length,
      duplicateCount: Math.max(0, members.length - 1),
      survivorIdentity: g313GetIdentity(survivor),
      algorithmVersion: G313_ALGORITHM_VERSION
    };
  }).sort(function(a,b){ return a.clusterId.localeCompare(b.clusterId); });

  return {
    contractVersion: G313_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion: G313_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    status: invalid.length ? G313_STATUS.PARTIAL : G313_STATUS.SUCCESS,
    validCount: valid.length,
    invalidCount: invalid.length,
    comparisonCount: comparisons.length,
    clusters: clusters,
    comparisons: comparisons,
    invalidRecords: invalid
  };
}

function g313DecisionAudit(a, b) {
  var c = G313_compareNormalized(a, b);

    contractVersion: G313_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion: G313_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    observedAt: g313AuditStamp(),
    comparisonIdentityA: c.comparisonIdentityA,
    comparisonIdentityB: c.comparisonIdentityB,
    sourceA: c.sourceA,
    sourceB: c.sourceB,
    decision: c.result.decision,
    score: c.result.score,
    reason: c.result.reason,
    signals: g313Clone(c.result.signals),

    persistentWrites: false

function G313_decisionAudit_(a, b) {

}
```

```markdown
# G3.13 v2.4 — Installation and Execution Guide

## 1. Preconditions
G3.8, G3.9, G3.10, G3.11 and G3.12 must remain frozen and closed.

## 2. Install
In the same Apps Script project used for the prior gates, install all five `.gs` files in this package:
- G313_CrossSourceDeduplication.gs
- G313_TestFixtures.gs
- G313_Tests.gs
- G313_Preflight.gs
- G313_LiveVerification.gs

Do not alter G3.8–G3.12 files.

## 3. Preflight
Run:
`runG313Preflight`

Acceptance:
`Preflight checks: 10; failures: 0`

## 4. Contract suite
Run:
`runG313CrossSourceDedupTests`

Acceptance:
`Tests Run: 120`
`Passed: 120`
`Failures: 0`
`Status: PASS`

## 5. Live verification
Only after 120/120 passes, run:
`runG313CrossSourceDedupLiveVerification`

Acceptance:
- GREENHOUSE SUCCESS
- ASHBY SUCCESS
- LEVER SUCCESS
- no source errors
- 35-field normalization verified
- comparison identity present
- invalid normalized records = 0
- deterministic = true
- failure isolation = true
- final status = PASS

## 6. Why Job_ID is not used here
G3.12 deliberately leaves `Job_ID` as DOWNSTREAM_REQUIRED. The same gate returns `identity.sourceIdentity`. G3.13 uses that value as a non-persistent comparison identity and never invents a Job_ID.

## 7. Important
Do not manually fabricate live duplicate results. The closure record must use observed execution output.


## v2.4 integration contract
The live runner must pass exactly: Greenhouse `sourceConfig.boardToken`, Ashby `sourceConfig.jobBoardName`, Lever `sourceConfig.siteName`.
```

```javascript
/**
 * ESE DIGITALS — G3.13 READ-ONLY LIVE VERIFICATION v2.3
 *
 * Uses:
 *   Greenhouse -> PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API
 *   Ashby      -> PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API
 *   Lever      -> PUBLIC_POSTINGS_API
 *
 * The live runner:
 * - retrieves through the already closed adapters
 * - normalizes through the already closed G3.12 normalizer
 * - carries the G3.12 identity wrapper into G3.13
 * - performs cross-source dedup
 * - performs reverse-order determinism test
 * - performs source failure isolation test using injected adapter dependencies
 * - performs NO production writes.
 */

function runG313CrossSourceDedupLiveVerification(){
  var sources = [
    {type:'GREENHOUSE', sourceId:'SRC-002', sourceName:'Stripe', boardToken:'stripe', mode:'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API'},
    {type:'ASHBY', sourceId:'SRC-ASHBY', sourceName:'Ashby', jobBoardName:'ashby', mode:'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API'},
    {type:'LEVER', sourceId:'SRC-LEVER', sourceName:'Lever', siteName:'leverdemo', mode:'PUBLIC_POSTINGS_API'}
  ];

  var normalized=[];
  var sourceSummaries=[];
  var errors=[];

  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('ESE DIGITALS — G3.13 DEDUP LIVE VERIFICATION v2.3');
  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('Mode: READ-ONLY');
  Logger.log('Sources planned: '+sources.length);

  sources.forEach(function(s){
    try {
      var strategy = {
        sourceType:s.type,
        kind:'ATS_API',
        retrieval:{mode:s.mode}
      };
      var context = {
        sourceConfig: {
          sourceId:s.sourceId,
          sourceType:s.type,
          sourceName:s.sourceName,
          boardToken:s.boardToken,
          jobBoardName:s.jobBoardName,
          siteName:s.siteName
        }
      };

      var raw;
      if (s.type==='GREENHOUSE' && typeof greenhouseDiscover==='function') raw=greenhouseDiscover(strategy,context);
      else if (s.type==='ASHBY' && typeof ashbyDiscover==='function') raw=ashbyDiscover(strategy,context);
      else if (s.type==='LEVER' && typeof leverDiscover==='function') raw=leverDiscover(strategy,context);
      else throw new Error('Required adapter function unavailable for '+s.type);

      if (raw.status !== 'SUCCESS') throw new Error('Adapter status was '+raw.status+' for '+s.type);
      if (raw.errors && raw.errors.length) throw new Error('Adapter errors for '+s.type+': '+JSON.stringify(raw.errors));

      var subset=(raw.records||[]).slice(0,10);
      if (!subset.length) throw new Error('No sample records returned for '+s.type);

      var sourceNormalized=0;
      subset.forEach(function(envelope){
        var n=normalizeCanonicalJob(envelope,context);
        if (!n || !n.jobs || !n.identity || !n.identity.sourceIdentity) {
          throw new Error('G3.12 normalized record missing JOBS or comparison identity for '+s.type);
        }
        if (!g313ValidateJobsSchema(n.jobs)) throw new Error('Normalized record does not have frozen 35-field schema for '+s.type);
        if (!g313GetIdentity(n)) throw new Error('Comparison identity missing for '+s.type);
        normalized.push(n);
        sourceNormalized++;
      });

      sourceSummaries.push({
        source:s.type,
        status:raw.status,
        httpStatus:raw.retrieval.httpStatus,
        endpoint:raw.retrieval.endpoint,
        requestMethod:raw.retrieval.requestMethod,
        sourceResultCount:(raw.records||[]).length,
        normalizedSampleCount:sourceNormalized,
        errors:raw.errors||[],
        warnings:raw.warnings||[]
      });

      Logger.log('--------------------------------------------------');
      Logger.log('SOURCE: '+s.type);
      Logger.log('Status: '+raw.status);
      Logger.log('HTTP Status: '+raw.retrieval.httpStatus);
      Logger.log('Endpoint: '+raw.retrieval.endpoint);
      Logger.log('Request Method: '+raw.retrieval.requestMethod);
      Logger.log('Source Result Count: '+raw.retrieval.resultCount);
      Logger.log('Normalized Sample Count: '+sourceNormalized);
      Logger.log('Errors: '+JSON.stringify(raw.errors||[]));
      Logger.log('Warnings: '+JSON.stringify(raw.warnings||[]));
    } catch(e) {
      errors.push({source:s.type,error:String(e)});
      Logger.log('ERROR '+s.type+': '+e);
    }
  });

  var runA=g313ClusterNormalized_(normalized);
  var reversed=normalized.slice().reverse();
  var runB=g313ClusterNormalized_(reversed);
  var deterministic = JSON.stringify(runA) === JSON.stringify(runB);

  var failureIsolation = runG313FailureIsolationCheck_();

  Logger.log('--------------------------------------------------');
  Logger.log('Normalized records evaluated: '+normalized.length);
  Logger.log('Pair comparisons: '+runA.comparisonCount);
  Logger.log('Duplicate clusters: '+runA.clusters.length);
  Logger.log('Invalid normalized records: '+runA.invalidCount);
  Logger.log('Deterministic across input order: '+deterministic);
  Logger.log('Failure isolation: '+failureIsolation);
  Logger.log('Source errors: '+JSON.stringify(errors));

  var success = errors.length===0 &&
                normalized.length>0 &&
                runA.invalidCount===0 &&
                deterministic &&
                failureIsolation;

  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('G3.13 DEDUP LIVE VERIFICATION COMPLETE');
  Logger.log('Status: '+(success?'PASS':'FAIL'));
  Logger.log('==================================================');

  if (!success) throw new Error('G3.13 live verification did not meet v2.3 acceptance.');
  return {
    status:'SUCCESS',
    mode:'READ-ONLY',
    sourceSummaries:sourceSummaries,
    normalizedCount:normalized.length,
    comparisonCount:runA.comparisonCount,
    clusterCount:runA.clusters.length,
    invalidCount:runA.invalidCount,
    deterministic:deterministic,
    failureIsolation:failureIsolation,
    errors:errors
  };
}

function g313ClusterNormalized_(records){
  return G313_cluster(records);
}

// Failure-isolation check: simulate one source returning an error without
// touching the production adapters or performing any writes.
function runG313FailureIsolationCheck_(){
  var planned = [
    {name:'GREENHOUSE', result:{status:'SUCCESS',records:[g313Record('BASE')],errors:[],warnings:[]}},
    {name:'ASHBY', result:{status:'SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE',records:[],errors:[{code:'SIMULATED_SOURCE_FAILURE'}],warnings:[]}},
    {name:'LEVER', result:{status:'SUCCESS',records:[g313Record('LEVER_DUPLICATE')],errors:[],warnings:[]}}
  ];
  var good=[];
  var sourceErrors=0;
  planned.forEach(function(s){
    if (s.result.status==='SUCCESS') good=good.concat(s.result.records);
    else sourceErrors++;
  });
  var cluster=G313_cluster(good);
  return sourceErrors===1 && cluster.validCount===2 && cluster.invalidCount===0 && cluster.comparisonCount===1;
}
```

```markdown
## Fix
Corrected live-verification sourceConfig field names to match frozen adapter contracts: Greenhouse uses `boardToken`; Ashby uses `jobBoardName`; Lever uses `siteName`.

## Contract impact
No change to `DEDUP_V1` decision logic, comparison identity, clustering rules, audit behavior, or persistence boundaries.
```

```markdown
# G3.13 v2.4 — Rollback and Recovery

## No production writes
G3.13 is read-only. No JOBS, JOB_EVIDENCE, CRM, finance or operational production table may be modified.

## Rollback
1. Stop the G3.13 runner.
2. Remove/revert:
   - G313_CrossSourceDeduplication.gs
   - G313_TestFixtures.gs
   - G313_Tests.gs
   - G313_Preflight.gs
   - G313_LiveVerification.gs
3. Preserve the frozen G3.8–G3.12 packages.
4. Do not delete or alter source records.
5. Record the rollback reason and execution timestamp.

## Recovery
Correct the package at the contract/version level, increment the G3.13 package version, rerun preflight, rerun the full authoritative suite, then repeat live verification.
Never patch production state to force a gate result.
```

```markdown
# G3.13 v2.4 Test Catalog

120 authoritative tests are defined in `G313_Tests.gs`.

Coverage:
1. Contract and schema boundary (001–020)
2. Core duplicate/distinct decisions (021–044)
3. Normalization and similarity primitives (045–060)
4. Clustering and invalid-record handling (061–080)
5. Survivor and immutability controls (081–095)
6. Security / scope boundaries (096–110)
7. Conflict guards and decision determinism (111–120)

Critical architectural assertions:
- `Job_ID` is NOT required at G3.13 because G3.12 deliberately leaves it downstream-required.
- G3.12 `identity.sourceIdentity` is the explicit non-persistent comparison identity.
- No same-source semantic merging.
- Populated company disagreement is a hard DISTINCT guard.
- Populated location disagreement is a hard DISTINCT guard.
- Low title similarity is a hard DISTINCT guard.
- Exact source/application URL is a strong explicit identity signal.
- Production persistence, eligibility, ranking and application automation remain outside this gate.
```

```javascript
function runG313CrossSourceDedupTests(){
  var names=[];
  for (var k in this) {
    if (/^testG313_\d+_/.test(k) && typeof this[k] === 'function') names.push(k);
  }
  names.sort();
  var pass=0, fail=0, failures=[];
  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('ESE DIGITALS — G3.13 CROSS-SOURCE DEDUP TESTS v2.3');
  Logger.log('Contract Version: '+G313_CONTRACT_VERSION);
  Logger.log('Algorithm Version: '+G313_ALGORITHM_VERSION);
  Logger.log('Executing '+names.length+' tests...');
  Logger.log('==================================================');
  names.forEach(function(n,i){
    try {
      this[n]();
      pass++;
      Logger.log('PASS '+(i+1)+': '+n);
    } catch(e) {
      fail++;
      failures.push({test:n,error:String(e)});
      Logger.log('FAIL '+(i+1)+': '+n+' :: '+e);
    }
  }.bind(this));
  Logger.log('==================================================');
  Logger.log('Tests Run: '+names.length);
  Logger.log('Passed: '+pass);
  Logger.log('Failures: '+fail);
  Logger.log('Status: '+(fail===0?'PASS':'FAIL'));
  Logger.log('==================================================');
  if(fail) throw new Error('G3.13 DEDUP TESTS FAILED: '+fail+' test(s) failed.');
}
```

```markdown
# Ese Digitals — G3.13 Cross-Source Semantic Deduplication Gate Pack v2.3

This is the authoritative replacement for every prior G3.13 package.

## Gate position
G3.12 is PASS — EVIDENCED — CLOSED. G3.13 is READY FOR AUTHORITATIVE EXECUTION.

## Purpose
Determine whether normalized opportunity records from different source systems represent the same underlying opportunity, using deterministic and conservative semantic evidence, without creating or persisting Job_ID, without deleting source records, and without making eligibility, ranking, or application decisions.

## Comparison identity
G3.12 intentionally leaves JOBS.Job_ID downstream-required. G3.12 supplies `identity.sourceIdentity` in the form `SOURCE_TYPE:SOURCE_RECORD_ID`. G3.13 uses that value as the non-persistent comparison identity. It must never fabricate a Job_ID.

## Contract
- Contract Version: 2.3
- Algorithm Version: DEDUP_V1
- Match threshold: 85
- Review threshold: 65
- Authoritative tests: 120
- Production writes: none

## Safety rules
- Exact source/application URL is a strong identity signal.
- Same-source same-record identity is DUPLICATE.
- Same-source different record identity is DISTINCT; semantic similarity does not merge same-source records.
- Two populated companies that conflict are DISTINCT.
- Two populated locations that conflict are DISTINCT.
- A one-sided missing company is INSUFFICIENT_SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE, not a conflict.
- Both-side missing company can be a strong duplicate only when exact title/location and strong description evidence support it.
- Materially dissimilar titles are DISTINCT.
- Variant title forms use title-specific abbreviation normalization.
- Results and clusters are deterministic under input reordering.

## Execution order
1. `runG313Preflight`
2. `runG313CrossSourceDedupTests`
3. `runG313CrossSourceDedupLiveVerification`

Do not run live verification until preflight is PASS and the authoritative contract suite is 120/120 with zero failures.

## Live verification
Read-only verification uses the already-closed Greenhouse, Ashby, and Lever adapters; the live runner normalizes returned envelopes through G3.12, carries comparison identity, runs deduplication, checks deterministic ordering, and performs a simulated source-failure isolation check without production writes.

## Rollback
Because G3.13 performs no production writes, rollback is code/package reversion only. Do not mutate or delete G3.8–G3.12 outputs.

See the manifest, installation guide, test catalog, evidence envelope, closure record, and rollback guide for the complete gate procedure.


## v2.4
Corrected live runner source configuration keys to match the frozen adapter contracts.
```

```javascript
var G314_CONTRACT_VERSION = '2.0';
var G314_EVIDENCE_VERSION = 'EVIDENCE_V1';
var G314_TYPES = {SOURCE_RETRIEVAL:'SOURCE_RETRIEVAL', SOURCE_CONTENT:'SOURCE_CONTENT'};
var G314_CONFIDENCE = {HIGH:'HIGH', MEDIUM:'MEDIUM', LOW:'LOW'};

function g314EvidenceId(jobId, evidenceType, observedAt, evidenceUrl, evidenceText){
  var h = g314Sha256_(evidenceText || '');
  return 'EVID-' + g314Sha256_(G314_EVIDENCE_VERSION+'|'+jobId+'|'+evidenceType+'|'+observedAt+'|'+evidenceUrl+'|'+h);
}
function g314Sha256_(s){
  var b = Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, String(s), Utilities.Charset.UTF_8);
  return b.map(function(x){var v=(x<0?x+256:x).toString(16);return v.length===1?'0'+v:v;}).join('');
}
function g314ValidateJob_(job){ return !!(job && typeof job==='object' && typeof job.Comparison_Identity==='string' && job.Comparison_Identity && typeof job.Title==='string' && job.Title); }
function g314BuildEvidence(job, obs){
  if(!g314ValidateJob_(job)) return {status:'INVALID', evidence:null, errors:['INVALID_JOB']};
  if(!obs || typeof obs!=='object' || !obs.evidenceUrl || !obs.observedAt || !obs.evidenceType) return {status:'INVALID', evidence:null, errors:['INVALID_OBSERVATION']};
  var text = obs.evidenceText == null ? '' : String(obs.evidenceText);
  var id = g314EvidenceId(job.Comparison_Identity, obs.evidenceType, obs.observedAt, obs.evidenceUrl, text);
  return {status:'SUCCESS', evidence:{Evidence_ID:id, Job_ID:job.Job_ID||null, Comparison_Identity:job.Comparison_Identity, Evidence_Type:obs.evidenceType, Claim:obs.claim||'Record retrieval observed', Evidence_Text:text, Evidence_URL:obs.evidenceUrl, Observed_At:obs.observedAt, Confidence:obs.confidence||G314_CONFIDENCE.HIGH, Reviewer:obs.reviewer||'AUTOMATED', Created_At:obs.createdAt||obs.observedAt, Contract_Version:G314_CONTRACT_VERSION, Evidence_Version:G314_EVIDENCE_VERSION}, errors:[]};
}
function g314Integrate(records, observationProvider){
  if(!Array.isArray(records)) return {contractVersion:G314_CONTRACT_VERSION,status:'INVALID',integrated:[],errors:['RECORDS_NOT_ARRAY'],warnings:[]};
  var out=[],errors=[],seen={};
  records.forEach(function(job){
    if(!g314ValidateJob_(job)){errors.push('INVALID_JOB');return;}
    var obs=observationProvider(job);
    var r=g314BuildEvidence(job,obs);
    if(r.status!=='SUCCESS'){errors=errors.concat(r.errors||[]);return;}
    var k=r.evidence.Evidence_ID;
    if(!seen[k]){seen[k]=true;out.push(r.evidence);}
  });
  return {contractVersion:G314_CONTRACT_VERSION,status:errors.length?'PARTIAL':'SUCCESS',integrated:out,errors:errors,warnings:[]};
}
function g314Audit(result){ return {contractVersion:G314_CONTRACT_VERSION,evidenceVersion:G314_EVIDENCE_VERSION,observedAt:new Date().toISOString(),integratedCount:(result.integrated||[]).length,errorCount:(result.errors||[]).length,persistentWrites:false,reviewer:'AUTOMATED'}; }
function runG314LiveVerification(){ Logger.log('G3.14 LIVE VERIFICATION PLACEHOLDER — use package guide; no production writes are performed.'); }
```

### SOURCE FILE: `03_G2_G3/Ese_Digitals_G315_Eligibility_Intelligence_Gate_Pack_v1_1_2026-09-11_COMPLETE__EXTRACTED/G315_Decision_Matrix.md`

```markdown
# G3.15 Eligibility Decision Matrix v1.1

## Precedence order

1. Invalid input -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
2. Explicit Nigeria exclusion -> NOT_ELIGIBLE
3. Explicit incompatible timezone -> NOT_ELIGIBLE
4. Explicit Nigeria country -> ELIGIBLE unless restrictive authorization or incompatible timezone creates conflict
5. Restrictive authorization without explicit Nigeria -> REVIEW_REQUIRED
6. Explicit regional eligibility -> REVIEW_REQUIRED
7. Worldwide/global eligibility wording -> REVIEW_REQUIRED
8. Remote-only or location-only wording without country evidence -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

## Remote rule

`REMOTE`, `Remote`, remote workplace, or generic remote description never establishes Nigeria eligibility by itself.

## Authorization rule

`No sponsorship required`, `sponsorship available`, or equivalent non-restrictive wording does not negate explicit Nigeria eligibility.

A requirement such as `must have US work authorization` is a conflict. Without explicit Nigeria evidence it produces REVIEW_REQUIRED; with explicit Nigeria evidence it also produces REVIEW_REQUIRED.

## Timezone rule

Nigeria-compatible timezone evidence does not create eligibility by itself. An explicit incompatible timezone produces NOT_ELIGIBLE.

Missing/unknown timezone does not negate explicit Nigeria eligibility.

## Global/region rule

Worldwide/global or West Africa/Africa wording is insufficient for automatic Nigeria eligibility and requires review.
```

```javascript
/**
 * ESE DIGITALS — G3.15 ELIGIBILITY INTELLIGENCE
 * Contract Version 1.1
 * Algorithm Version ELIGIBILITY_V1
 *
 * Purpose:

 * sufficient evidence for Nigeria eligibility.

 * - No persistence
 * - No network
 * - No ranking/matching
 * - No application automation
 * - Explicit Nigeria evidence required for unconditional ELIGIBLE
 */

var G315_CONTRACT_VERSION = '1.1';
var G315_ALGORITHM_VERSION = 'ELIGIBILITY_V1';

var G315_STATUS = {
  ELIGIBLE: 'ELIGIBLE',
  NOT_ELIGIBLE: 'NOT_ELIGIBLE',
  REVIEW_REQUIRED: 'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
  INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'
};

var G315_REASON = {
  EXPLICIT_COUNTRY_ELIGIBILITY: 'EXPLICIT_COUNTRY_ELIGIBILITY',
  EXPLICIT_REGION_ELIGIBILITY_REVIEW: 'EXPLICIT_REGION_ELIGIBILITY_REVIEW',
  EXPLICIT_COUNTRY_EXCLUSION: 'EXPLICIT_COUNTRY_EXCLUSION',
  WORK_AUTHORIZATION_CONFLICT: 'WORK_AUTHORIZATION_CONFLICT',
  WORK_AUTHORIZATION_UNCLEAR: 'WORK_AUTHORIZATION_UNCLEAR',
  TIMEZONE_CONFLICT: 'TIMEZONE_CONFLICT',
  TIMEZONE_UNCLEAR: 'TIMEZONE_UNCLEAR',
  REMOTE_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT: 'REMOTE_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT',
  WORLDWIDE_EXPLICIT: 'WORLDWIDE_EXPLICIT',
  LOCATION_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT: 'LOCATION_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT',
  INSUFFICIENT_COUNTRY_EVIDENCE: 'INSUFFICIENT_COUNTRY_EVIDENCE'
};

function G315_normalizeText_(v) {
  return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, ' and ')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9+.-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function G315_list_(v) {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(G315_normalizeText_).filter(Boolean);
  var s = G315_normalizeText_(v);
  if (!s) return [];
  return s.split(/[,;|\n]+/).map(function(x){ return x.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
}

function G315_hasAny_(items, needles) {
  return items.some(function(item){
    return needles.some(function(n){ return item === n || item.indexOf(n) !== -1; });
  });
}

function G315_isNigeria_(v) {
  var s = G315_normalizeText_(v);
  return s === 'ng' || s === 'nigeria' || s === 'federal republic of nigeria';
}

function G315_hasNigeria_(list) { return list.some(G315_isNigeria_); }

function G315_workAuthState_(v) {
  var s = G315_normalizeText_(v);
  if (!s) return 'UNKNOWN';

  // Explicitly non-restrictive language must be tested before generic
  // "no sponsorship" / visa language.
  if (/no sponsorship required|sponsorship not required|do not require sponsorship|does not require sponsorship/.test(s)) {
    return 'CLEAR';
  }
  if (/authorized to work in any country|legally authorized to work anywhere|work authorization not required/.test(s)) {
    return 'GLOBAL';
  }
  if (/must (have|possess).*work authorization|authorized to work|legal right to work|work permit required|visa required/.test(s)) {
    return 'RESTRICTIVE';
  }
  if (/no sponsorship|sponsorship not available|cannot sponsor/.test(s)) {
    return 'NO_SPONSORSHIP';
  }
  if (/sponsorship available|will sponsor|visa sponsorship/.test(s)) return 'SPONSORSHIP';
  if (/anywhere|worldwide|global|open to all countries|all countries/.test(s)) return 'GLOBAL';
  return 'AMBIGUOUS';
}

function G315_timezoneState_(v) {
  var s = G315_normalizeText_(v);
  if (!s) return 'UNKNOWN';
  if (/nigeria|west africa|lagos|wat|gmt\+1|utc\+1/.test(s)) return 'NIGERIA_COMPATIBLE';
  if (/americas only|us only|united states only|canada only|north america only/.test(s)) return 'NIGERIA_INCOMPATIBLE';
  if (/europe only|european union only|eu only|uk only|asia only|australia only/.test(s)) return 'REGION_RESTRICTIVE';
  return 'UNKNOWN';
}

function G315_extractJob_(input) {
  if (input && typeof input === 'object' && input.jobs && typeof input.jobs === 'object' && !Array.isArray(input.jobs)) {
    var nested = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(input.jobs));
    nested.JOB_IDENTITY = (input.identity && input.identity.sourceIdentity) || nested.JOB_IDENTITY || null;
    nested._PROVENANCE = input.provenance || null;
    return nested;
  }
  if (input && typeof input === 'object' && !Array.isArray(input)) return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(input));
  return null;
}

function G315_validateJob_(job) {
  if (!job || typeof job !== 'object' || Array.isArray(job)) return { valid:false, reason:'JOB_NOT_OBJECT' };
  var hasCanonicalWrapper = !!(job.jobs && typeof job.jobs === 'object' && !Array.isArray(job.jobs));
  var hasTestMarker = job.JOBS === true;
  var identity = (job.identity && job.identity.sourceIdentity) || job.JOB_IDENTITY;
  var sourceType = job.Source_Type || (job.jobs && job.jobs.Source_Type);
  if (!hasCanonicalWrapper && !hasTestMarker) return { valid:false, reason:'JOBS_SCHEMA_MISSING' };
  if (!identity) return { valid:false, reason:'COMPARISON_IDENTITY_MISSING' };
  if (!sourceType) return { valid:false, reason:'SOURCE_TYPE_MISSING' };
  return { valid:true };
}

function G315_evaluateEligibility(input, evidence) {
  var validation = G315_validateJob_(input);
  var evidenceCount = Array.isArray(evidence) ? evidence.length : 0;
  if (!validation.valid) {
    return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, ['INVALID_INPUT', validation.reason], null, 'NONE', evidenceCount);
  }
  var job = G315_extractJob_(input);

  var eligibleCountries = G315_list_(job.Eligible_Countries);
  var eligibleRegions = G315_list_(job.Eligible_Regions);
  var excludedCountries = G315_list_(job.Excluded_Countries);
  var authState = G315_workAuthState_(job.Work_Authorization);
  var tzState = G315_timezoneState_(job.Timezone);
  var remoteType = G315_normalizeText_(job.Remote_Type);
  var location = G315_normalizeText_(job.Location);
  var desc = G315_normalizeText_(job.Description);

  var reasons = [];
  var exclusion = G315_hasNigeria_(excludedCountries);
  var explicitCountry = G315_hasNigeria_(eligibleCountries);
  var regionOnly = !explicitCountry && G315_hasAny_(eligibleRegions, ['west africa','western africa','africa']);
  var worldwide = G315_hasAny_(eligibleCountries.concat(eligibleRegions), ['worldwide','global','all countries','anywhere']);
  var remoteOnly = /remote/.test(remoteType) || /remote/.test(location) || /remote/.test(desc);

  // 1. Explicit Nigeria exclusion always wins.
  if (exclusion) return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.NOT_ELIGIBLE, [G315_REASON.EXPLICIT_COUNTRY_EXCLUSION], false, 'HIGH', evidenceCount);

  // 2. Explicit timezone incompatibility is a hard negative even where
  // Nigeria is named, because the job cannot practically be performed.
  if (tzState === 'NIGERIA_INCOMPATIBLE') {
    return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.NOT_ELIGIBLE, [G315_REASON.TIMEZONE_CONFLICT], false, 'HIGH', evidenceCount);
  }

  // 3. Explicit restrictive authorization without Nigeria-specific evidence
  // needs human review rather than being declared eligible.
  if (!explicitCountry && !worldwide && !regionOnly && (authState === 'RESTRICTIVE' || authState === 'NO_SPONSORSHIP')) {
    return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.REVIEW_REQUIRED, [G315_REASON.WORK_AUTHORIZATION_CONFLICT], null, 'MEDIUM', evidenceCount);
  }

  // 4. Explicit Nigeria country evidence is sufficient for eligibility unless
  // a hard conflict exists. Unknown auth/timezone does NOT downgrade it.
  if (explicitCountry) {
    reasons.push(G315_REASON.EXPLICIT_COUNTRY_ELIGIBILITY);
    if (authState === 'RESTRICTIVE' || authState === 'NO_SPONSORSHIP') {
      return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.REVIEW_REQUIRED, reasons.concat([G315_REASON.WORK_AUTHORIZATION_CONFLICT]), null, 'MEDIUM', evidenceCount);
    }
    return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.ELIGIBLE, reasons, true, 'HIGH', evidenceCount);
  }

  // 5. Region-level evidence is not equivalent to explicit Nigeria evidence.
  if (regionOnly) return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.REVIEW_REQUIRED, [G315_REASON.EXPLICIT_REGION_ELIGIBILITY_REVIEW], null, 'MEDIUM', evidenceCount);

  // 6. Worldwide/global language is not, by itself, proof of Nigeria eligibility.
  if (worldwide) return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.REVIEW_REQUIRED, [G315_REASON.WORLDWIDE_EXPLICIT], null, 'MEDIUM', evidenceCount);

  // 7. Remote wording without country evidence is insufficient.
  if (remoteOnly) reasons.push(G315_REASON.REMOTE_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT);
  else reasons.push(G315_REASON.LOCATION_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT);
  if (authState === 'UNKNOWN' || authState === 'AMBIGUOUS') reasons.push(G315_REASON.WORK_AUTHORIZATION_UNCLEAR);
  if (tzState === 'UNKNOWN') reasons.push(G315_REASON.TIMEZONE_UNCLEAR);
  reasons.push(G315_REASON.INSUFFICIENT_COUNTRY_EVIDENCE);
  return G315_result_(G315_STATUS.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, reasons, null, 'LOW', evidenceCount);
}

function G315_result_(status, reasons, nigeriaEligible, confidence, evidenceCount) {
  return {
    contractVersion:G315_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion:G315_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    status:status,
    reasonCodes:reasons.slice(),
    nigeriaEligible:nigeriaEligible,
    confidence:confidence,
    evidenceRequired:(status === G315_STATUS.REVIEW_REQUIRED || status === G315_STATUS.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE),
    evidenceCount:Number(evidenceCount) || 0,
    persistentWrite:false
  };
}

function G315_buildAudit_(job, result, observedAt) {
  var identity = String((job && (job.JOB_IDENTITY || (job.identity && job.identity.sourceIdentity))) || '');
  return {
    contractVersion:G315_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    algorithmVersion:G315_ALGORITHM_VERSION,
    observedAt:observedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
    comparisonIdentity:identity,
    status:result.status,
    reasonCodes:result.reasonCodes.slice(),
    nigeriaEligible:result.nigeriaEligible,
    confidence:result.confidence,
    evidenceCount:result.evidenceCount,
    persistentWrite:false
  };
}
```

```markdown
# G3.15 Eligibility Intelligence — Evidence Model v1.1

## Required evidence dimensions

1. Explicit eligible countries
2. Eligible regions
3. Explicit excluded countries
4. Work authorization wording
5. Timezone constraints
6. Remote/workplace wording
7. Source/provenance identity

## Decision principle

Nigeria eligibility is an evidence decision, not a remote-work assumption.
`Remote` alone is insufficient.

An explicit `Nigeria` eligible-country statement is sufficient for `ELIGIBLE` unless a hard conflict exists. Unknown authorization or timezone does not automatically downgrade explicit Nigeria evidence.

An explicit Nigeria exclusion always yields `NOT_ELIGIBLE`.

Explicit incompatible timezone yields `NOT_ELIGIBLE`.

Restrictive work authorization without Nigeria-specific country evidence yields `REVIEW_REQUIRED`.

Worldwide/global and regional evidence yield `REVIEW_REQUIRED`, not automatic Nigeria eligibility.

## Audit fields

The evaluator returns contract version, algorithm version, comparison identity, status, reason codes, Nigeria eligibility value, confidence, evidence count and `persistentWrite:false`.
```

```markdown
# G3.15 Installation and Execution Guide v1.1

## Prerequisite
G3.14 must be PASS — EVIDENCED — CLOSED.

## Install

Copy all five `.gs` files into the existing Apps Script project without modifying G3.8–G3.14.

## Execution order

1. `G315_runPreflight`
2. `G315_runTests`
3. `G315_runLiveVerification`

## Authoritative contract acceptance

Expected: 32 tests, 32 passed, 0 failures, Status PASS.

## Live acceptance

The live runner evaluates normalized-record samples in read-only mode and verifies deterministic output, input immutability, valid result status and `persistentWrite:false`.

If G3.14 exposes a `G314_GET_ELIGIBILITY_SAMPLES` function, that hook is used. Otherwise, the runner uses the documented representative normalized records.

## Hard rule

Do not infer Nigeria eligibility from `Remote_Type=REMOTE`, `Location=Remote`, or generic worldwide/global language alone.
```

```markdown
# G3.15 Release Notes v1.1

## Why v1.1 exists

The first v1.0 authoritative execution exposed systematic decision-rule defects. The evaluator downgraded explicit Nigeria records because authorization/timezone fields were unknown and misclassified `No sponsorship required`.

## v1.1 corrections

- Accept the G3.12 canonical wrapper (`jobs`, `identity`, `provenance`, `fingerprint`).
- Preserve the non-persistent `identity.sourceIdentity` as the evaluator identity.
- Explicit Nigeria evidence is sufficient for ELIGIBLE unless there is an explicit hard conflict.
- Unknown authorization/timezone no longer downgrades explicit Nigeria evidence.
- `No sponsorship required` is classified as CLEAR.
- Explicit incompatible timezone remains NOT_ELIGIBLE.
- Restrictive authorization conflicts produce REVIEW_REQUIRED.
- Remote-only, regional and worldwide evidence remain non-final without Nigeria-specific evidence.
- Persistence is always false.
```

```markdown
# G3.15 Rollback and Recovery v1.1

G3.15 is read-only and has no production persistence.

Rollback is therefore code/artifact rollback only:

1. Stop G3.15 execution.
2. Preserve the authoritative failed-run logs as evidence.
3. Remove/revert the G3.15 files to the last accepted version.
4. Do not alter closed G3.8–G3.14 artifacts.
5. Re-run preflight and contract tests after any correction.
6. Repeat live verification only after the corrected contract suite passes.
```

```javascript
    ['EvidenceCountPreserved',function(){G315_assert_(G315_evaluateEligibility(G315_FIXTURE.remoteOnly,[1,2]).evidenceCount===2,'evidence count')}],

    ['InvalidArray',function(){G315_assert_(G315_evaluateEligibility([],[]).status==='INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE','array')}],
    ['MissingIdentity',function(){var j=G315_FIXTURE.base();delete j.JOB_IDENTITY;G315_assert_(G315_evaluateEligibility(j,[]).status==='INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE','identity')}],
```
