  if (status === 404 || status === 410 || status === 401 || status === 403) {
    return G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE;
  }
  return G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE;
}

/**
 * Primary adapter interface.
 * @param {Object} strategy one validated G2 strategy
 * @param {Object} context execution context with sourceConfig and optional runId/planId
 * @param {Object=} dependencies optional test dependency injection; fetch(request) required only in tests
 * @return {Object} frozen common adapter result shape
 */
function greenhouseDiscover(strategy, context, dependencies) {
  var requestedAt = g38GhNowIso();
  var config;
  var endpoint;

  try {
    g38GhValidateStrategy(strategy);
    config = g38GhGetConfig(context);
    endpoint = g38GhBuildEndpoint(config);
  } catch (error) {
    var invalidCode = String(error && error.message ? error.message : error);
    var invalidStatus = invalidCode.indexOf(G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_STRATEGY) === 0
      ? G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.INVALID_STRATEGY
      : G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.INVALID_SOURCE;
    return {
      status: invalidStatus,
      source: config ? g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint) : {
        sourceId: config ? config.sourceId : '',
        sourceType: G38_GREENHOUSE_SOURCE_TYPE,
        sourceName: config ? config.sourceName : 'Greenhouse',
        endpoint: endpoint || '',
        verificationStatus: 'UNVERIFIED'
      },
      retrieval: {
        requestedAt: requestedAt,
        retrievedAt: requestedAt,
        httpStatus: 0,
        requestMethod: 'GET',
        endpoint: endpoint || '',
        resultCount: 0,
        durationMs: 0
      },
      records: [],
      errors: [{ code: String(error && error.message ? error.message : error), message: String(error && error.message ? error.message : error) }],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  var fetchFn = dependencies && typeof dependencies.fetch === 'function'
    ? dependencies.fetch
    : function(url, options) {
        return UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);
      };

  var startedMs = new Date().getTime();
  var response;
  var httpStatus = 0;
  var retrievedAt;

  try {
    response = fetchFn(endpoint, {
      method: 'get',
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      muteHttpExceptions: true,
      followRedirects: true
    });

    httpStatus = g38GhReadStatus(response);
    retrievedAt = g38GhNowIso();

    if (httpStatus !== 200) {
      var failureStatus = g38GhClassifyHttpFailure(httpStatus);
      var failureCode = httpStatus === 429
        ? G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.RATE_LIMITED
        : G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.HTTP_ERROR;
      return {
        status: failureStatus,
        source: g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint),
        retrieval: {
          requestedAt: requestedAt,
          retrievedAt: retrievedAt,
          httpStatus: httpStatus,
          requestMethod: 'GET',
          endpoint: endpoint,
          resultCount: 0,
          durationMs: new Date().getTime() - startedMs
        },
        records: [],
        errors: [{ code: failureCode, message: 'Greenhouse returned HTTP ' + httpStatus }],
        warnings: []
      };
    }

    var text = g38GhReadText(response);
    var payload;
    try {
      payload = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch (parseError) {

        status: G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.PARSE_ERROR,
        source: g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint),
        retrieval: {
          requestedAt: requestedAt,
          retrievedAt: retrievedAt,
          httpStatus: httpStatus,
          requestMethod: 'GET',
          endpoint: endpoint,
          resultCount: 0,
          durationMs: new Date().getTime() - startedMs
        },
        records: [],
        errors: [{ code: G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.PARSE_ERROR, message: 'Invalid JSON response' }],
        warnings: []

    if (!g38GhIsObject(payload) || !Array.isArray(payload.jobs)) {
      return {
        status: G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.PARSE_ERROR,
        source: g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint),
        retrieval: {
          requestedAt: requestedAt,
          retrievedAt: retrievedAt,
          httpStatus: httpStatus,
          requestMethod: 'GET',
          endpoint: endpoint,
          resultCount: 0,
          durationMs: new Date().getTime() - startedMs
        },
        records: [],
        errors: [{ code: G38_GREENHOUSE_ERROR_CODES.INVALID_RESPONSE, message: 'Response jobs array required' }],
        warnings: []

    var errors = [];
    var warnings = [];

      status: G38_GREENHOUSE_STATUS.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE,
      source: g38GhBuildSource(config, endpoint),

        requestedAt: requestedAt,
        retrievedAt: retrievedAt,
        httpStatus: httpStatus,
        requestMethod: 'GET',
        endpoint: endpoint,

        durationMs: new Date().getTime() - startedMs

  var s={id:'STRAT-ASHBY-TEST',kind:'ATS_API',sourceType:'ASHBY',role:'Operations Specialist',roleResolution:{exactTitles:['Operations Specialist']},geography:{country:'Nigeria'},remote:'FULLY_REMOTE',employmentType:'FULL_TIME',keywords:['operations','excel'],exclusions:['US-only'],freshnessDays:7,retrieval:{mode:'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API',endpointMode:'ASHBY_PUBLIC_JOB_BOARD'}};
  if(overrides) Object.keys(overrides).forEach(function(k){s[k]=overrides[k];}); return s;
}
function g39tContext(overrides){
  var c={runId:'RUN-G39-TEST',planId:'PLAN-G39-TEST',requestedAt:G39T_BASE_TIME,executionMode:'TEST',sourceConfig:{sourceId:'SRC-ASHBY-TEST',sourceType:'ASHBY',sourceName:'Ashby Test Board',jobBoardName:'example',verificationStatus:'VERIFIED'}};
  if(overrides) Object.keys(overrides).forEach(function(k){c[k]=overrides[k];}); return c;
}
function g39tJob(id,overrides){
  var j={id:id,title:'Operations Specialist',location:'Remote - Worldwide',secondaryLocations:[{location:'Lagos',address:{addressCountry:'NGA'}}],jobUrl:'https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/example/'+encodeURIComponent(String(id)),applyUrl:'https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/example/'+encodeURIComponent(String(id))+'?application=true',department:'Operations',team:'Business Operations',isListed:true,compensation:{compensationTierSummary:'Salary'},metadata:{arbitrary:'source-native-data'},descriptionPlain:'Source description '+id};
  if(overrides) Object.keys(overrides).forEach(function(k){j[k]=overrides[k];}); return j;
}
function g39tResponse(status,payload,textOverride){var body=textOverride!==undefined?textOverride:JSON.stringify(payload);return{getResponseCode:function(){return status;},getContentText:function(){return body;}};}
function g39tPayload(jobs){return{apiVersion:'1',jobs:jobs||[]};}
function g39tRun(jobs,strategy,context,observed,responseOverride){var response=responseOverride||g39tResponse(200,g39tPayload(jobs));var obs=observed||{};var c=context||g39tContext();var s=strategy||g39tStrategy();return ashbyDiscover(s,c,{fetch:function(url,options){obs.url=url;obs.options=g39tClone(options);obs.calls=(obs.calls||0)+1;return response;}});}

```markdown
# ESE DIGITALS — PHASE 4 — G2 QUERY INTELLIGENCE
## FINAL END-TO-END IMPLEMENTATION SPECIFICATION

**Status:** Final corrected G2 specification for implementation
**Gate:** Phase 4 — G2 (Query Intelligence / 4A)
**Purpose:** Convert a user's structured opportunity-search intent into a deterministic, auditable, machine-readable Query Plan that G3 can consume.
**Implementation target:** Google Apps Script attached to `PDE_OS_MASTER`
**Primary module:** `QueryEngine.gs`
**Primary test module:** `QueryEngineTests.gs`
**Interface position:** UI/front-end may collect the inputs, but Query Intelligence remains centralized in Apps Script.
**G3 contract:** The output is JSON-serializable, versioned, deterministic in structure, and explicitly marked for G3 compatibility.
**Frozen design principle:** This document fixes the remaining G2.1 QA gaps without reopening the prior architecture redesign.

> **IMPORTANT EXECUTION STATUS RULE**
>
> This file is an implementation specification and execution guide. It does **not** claim that the user's Apps Script environment has already executed this code successfully. Completion must be established by running the supplied tests in the user's actual Apps Script project and retaining the resulting evidence.

---

# 1. CONTROLLING DECISIONS

The Phase 4 project manual establishes the Opportunity Intelligence Engine as the larger product context, with Query Intelligence as an early layer. The controlling rules for this gate are:

1. Query generation is an intelligence layer, not a collection of ad-hoc string substitutions.
2. Role resolution must use a controlled taxonomy.
3. Geography must remain explicit and must never be expanded to Worldwide merely because the user selected remote work.
4. `Remote` is a work-mode preference. It is not evidence of Worldwide eligibility and is not evidence of Nigerian eligibility.
5. User-country, target-country, preferred-region, and other geography concepts must not be silently conflated.
6. Raw user input must remain auditable while canonical values are used for deterministic logic.
7. Every generated strategy must conform to a common schema.
8. Strategy signatures must be unique within a Query Plan.
9. The plan must have a stable, versioned schema contract for G3.
10. ATS strategies are discovery strategies, not fabricated ATS records.
11. No private data, payment secret, API secret, credential, or internal CRM data belongs in the Query Plan.
12. Google search is a discovery mechanism. A search result is not proof that a job is live, eligible, or current.
13. No job application is automated by G2.
14. No strategy may silently invent geography, role titles, or eligibility.
15. If input is unresolved, the plan must fail closed for that dimension and record the unresolved condition instead of guessing.

These principles align with the master Phase 4 rules prohibiting fabrication and prohibiting the conflation of remote, worldwide, eligibility, freshness and evidence. fileciteturn12file1L129-L153

---

# 2. WHAT G2 IS — AND WHAT IT IS NOT

## 2.1 G2 IS

G2 is the controlled translation layer between user intent and discovery instructions.

The logical flow is:

```text
USER INTENT
    ↓
INPUT VALIDATION
    ↓
RAW-VALUE PRESERVATION
    ↓
CANONICAL NORMALIZATION
    ↓
ROLE RESOLUTION
    ↓
GEOGRAPHY RESOLUTION
    ↓
RETRIEVAL CONTEXT
    ↓
STRATEGY GENERATION
    ↓
STRATEGY-SCHEMA VALIDATION
    ↓
DUPLICATE-SIGNATURE VALIDATION
    ↓
PLAN VALIDATION
    ↓
VERSIONED QUERY PLAN
    ↓
G3 DISCOVERY
```

## 2.2 G2 IS NOT

G2 is **not**:

- a live job scraper;
- a job-verification engine;
- an eligibility adjudicator for individual jobs;
- a complete recommendation engine;
- an application automation system;
- a source of invented jobs;
- a promise that Google results are exhaustive;
- an assumption that `Fully Remote` means `Worldwide`;
- a reason to publish the private `PDE_OS_MASTER` workbook;
- a replacement for G3 structured ATS discovery.

The master Phase 4 manual explicitly places multi-source discovery, verification, evidence, eligibility and ranking after the query layer. fileciteturn12file1L124-L139

---

# 3. INPUT CONTRACT

The canonical `generateQueryPlan()` input object is designed to accept either arrays or comma-separated strings for fields where that is useful to the user interface.

## 3.1 Required / optional fields

```javascript
{
  role: string,
  country: string,
  targetCountries: string | string[],
  regions: string | string[],
  remotePreference: string,
  employmentType: string,
  keywords: string | string[],
  exclusions: string | string[],
  freshnessDays: number | string,
  allowWorldwide: boolean,
  preferredRegions: string | string[],
  workAuthorization: string,
  timezone: string,
  mode: string
}
```

## 3.2 Meaning of `country`

`country` means the user's stated base/home country for the profile context unless the front-end explicitly labels another meaning.

It is preserved as both:

- `userIntent.raw.country` — exact user-supplied value;
- `userIntent.canonical.country` — normalized canonical country, where resolvable.

## 3.3 Meaning of `targetCountries`

`targetCountries` means the countries in which the user wants to search for opportunities or which the user has explicitly identified as target hiring geographies.

This distinction prevents a future profile from accidentally using the user's own country as the only target opportunity geography.

If `targetCountries` is not supplied, G2 uses `country` as the initial exact-country discovery target **only because that is the conservative default for the current MVP profile model**. The plan records this in `geographyResolution.targetCountriesSource`.

That is a defaulting rule, not an eligibility claim.

## 3.4 Meaning of `regions`

`regions` are broader geographic preferences such as `Africa`, `EMEA`, `Europe`, `APAC`, etc.

Multiple regions are preserved and produce separate region strategies. They are not collapsed to the first item.

## 3.5 Meaning of `allowWorldwide`

`allowWorldwide === true` explicitly authorizes a Worldwide discovery strategy.

`allowWorldwide === false` means no Worldwide strategy is generated.

Remote preference alone can never set this flag to true.

## 3.6 Meaning of `freshnessDays`

`freshnessDays` is the user's preferred maximum posting age for downstream retrieval and filtering.

It is not treated as a fake Google search operator and is not silently inserted into search text as though Google guaranteed date semantics.

Valid range: **1–90 days**.

Out-of-range input causes an explicit validation error; it is not silently coerced.

---

# 4. G2 OUTPUT CONTRACT

The top-level output object is the canonical Query Plan.

```javascript
{
  schemaVersion: "2.1",
  taxonomyVersion: "1.0",
  geographyVersion: "1.0",
  planId: "PLAN-...",
  generatedAt: "ISO-8601 timestamp",
  generatedBy: "QueryEngine.gs",
  compatibleWith: ["G3"],
  status: "VALID" | "INVALID",
  executable: true | false,
  userIntent: {...},
  retrievalContext: {...},
  strategies: [...],
  totalStrategies: number,
  validation: {...}
}
```

## 4.1 The G3 contract

G3 must be able to consume the plan without reverse-engineering free text.

Every strategy therefore contains structured properties such as:

```javascript
{
  id,
  kind,
  purpose,
  sourceType,
  role,
  roleResolution,
  geography,
  remote,
  employmentType,
  keywords,
  exclusions,
  freshnessDays,
  retrieval,
  query,
  enabled,
  signature
}
```

The final Google query string exists as a convenience for Google discovery. It is not the canonical semantic representation.

---

# 5. CONTROLLED ROLE TAXONOMY

The role resolver must never use naive substring logic such as:

```javascript
if (role.toLowerCase().includes('operations')) { ... }
```

That approach causes false taxonomy expansion and makes results difficult to audit.

The controlled taxonomy below uses explicit tiers:

- `EXACT_TITLE` — canonical role title supplied or directly recognized;
- `RELATED_TITLE` — close controlled title in the same family;
- `ADJACENT_ROLE` — adjacent role that may legitimately capture relevant opportunities without pretending equivalence;
- `FAMILY` — the selected role family itself;
- `CUSTOM_ROLE` — user supplied role that is not in the controlled taxonomy;
- `EMPTY` — no usable role.

### 5.1 Frozen taxonomy

```javascript

    ]
  },

    ]
  },

> The exact taxonomy must remain centrally controlled. Adding new titles is a taxonomy change and must increase the taxonomy version when the compatibility contract changes.

# 6. COUNTRY AND REGION MODELS

## 6.1 Country model

```javascript
const COUNTRY_MODEL = {
  Nigeria: {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'Nigeria',
    terms: ['Nigeria']
  },
  'United States': {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'United States',
    terms: ['United States', 'USA', 'US']
  },
  UK: {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'UK',
    terms: ['UK', 'United Kingdom', 'Britain']
  },
  Canada: {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'Canada',
    terms: ['Canada']
  },
  Kenya: {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'Kenya',
    terms: ['Kenya']
  },
  'South Africa': {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'South Africa',
    terms: ['South Africa']
  },
  Ghana: {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'Ghana',
    terms: ['Ghana']
  },
  Germany: {
    type: 'country',
    label: 'Germany',
    terms: ['Germany']
  }
};
```

## 6.2 Region model

The alias sets are deliberately non-overlapping at the normalized-key level so that country-like strings do not accidentally resolve to regions.

```javascript
const REGION_MODEL = {
  Africa: {
    type: 'region',
    label: 'Africa',
    terms: ['Africa']
  },
  EMEA: {
    type: 'region',
    label: 'EMEA',
    terms: ['EMEA', 'Europe Middle East Africa']
  },
  Europe: {
    type: 'region',
    label: 'Europe',
    terms: ['Europe']
  },
  Asia: {
    type: 'region',
    label: 'Asia',
    terms: ['Asia']
  },
  APAC: {
    type: 'region',
    label: 'APAC',
    terms: ['APAC', 'Asia Pacific', 'Asia-Pacific']
  },
  'North America': {
    type: 'region',
    label: 'North America',
    terms: ['North America']
  },
  LATAM: {
    type: 'region',
    label: 'LATAM',
    terms: ['LATAM', 'Latin America']
  },
  Worldwide: {
    type: 'global',
    label: 'Worldwide',
    terms: ['Worldwide', 'Global', 'Anywhere in the world']
  }
};
```

## 6.3 Remote model

```javascript
const REMOTE_TYPES = {
  'Fully Remote': 'Fully Remote',
  'Remote-First': 'Remote-First',
  Hybrid: 'Hybrid',
  'On-site': 'On-site'
};
```

Remote terminology is an independent dimension. It must not rewrite geography.

---

# 7. RAW-VALUE PRESERVATION AND NORMALIZATION

G2.1 QA requires a deliberate distinction between:

- the value the user actually typed;
- the canonical list used internally.

This means a scalar string must remain a scalar string in the raw record. It must not be silently converted to an array merely because the engine uses arrays internally.

## 7.1 Utility functions

```javascript
function cloneRawValue(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.slice();
  if (value && typeof value === 'object') return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  return value;
}

function splitRawToItems(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value
      .map(v => String(v).trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return value
      .split(',')
      .map(v => v.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return [];
  return [String(value).trim()].filter(Boolean);
}

function normalizeString(value) {
  return String(value === undefined || value === null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function normalizeKey(value) {
  return normalizeString(value).toLowerCase();
}

function normalizeStringArray(value) {
  const items = splitRawToItems(value);
  const seen = new Set();
  const out = [];

  items.forEach(item => {
    const clean = normalizeString(item);
    const key = clean.toLowerCase();
    if (!clean || seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push(clean);
  });

  return out;
}
```

## 7.2 Freshness normalization

```javascript
function normalizeFreshnessDays(value, defaultValue) {
  const fallback = defaultValue || 7;

  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
    return {
      value: fallback,
      valid: true,
      reason: 'DEFAULTED'
    };
  }

  const n = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
    return {
      value: null,
      valid: false,
      reason: 'FRESHNESS_NOT_NUMERIC'
    };
  }

  if (!Number.isInteger(n)) {
    return {
      value: null,
      valid: false,
      reason: 'FRESHNESS_NOT_INTEGER'
    };
  }

  if (n < 1 || n > 90) {
    return {
      value: null,
      valid: false,
      reason: 'FRESHNESS_OUT_OF_RANGE_1_TO_90'
    };
  }

  return {
    value: n,
    valid: true,
    reason: 'VALID'
  };
}
```

This specifically fixes the QA requirement that an invalid freshness value should produce a precise reason rather than silently defaulting.

---

# 8. ROLE RESOLUTION

Resolution order is frozen as:

```text
FAMILY
→ EXACT_TITLE
→ RELATED_TITLE
→ ADJACENT_ROLE
→ CUSTOM_ROLE
→ EMPTY
```

The resolver must return enough information for auditing and strategy construction.

```javascript
function resolveRole(rawRole) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawRole);
  const normalized = normalizeString(rawRole);
  const key = normalizeKey(normalized);

  if (!key) {
    return {
      tier: 'EMPTY',
      family: null,
      canonicalRole: null,
      raw: raw,
      normalized: normalized,
      exactTitles: [],
      relatedTitles: [],
      adjacentRoles: [],
      reason: 'ROLE_EMPTY'
    };
  }

  const families = Object.keys(ROLE_TAXONOMY);

  // FAMILY first.
  for (const family of families) {
    if (normalizeKey(family) === key) {
      const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
      return {
        tier: 'FAMILY',
        family: family,
        canonicalRole: family,
        raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized,
        exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(),
        adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_FAMILY'
      };
    }
  }

  // EXACT_TITLE.
  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.exact.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'EXACT_TITLE',
        family: family,
        canonicalRole: normalized,
        raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized,
        exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(),
        adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_EXACT_TITLE'
      };
    }
  }

  // RELATED_TITLE.
  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.related.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'RELATED_TITLE',
        family: family,
        canonicalRole: normalized,
        raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized,
        exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(),
        adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_RELATED_TITLE'
      };
    }
  }

  // ADJACENT_ROLE.
  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.adjacent.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'ADJACENT_ROLE',
        family: family,
        canonicalRole: normalized,
        raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized,
        exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(),
        adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_ADJACENT_ROLE'
      };
    }
  }

  // CUSTOM_ROLE.
  return {
    tier: 'CUSTOM_ROLE',
    family: null,
    canonicalRole: normalized,
    raw: raw,
    normalized: normalized,
    exactTitles: [normalized],
    relatedTitles: [],
    adjacentRoles: [],
    reason: 'ROLE_TREATED_AS_CUSTOM_ROLE'
  };
}
```

## 8.1 Role semantics

`FAMILY` does not mean every title is equivalent. It means the user selected a family and the engine may use the controlled exact/related/adjacent tiers for separate discovery purposes.

`EXACT_TITLE` does not authorize the engine to invent related roles outside the family.

`RELATED_TITLE` is not silently relabeled as exact.

`ADJACENT_ROLE` is optional recall support and must remain visibly distinct.

`CUSTOM_ROLE` is preserved as entered and is not matched to a family unless taxonomy is explicitly updated.

---

# 9. COUNTRY AND REGION RESOLUTION

## 9.1 Country normalization

```javascript
function normalizeCountry(rawCountry) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawCountry);
  const text = normalizeString(rawCountry);
  const key = normalizeKey(text);

  if (!key) {
    return {
      raw: raw,
      normalized: text,
      canonical: null,
      resolved: false,
      reason: 'COUNTRY_EMPTY'
    };
  }

  for (const [canonical, model] of Object.entries(COUNTRY_MODEL)) {
    const aliases = [canonical].concat(model.terms || []);
    if (aliases.some(term => normalizeKey(term) === key)) {
      return {
        raw: raw,
        normalized: text,
        canonical: canonical,
        resolved: true,
        reason: 'COUNTRY_RESOLVED'
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    raw: raw,
    normalized: text,
    canonical: null,
    resolved: false,
    reason: 'COUNTRY_UNRESOLVED'
  };
}
```

## 9.2 Region normalization

```javascript
function normalizeRegion(rawRegion) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawRegion);
  const text = normalizeString(rawRegion);
  const key = normalizeKey(text);

  if (!key) {
    return {
      raw: raw,
      normalized: text,
      canonical: null,
      resolved: false,
      reason: 'REGION_EMPTY'
    };
  }

  for (const [canonical, model] of Object.entries(REGION_MODEL)) {
    const aliases = [canonical].concat(model.terms || []);
    if (aliases.some(term => normalizeKey(term) === key)) {
      return {
        raw: raw,
        normalized: text,
        canonical: canonical,
        resolved: true,
        reason: 'REGION_RESOLVED'
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    raw: raw,
    normalized: text,
    canonical: null,
    resolved: false,
    reason: 'REGION_UNRESOLVED'
  };
}
```

## 9.3 Multiple regions

All region inputs are resolved independently.

Example:

```javascript
regions: ['Africa', 'EMEA', 'APAC']
```

must produce three region resolutions and three separate region strategies, subject to deterministic de-duplication.

The engine must **not** keep only the first region.

## 9.4 Unresolved geography

Unresolved geography is never converted into `Worldwide` as a fallback.

Instead:

```javascript
{
  raw: 'Some Custom Region',
  canonical: null,
  resolved: false,
  reason: 'REGION_UNRESOLVED'
}
```

is retained in `geographyResolution.unresolvedRegions` and a validation warning is emitted.

If there is no usable country or region, the engine may still create a discovery plan using explicitly requested global or remote semantics, but it must label the plan accordingly and must not claim country eligibility.

---

# 10. GEOGRAPHY RESOLUTION MODEL

The plan contains both the user's profile geography and the target discovery geography.

Example:

```javascript
{
  userCountry: {
    raw: 'Nigeria',
    canonical: 'Nigeria',
    resolved: true
  },
  targetCountries: {
    source: 'EXPLICIT',
    raw: ['Nigeria'],
    canonical: ['Nigeria'],
    unresolved: []
  },
  regions: {
    raw: ['Africa', 'EMEA'],
    canonical: ['Africa', 'EMEA'],
    unresolved: []
  },
  allowWorldwide: false,
  targetCountriesSource: 'EXPLICIT'
}
```

When `targetCountries` is omitted:

```javascript
{
  targetCountriesSource: 'DEFAULTED_FROM_USER_COUNTRY'
}
```

This distinction is important because a future user may live in Nigeria but intentionally search for Europe or North America opportunities.

---

# 11. RETRIEVAL CONTEXT

The strategy generator should not force G3 to infer every downstream retrieval requirement from free text.

The final plan includes:

```javascript
retrievalContext: {
  requestedFreshnessDays,
  sourceClasses,
  atsEndpointMode,
  googleDiscoveryAllowed,
  canonicalIdAllowedInGoogleQuery,
  verificationRequiredDownstream,
  eligibilityRequiredDownstream,
  applicationAutomation: 'PROHIBITED'
}
```

## 11.1 Frozen ATS mode

```javascript
const ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE = 'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API';
```

G2 does not pretend to call those APIs. It tells G3 that ATS strategies are intended for public job-posting endpoints.

## 11.2 Source classes

The plan may reference:

- `GOOGLE_SEARCH`
- `GREENHOUSE`
- `LEVER`
- `ASHBY`

The earlier G2.1 QA correction explicitly restored Ashby to the structured source strategy set.

## 11.3 Google query identifier rule

Canonical internal identifiers such as `PLAN-*`, `ROLE-*`, or database IDs must not be inserted into Google queries.

A Google query should contain discoverable terms, not private or internal IDs.

---

# 12. GOOGLE QUERY CONSTRUCTION

The query builder must treat query text as a rendered view over structured intent.

```javascript
function quoteIfNeeded(value) {
  const text = normalizeString(value);
  if (!text) return '';
  if (/^".*"$/.test(text)) return text;
  if (/\s/.test(text)) return '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '') + '"';
  return text;
}

function buildRoleClause(roleTerms) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(roleTerms);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildGeographyClause(geographyTerms) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(geographyTerms);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildRemoteClause(remotePreference) {
  const remote = normalizeString(remotePreference);

  if (remote === 'Fully Remote') {
    return '(remote OR "work from anywhere" OR "work remotely")';
  }

  if (remote === 'Remote-First') {
    return '(remote-first OR remote)';
  }

  if (remote === 'Hybrid') {
    return '(hybrid OR remote)';
  }

  if (remote === 'On-site') {
    return '(on-site OR onsite)';
  }

  return '';
}

function buildExclusionClause(exclusions) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(exclusions);
  if (!terms.length) return '';

  return terms
    .map(term => '-' + quoteIfNeeded(term))
    .join(' ');
}

function buildKeywordClause(keywords) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(keywords);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildSiteClause(domains) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(domains);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return 'site:' + terms[0];
  return '(' + terms.map(d => 'site:' + d).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildGoogleQuery(options) {
  const parts = [];

  const roleClause = buildRoleClause(options.roleTerms || []);
  const geoClause = buildGeographyClause(options.geographyTerms || []);
  const remoteClause = buildRemoteClause(options.remotePreference || '');
  const keywordClause = buildKeywordClause(options.keywords || []);
  const exclusionClause = buildExclusionClause(options.exclusions || []);
  const siteClause = buildSiteClause(options.siteDomains || []);

  if (roleClause) parts.push(roleClause);
  if (geoClause) parts.push(geoClause);
  if (remoteClause) parts.push(remoteClause);
  if (keywordClause) parts.push(keywordClause);
  if (exclusionClause) parts.push(exclusionClause);
  if (siteClause) parts.push(siteClause);

  return parts.join(' ').trim();
}
```

## 12.1 Important syntax rule

Correct:

```text
site:greenhouse.io
site:lever.co
site:ashbyhq.com
```

Incorrect:

```text
site:://greenhouse.io
site://lever.co
```

The engine must contain a regression test for malformed `site:` syntax.

---

# 13. SOURCE STRATEGIES

The final G2 plan uses explicit strategy IDs and exact composition.

## 13.1 Strategy types

### Strategy A — `EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY`

High precision. Exact canonical/current title plus a target country.

### Strategy B — `EXACT_ROLE_REGION`

One strategy per resolved target region.

### Strategy C — `FAMILY_COUNTRY`

Controlled family expansion against country when family resolution provides additional titles.

### Strategy D — `SKILLS_LED`

Skills-led discovery when useful keywords are supplied.

### Strategy E — `ATS_API`

One structured ATS strategy per supported ATS source.

### Strategy F — `UNRESOLVED_DISCOVERY`

Fail-safe discovery path when there is insufficient resolved geography/role information but a discoverable input remains.

The exact strategy count is deterministic for a given input.

---

# 14. STRATEGY SCHEMA

Every strategy must pass the same invariant schema.

```javascript
function buildStrategyBase(options) {
  return {
    id: options.id,
    kind: options.kind,
    purpose: options.purpose,
    sourceType: options.sourceType,
    role: options.role,
    roleResolution: options.roleResolution,
    geography: options.geography,
    remote: options.remote,
    employmentType: options.employmentType,
    keywords: options.keywords,
    exclusions: options.exclusions,
    freshnessDays: options.freshnessDays,
    retrieval: options.retrieval,
    query: options.query,
    enabled: options.enabled !== false,
    signature: options.signature
  };
}
```

## 14.1 Strategy schema invariant

The following keys are mandatory for **every** strategy:

```text
id
kind
purpose
sourceType
role
roleResolution
geography
remote
employmentType
keywords
exclusions
freshnessDays
retrieval
query
enabled
signature
```

The test suite must fail if any required key is missing.

---

# 15. STRATEGY SIGNATURES

Duplicate strategies are not acceptable even if their IDs differ.

A strategy signature is a stable normalized identity built from semantic components.

```javascript
function makeStrategySignature(parts) {
  return [
    parts.kind || '',
    parts.sourceType || '',
    normalizeString(parts.role || ''),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.roleTerms || [])),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.geographyTerms || [])),
    normalizeString(parts.remote || ''),
    normalizeString(parts.employmentType || ''),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.keywords || [])),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.exclusions || [])),
    String(parts.freshnessDays || '')
  ].join('|').toLowerCase();
}
```

The final plan must contain no duplicate `signature` values.

This specifically implements the G2.1 QA requirement that duplicate-strategy signatures fail rather than being silently tolerated.

const ATS_SOURCES = [

];

function cloneRawValue(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.slice();
  if (value && typeof value === 'object') return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  return value;
}

function splitRawToItems(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map(v => String(v).trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return value.split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return [];
  return [String(value).trim()].filter(Boolean);
}

function normalizeString(value) {
  return String(value === undefined || value === null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function normalizeKey(value) {
  return normalizeString(value).toLowerCase();
}

function normalizeStringArray(value) {
  const items = splitRawToItems(value);
  const seen = new Set();
  const out = [];
  items.forEach(item => {
    const clean = normalizeString(item);
    const key = clean.toLowerCase();
    if (!clean || seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push(clean);
  });
  return out;
}

function normalizeFreshnessDays(value, defaultValue) {
  const fallback = defaultValue || 7;
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
    return { value: fallback, valid: true, reason: 'DEFAULTED' };
  }
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) {
    return { value: null, valid: false, reason: 'FRESHNESS_NOT_NUMERIC' };
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(n)) {
    return { value: null, valid: false, reason: 'FRESHNESS_NOT_INTEGER' };
  }
  if (n < 1 || n > 90) {
    return { value: null, valid: false, reason: 'FRESHNESS_OUT_OF_RANGE_1_TO_90' };
  }
  return { value: n, valid: true, reason: 'VALID' };
}

function resolveRole(rawRole) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawRole);
  const normalized = normalizeString(rawRole);
  const key = normalizeKey(normalized);

  if (!key) {
    return {
      tier: 'EMPTY', family: null, canonicalRole: null, raw: raw,
      normalized: normalized, exactTitles: [], relatedTitles: [], adjacentRoles: [],
      reason: 'ROLE_EMPTY'
    };
  }

  const families = Object.keys(ROLE_TAXONOMY);

  for (const family of families) {
    if (normalizeKey(family) === key) {
      const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
      return {
        tier: 'FAMILY', family: family, canonicalRole: family, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_FAMILY'
      };
    }
  }

  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.exact.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'EXACT_TITLE', family: family, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_EXACT_TITLE'
      };
    }
  }

  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.related.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'RELATED_TITLE', family: family, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_RELATED_TITLE'
      };
    }
  }

  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.adjacent.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'ADJACENT_ROLE', family: family, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_ADJACENT_ROLE'
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    tier: 'CUSTOM_ROLE', family: null, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
    normalized: normalized, exactTitles: [normalized], relatedTitles: [],
    adjacentRoles: [], reason: 'ROLE_TREATED_AS_CUSTOM_ROLE'
  };
}

function normalizeCountry(rawCountry) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawCountry);
  const text = normalizeString(rawCountry);
  const key = normalizeKey(text);

  if (!key) {
    return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'COUNTRY_EMPTY' };
  }

  for (const [canonical, model] of Object.entries(COUNTRY_MODEL)) {
    const aliases = [canonical].concat(model.terms || []);
    if (aliases.some(term => normalizeKey(term) === key)) {
      return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: canonical, resolved: true, reason: 'COUNTRY_RESOLVED' };
    }
  }

  return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'COUNTRY_UNRESOLVED' };
}

function normalizeRegion(rawRegion) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawRegion);
  const text = normalizeString(rawRegion);
  const key = normalizeKey(text);

  if (!key) {
    return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'REGION_EMPTY' };
  }

  for (const [canonical, model] of Object.entries(REGION_MODEL)) {
    const aliases = [canonical].concat(model.terms || []);
    if (aliases.some(term => normalizeKey(term) === key)) {
      return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: canonical, resolved: true, reason: 'REGION_RESOLVED' };
    }
  }

  return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'REGION_UNRESOLVED' };
}

function quoteIfNeeded(value) {
  const text = normalizeString(value);
  if (!text) return '';
  if (/^".*"$/.test(text)) return text;
  if (/\s/.test(text)) return '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '') + '"';
  return text;
}

function buildRoleClause(roleTerms) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(roleTerms);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildGeographyClause(geographyTerms) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(geographyTerms);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildRemoteClause(remotePreference) {
  const remote = normalizeString(remotePreference);
  if (remote === 'Fully Remote') return '(remote OR "work from anywhere" OR "work remotely")';
  if (remote === 'Remote-First') return '(remote-first OR remote)';
  if (remote === 'Hybrid') return '(hybrid OR remote)';
  if (remote === 'On-site') return '(on-site OR onsite)';
  return '';
}

function buildExclusionClause(exclusions) {
  return normalizeStringArray(exclusions).map(term => '-' + quoteIfNeeded(term)).join(' ');
}

function buildKeywordClause(keywords) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(keywords);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildSiteClause(domains) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(domains);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return 'site:' + terms[0];
  return '(' + terms.map(d => 'site:' + d).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildGoogleQuery(options) {
  const parts = [];
  const roleClause = buildRoleClause(options.roleTerms || []);
  const geoClause = buildGeographyClause(options.geographyTerms || []);
  const remoteClause = buildRemoteClause(options.remotePreference || '');
  const keywordClause = buildKeywordClause(options.keywords || []);
  const exclusionClause = buildExclusionClause(options.exclusions || []);
  const siteClause = buildSiteClause(options.siteDomains || []);

  if (roleClause) parts.push(roleClause);
  if (geoClause) parts.push(geoClause);
  if (remoteClause) parts.push(remoteClause);
  if (keywordClause) parts.push(keywordClause);
  if (exclusionClause) parts.push(exclusionClause);
  if (siteClause) parts.push(siteClause);

  return parts.join(' ').trim();
}

function makeStrategySignature(parts) {
  return [
    parts.kind || '',
    parts.sourceType || '',
    normalizeString(parts.role || ''),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.roleTerms || [])),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.geographyTerms || [])),
    normalizeString(parts.remote || ''),
    normalizeString(parts.employmentType || ''),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.keywords || [])),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.exclusions || [])),
    String(parts.freshnessDays || '')
  ].join('|').toLowerCase();
}

function buildStrategy(options) {
  return {
    id: options.id,
    kind: options.kind,
    purpose: options.purpose,
    sourceType: options.sourceType,
    role: options.role,
    roleResolution: options.roleResolution,
    geography: options.geography,
    remote: options.remote,
    employmentType: options.employmentType,
    keywords: options.keywords,
    exclusions: options.exclusions,
    freshnessDays: options.freshnessDays,
    retrieval: options.retrieval,
    query: options.query,
    enabled: options.enabled !== false,
    signature: options.signature
  };
}

function validateStrategySchema(strategy) {
  const required = [
    'id', 'kind', 'purpose', 'sourceType', 'role', 'roleResolution',
    'geography', 'remote', 'employmentType', 'keywords', 'exclusions',
    'freshnessDays', 'retrieval', 'query', 'enabled', 'signature'
  ];

  const missing = required.filter(key => !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(strategy, key));
  return {
    valid: missing.length === 0,
    missing: missing
  };
}

function resolveTargetCountries(inputs, countryResolution) {
  const rawTarget = cloneRawValue(inputs.targetCountries);
  const items = splitRawToItems(rawTarget);

  if (items.length === 0 && countryResolution.resolved) {
    return {
      source: 'DEFAULTED_FROM_USER_COUNTRY',
      raw: [countryResolution.raw],
      canonical: [countryResolution.canonical],
      unresolved: []
    };
  }

  const canonical = [];
  const unresolved = [];
  const seen = new Set();

  items.forEach(item => {
    const res = normalizeCountry(item);
    if (res.resolved) {
      const key = normalizeKey(res.canonical);
      if (!seen.has(key)) {
        seen.add(key);
        canonical.push(res.canonical);
      }
    } else {
      unresolved.push(res);
    }
  });

  return {
    source: items.length ? 'EXPLICIT' : 'NONE',
    raw: rawTarget,
    canonical: canonical,
    unresolved: unresolved
  };
}

function buildGeographyResolution(inputs, countryResolution) {
  const regionRaw = cloneRawValue(inputs.regions);
  const regionItems = splitRawToItems(regionRaw);
  const regionCanonical = [];
  const unresolvedRegions = [];
  const regionSeen = new Set();

  regionItems.forEach(item => {
    const res = normalizeRegion(item);
    if (res.resolved) {
      const key = normalizeKey(res.canonical);
      if (!regionSeen.has(key)) {
        regionSeen.add(key);
        regionCanonical.push(res.canonical);
      }
    } else {
      unresolvedRegions.push(res);
    }
  });

  const targetCountries = resolveTargetCountries(inputs, countryResolution);

  return {
    userCountry: countryResolution,
    targetCountries: targetCountries,
    regions: {
      raw: regionRaw,
      canonical: regionCanonical,
      unresolved: unresolvedRegions
    },
    allowWorldwide: inputs.allowWorldwide === true,
    remoteDoesNotExpandGeography: true,
    targetCountriesSource: targetCountries.source
  };
}

function targetCountryTerms(country) {
  const model = COUNTRY_MODEL[country];
  return model ? [model.label].concat(model.terms || []) : [country];
}

function regionTerms(region) {
  const model = REGION_MODEL[region];
  return model ? model.terms.slice() : [region];
}

function makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution) {
  const role = roleResolution.canonicalRole;
  return role ? [role] : [];
}

function makeFamilyTerms(roleResolution) {
  const terms = [];
  terms.push.apply(terms, roleResolution.exactTitles || []);
  terms.push.apply(terms, roleResolution.relatedTitles || []);
  return normalizeStringArray(terms);
}

function makeSkillsTerms(keywords) {
  return normalizeStringArray(keywords);
}

function createCommonRetrieval(sourceType) {
  if (sourceType === 'GOOGLE') {
    return {
      mode: 'GOOGLE_SEARCH',
      endpointMode: null,
      directApiCall: false
    };
  }

  return {
    mode: 'ATS_API',
    endpointMode: QUERY_ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE,
    directApiCall: false
  };
}

function strategySignatureFor(strategyParts) {
  const roleTerms = strategyParts.roleTerms || (
    strategyParts.roleResolution && strategyParts.roleResolution.exactTitles
      ? [strategyParts.role]
      : []
  );
  const geographyTerms = strategyParts.geographyTerms || (
    strategyParts.geography && Array.isArray(strategyParts.geography.terms)
      ? strategyParts.geography.terms
      : []
  );

  return makeStrategySignature(Object.assign({}, strategyParts, {
    roleTerms: roleTerms,
    geographyTerms: geographyTerms
  }));
}

function generateQueryPlan(inputs) {
  inputs = inputs || {};

  const rawRole = cloneRawValue(inputs.role);
  const rawCountry = cloneRawValue(inputs.country);
  const rawTargetCountries = cloneRawValue(inputs.targetCountries);
  const rawRegions = cloneRawValue(inputs.regions);
  const rawKeywords = cloneRawValue(inputs.keywords);
  const rawExclusions = cloneRawValue(inputs.exclusions);
  const rawEmploymentType = cloneRawValue(inputs.employmentType);
  const rawRemotePreference = cloneRawValue(inputs.remotePreference);
  const rawWorkAuthorization = cloneRawValue(inputs.workAuthorization);
  const rawTimezone = cloneRawValue(inputs.timezone);
  const rawMode = cloneRawValue(inputs.mode);

  const roleResolution = resolveRole(rawRole);
  const countryResolution = normalizeCountry(rawCountry);
  const geographyResolution = buildGeographyResolution(inputs, countryResolution);

  const role = roleResolution.canonicalRole;
  const remotePreference = normalizeString(rawRemotePreference) || 'Fully Remote';
  const employmentType = normalizeString(rawEmploymentType);
  const keywords = normalizeStringArray(rawKeywords);
  const exclusions = normalizeStringArray(rawExclusions);
  const freshness = normalizeFreshnessDays(inputs.freshnessDays, 7);

  const validationErrors = [];
  const validationWarnings = [];

  if (!roleResolution.canonicalRole) {
    validationErrors.push({ code: 'ROLE_REQUIRED', message: 'Role is required.' });
  }

  if (!REMOTE_TYPES[remotePreference]) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: 'INVALID_REMOTE_PREFERENCE',
      message: 'Remote preference must be one of the supported remote types.'
    });
  }

  if (!freshness.valid) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: freshness.reason,
      message: 'Freshness input is invalid.'
    });
  }

  if (!countryResolution.resolved && geographyResolution.targetCountries.canonical.length === 0) {
    validationWarnings.push({
      code: 'COUNTRY_UNRESOLVED',
      message: 'User country could not be resolved; no country target strategy will be created from it.'
    });
  }

  if (geographyResolution.regions.unresolved.length) {
    validationWarnings.push({
      code: 'REGION_UNRESOLVED',
      message: 'One or more region inputs could not be resolved and were not converted to Worldwide.'
    });
  }

  if (inputs.allowWorldwide === true && !REMOTE_TYPES[remotePreference]) {
    validationWarnings.push({
      code: 'WORLDWIDE_WITH_INVALID_REMOTE',
      message: 'Worldwide was explicitly requested, but remote preference is invalid.'
    });
  }

  const strategies = [];

  function addStrategy(options) {
    const signature = strategySignatureFor(options);
    const strategy = buildStrategy(Object.assign({}, options, { signature: signature }));
    const schemaResult = validateStrategySchema(strategy);
    if (!schemaResult.valid) {
      validationErrors.push({
        code: 'INVALID_STRATEGY_SCHEMA',
        strategyId: strategy.id,
        missing: schemaResult.missing
      });
      return;
    }
    strategies.push(strategy);
  }

  const countryTargets = geographyResolution.targetCountries.canonical;
  const regionTargets = geographyResolution.regions.canonical;

  // 1. EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY — one per country target.
  countryTargets.forEach(country => {
    const geoTerms = targetCountryTerms(country);
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const parts = {
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: [country],
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY_' + normalizeKey(country).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_'),
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY',
      purpose: 'High-precision discovery using the resolved role and target country.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: {
        type: 'country',
        country: country,
        terms: geoTerms,
        status: 'RESOLVED'
      },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: geoTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  });

  // 2. EXACT_ROLE_REGION — exactly one per resolved region.
  regionTargets.forEach(region => {
    const geoTerms = regionTerms(region);
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const parts = {
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_REGION',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: geoTerms,
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'EXACT_ROLE_REGION_' + normalizeKey(region).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_'),
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_REGION',
      purpose: 'Broader regional discovery using the resolved role and one explicit target region.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: {
        type: REGION_MODEL[region].type,
        region: region,
        terms: geoTerms,
        status: 'RESOLVED'
      },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: geoTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  });

  // 3. FAMILY_COUNTRY — only when a controlled family has extra terms.
  if (roleResolution.family && makeFamilyTerms(roleResolution).length > 1 && countryTargets.length) {
    countryTargets.forEach(country => {
      const familyTerms = makeFamilyTerms(roleResolution);
      const geoTerms = targetCountryTerms(country);
      const options = {
        kind: 'FAMILY_COUNTRY',
        sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
        role: roleResolution.family,
        roleTerms: familyTerms,
        geographyTerms: [country],
        remote: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        freshnessDays: freshness.value
      };

      addStrategy({
        id: 'FAMILY_COUNTRY_' + normalizeKey(country).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_'),
        kind: 'FAMILY_COUNTRY',
        purpose: 'Controlled recall expansion across the selected role family.',
        sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
        role: roleResolution.family,
        roleResolution: roleResolution,
        geography: { type: 'country', country: country, terms: geoTerms, status: 'RESOLVED' },
        remote: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        freshnessDays: freshness.value,
        retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
        query: buildGoogleQuery({
          roleTerms: familyTerms,
          geographyTerms: geoTerms,
          remotePreference: remotePreference,
          employmentType: employmentType,
          keywords: keywords,
          exclusions: exclusions,
          siteDomains: []
        }),
        enabled: true,
        signature: null
      });
    });
  }

  // 4. SKILLS_LED — only when meaningful keywords exist and a country target exists.
  if (keywords.length && countryTargets.length) {
    const country = countryTargets[0];
    const geoTerms = targetCountryTerms(country);
    const options = {
      kind: 'SKILLS_LED',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: null,
      roleTerms: [],
      geographyTerms: [country],
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'SKILLS_LED',
      kind: 'SKILLS_LED',
      purpose: 'Discovery led primarily by user skills and tools rather than title.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: null,
      roleResolution: { tier: 'SKILLS_ONLY', family: null, canonicalRole: null },
      geography: { type: 'country', country: country, terms: geoTerms, status: 'RESOLVED' },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: [],
        geographyTerms: geoTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  }

  // 5. ATS_API — exactly one strategy per ATS source.
  ATS_SOURCES.forEach(ats => {
    const baseRoleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const geoTerms = countryTargets.length ? targetCountryTerms(countryTargets[0]) : [];
    const options = {
      kind: 'ATS_API',
      sourceType: ats.sourceType,
      role: role,
      roleTerms: baseRoleTerms,
      geographyTerms: geoTerms,
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'ATS_API_' + ats.id,
      kind: 'ATS_API',
      purpose: 'Structured source strategy for ' + ats.id + ' public job postings.',
      sourceType: ats.sourceType,
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: {
        type: countryTargets.length ? 'country' : 'unresolved',
        country: countryTargets.length ? countryTargets[0] : null,
        terms: geoTerms,
        status: countryTargets.length ? 'RESOLVED' : 'UNRESOLVED'
      },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: {
        mode: 'ATS_API',
        endpointMode: QUERY_ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE,
        provider: ats.id,
        domain: ats.domain,
        directApiCall: false
      },
      query: '',
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  });

  // 6. WORLDWIDE — only when explicitly allowed.
  if (inputs.allowWorldwide === true) {
    const worldTerms = REGION_MODEL.Worldwide.terms.slice();
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const options = {
      kind: 'WORLDWIDE',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: worldTerms,
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'WORLDWIDE_EXPLICIT',
      kind: 'WORLDWIDE',
      purpose: 'Explicitly requested worldwide discovery; not inferred from remote preference.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: { type: 'global', region: 'Worldwide', terms: worldTerms, status: 'EXPLICIT' },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: worldTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  }

  // 7. Safe unresolved discovery path.
  if (roleResolution.canonicalRole && !countryTargets.length && !regionTargets.length && inputs.allowWorldwide !== true) {
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const options = {
      kind: 'UNRESOLVED_DISCOVERY',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: [],
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'UNRESOLVED_DISCOVERY',
      kind: 'UNRESOLVED_DISCOVERY',
      purpose: 'Fail-safe discovery when no country or region resolved; no geography is invented.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: { type: 'unresolved', country: null, region: null, terms: [], status: 'UNRESOLVED' },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: [],
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  }

  // Post-generation invariant checks.
  const strategySignatures = strategies.map(s => s.signature);
  const duplicateSignatures = strategySignatures.filter((sig, i) => strategySignatures.indexOf(sig) !== i);
  if (duplicateSignatures.length) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: 'DUPLICATE_STRATEGY_SIGNATURE',
      signatures: Array.from(new Set(duplicateSignatures))
    });
  }

  strategies.forEach(strategy => {
    const schema = validateStrategySchema(strategy);
    if (!schema.valid) {
      validationErrors.push({
        code: 'INVALID_STRATEGY_SCHEMA',
        strategyId: strategy.id,
        missing: schema.missing
      });
    }
  });

  // Canonical role must be present at the plan level whenever a role resolves.
  const canonicalRoleInvariant = !roleResolution.canonicalRole || (
    roleResolution.canonicalRole === role
  );

  if (!canonicalRoleInvariant) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: 'CANONICAL_ROLE_MISMATCH',
      message: 'Plan-level role does not match the canonical role resolver output.'
    });
  }

  const plan = {
    schemaVersion: QUERY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    taxonomyVersion: QUERY_TAXONOMY_VERSION,
    geographyVersion: QUERY_GEOGRAPHY_VERSION,
    planId: 'PLAN-' + new Date().getTime(),
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    generatedBy: 'QueryEngine.gs',
    compatibleWith: ['G3'],
    status: validationErrors.length ? 'INVALID' : 'VALID',
    executable: validationErrors.length === 0 && strategies.length > 0,
    userIntent: {
      raw: {
        role: rawRole,
        country: rawCountry,
        targetCountries: rawTargetCountries,
        regions: rawRegions,
        remotePreference: rawRemotePreference,
        employmentType: rawEmploymentType,
        keywords: rawKeywords,
        exclusions: rawExclusions,
        freshnessDays: inputs.freshnessDays,
        allowWorldwide: inputs.allowWorldwide,
        preferredRegions: cloneRawValue(inputs.preferredRegions),
        workAuthorization: rawWorkAuthorization,
        timezone: rawTimezone,
        mode: rawMode
      },
      canonical: {
        role: role,
        roleResolution: roleResolution,
        country: countryResolution.canonical,
        targetCountries: geographyResolution.targetCountries.canonical,
        regions: geographyResolution.regions.canonical,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        freshnessDays: freshness.value,
        allowWorldwide: inputs.allowWorldwide === true,
        workAuthorization: normalizeString(rawWorkAuthorization),
        timezone: normalizeString(rawTimezone),
        mode: normalizeString(rawMode)
      }
    },
    retrievalContext: {
      requestedFreshnessDays: freshness.value,
      freshnessResolution: freshness,
      sourceClasses: ['GOOGLE_SEARCH', 'GREENHOUSE', 'LEVER', 'ASHBY'],
      atsEndpointMode: QUERY_ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE,
      googleDiscoveryAllowed: true,
      canonicalIdAllowedInGoogleQuery: false,
      verificationRequiredDownstream: true,
      eligibilityRequiredDownstream: true,
      applicationAutomation: 'PROHIBITED'
    },
    geographyResolution: geographyResolution,
    strategies: strategies,
    totalStrategies: strategies.length,
    validation: {
      errors: validationErrors,
      warnings: validationWarnings,
      executionPolicy: {
        failClosedOnErrors: true,
        allowInvalidPlanExecution: false,
        allowWorldwideOnlyWhenExplicit: true,
        unresolvedGeographyMayNotBecomeWorldwide: true,
        noAutomaticJobApplication: true
      }
    }
  };

  return plan;
}

// Backward-compatible function name retained for callers that already use it.
function buildQueryPlan(inputs) {
  return generateQueryPlan(inputs);
}
```

---

# 18. QA PATCHES INCLUDED IN THE FINAL MODULE

This final module directly incorporates the remaining QA points without redesigning the architecture.

## Patch 1 — Canonical role invariant

The final plan explicitly carries:

```javascript
userIntent.canonical.role
```

and a regression test verifies that it equals the role resolver output.

## Patch 2 — Generic strategy-schema invariant

Every strategy is validated against one common mandatory-key list.

A new strategy that forgets one field will fail the suite.

## Patch 3 — Duplicate strategy signatures

Strategy IDs alone are insufficient. Semantic signatures are generated and duplicated signatures invalidate the plan.

## Patch 4 — Exact region strategy count

Each resolved input region maps to one `EXACT_ROLE_REGION` strategy. The test suite compares the number of region strategies against the resolved canonical region count.

## Patch 5 — Invalid freshness reasons

Freshness errors are specific:

```text
FRESHNESS_NOT_NUMERIC
FRESHNESS_NOT_INTEGER
FRESHNESS_OUT_OF_RANGE_1_TO_90
```

## Patch 6 — Country vs target opportunity distinction

The plan retains:

- `userIntent.canonical.country`
- `userIntent.canonical.targetCountries`
- `geographyResolution.targetCountriesSource`

The defaulting rule is explicit and auditable.

## Patch 7 — Full retrieval context

The plan includes:

- ATS endpoint mode;
- source class list;
- Google discovery flag;
- downstream verification requirement;
- downstream eligibility requirement;
- application-automation prohibition.

## Patch 8 — No implicit Worldwide fallback

The code contains no branch equivalent to:

```javascript
if (remote === 'Fully Remote') geoTerms.push('Worldwide');
```

Worldwide exists only when:

```javascript
inputs.allowWorldwide === true
```

## Patch 9 — No canonical IDs in Google queries

Internal IDs are retained only as plan metadata and strategy IDs.

## Patch 10 — Unresolved geography remains unresolved

Unknown regions do not become Worldwide.

## Patch 11 — Raw string semantics preserved

Strings remain strings under `userIntent.raw.*`. Arrays remain arrays. Internal normalization is separate.

## Patch 12 — Ashby included in structured ATS strategy coverage

The final set is:

```text
GREENHOUSE
LEVER
ASHBY
```

```javascript
// ============================================================================
// ESE DIGITALS — G2 QUERY INTELLIGENCE — QA / REGRESSION TESTS
// ============================================================================

function assertTrue(condition, message) {
  if (!condition) throw new Error('ASSERTION FAILED: ' + message);
}

function assertEqual(actual, expected, message) {
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(
      'ASSERTION FAILED: ' + message +
      ' | expected=' + JSON.stringify(expected) +
      ' | actual=' + JSON.stringify(actual)
    );
  }
}

function assertIncludes(array, value, message) {
  assertTrue(Array.isArray(array), message + ' | not an array');
  assertTrue(array.indexOf(value) >= 0, message + ' | missing=' + value);
}

function countBy(array, predicate) {
  return array.filter(predicate).length;
}

function baseTestInput() {
  return {
    role: 'Operations Specialist',
    country: 'Nigeria',
    remotePreference: 'Fully Remote',
    regions: ['Africa', 'EMEA'],
    keywords: ['Excel', 'Automation'],
    exclusions: ['US-only', 'Canada-only', 'UK-only'],
    freshnessDays: 7,
    allowWorldwide: false,
    employmentType: 'Full-time',
    preferredRegions: ['Africa', 'EMEA'],
    workAuthorization: 'Nigeria',
    timezone: 'Africa/Lagos',
    mode: 'Balanced'
  };
}

function testRoleResolutionTiers() {
  assertEqual(resolveRole('Operations').tier, 'FAMILY', 'family tier');
  assertEqual(resolveRole('Operations Specialist').tier, 'EXACT_TITLE', 'exact tier');
  assertEqual(resolveRole('Business Operations Specialist').tier, 'RELATED_TITLE', 'related tier');
  assertEqual(resolveRole('Project Coordinator').tier, 'ADJACENT_ROLE', 'adjacent tier');
  assertEqual(resolveRole('My Unlisted Role').tier, 'CUSTOM_ROLE', 'custom tier');
  assertEqual(resolveRole('').tier, 'EMPTY', 'empty tier');
  return 'PASS';
}

function testRawStringPreservation() {
  const input = baseTestInput();
  input.regions = 'Africa, EMEA';
  input.keywords = 'Excel, Automation';

  const plan = generateQueryPlan(input);

  assertEqual(typeof plan.userIntent.raw.regions, 'string', 'raw region string type preserved');
  assertEqual(typeof plan.userIntent.raw.keywords, 'string', 'raw keyword string type preserved');
  assertEqual(plan.userIntent.raw.regions, 'Africa, EMEA', 'raw region value preserved');
  assertEqual(plan.userIntent.raw.keywords, 'Excel, Automation', 'raw keyword value preserved');
  return 'PASS';
}

function testNoWorldwideImplicitly() {
  const input = baseTestInput();
  input.allowWorldwide = false;
  input.regions = ['Africa'];

  const plan = generateQueryPlan(input);

  const worldwide = plan.strategies.filter(s => s.kind === 'WORLDWIDE');
  assertEqual(worldwide.length, 0, 'Worldwide must not be implicit');
  assertTrue(
    plan.strategies.every(s => !String(s.query || '').toLowerCase().includes('worldwide')),
    'Google queries must not inject Worldwide when not requested'
  );
  return 'PASS';
}

function testWorldwideOnlyWhenExplicit() {
  const input = baseTestInput();
  input.allowWorldwide = true;
  const plan = generateQueryPlan(input);
  const worldwide = plan.strategies.filter(s => s.kind === 'WORLDWIDE');
  assertEqual(worldwide.length, 1, 'explicit Worldwide should create one Worldwide strategy');
  return 'PASS';
}

function testMultipleRegionsProduceExactCount() {
  const input = baseTestInput();
  input.regions = ['Africa', 'EMEA', 'APAC'];

  const plan = generateQueryPlan(input);
  const exactRegionStrategies = plan.strategies.filter(s => s.kind === 'EXACT_ROLE_REGION');

  assertEqual(exactRegionStrategies.length, 3, 'one exact region strategy per resolved region');
  assertIncludes(exactRegionStrategies.map(s => s.geography.region), 'Africa', 'Africa region strategy');
  assertIncludes(exactRegionStrategies.map(s => s.geography.region), 'EMEA', 'EMEA region strategy');
  assertIncludes(exactRegionStrategies.map(s => s.geography.region), 'APAC', 'APAC region strategy');
  return 'PASS';
}

function testUnresolvedRegionDoesNotBecomeWorldwide() {
  const input = baseTestInput();
  input.regions = ['Africa', 'Not-A-Real-Region'];
  input.allowWorldwide = false;

  const plan = generateQueryPlan(input);

  assertEqual(plan.geographyResolution.regions.canonical.length, 1, 'only one region resolves');
  assertEqual(plan.geographyResolution.regions.unresolved.length, 1, 'one region remains unresolved');
  assertIncludes(
    plan.validation.warnings.map(w => w.code),
    'REGION_UNRESOLVED',
    'unresolved-region warning'
  );
  assertEqual(
    plan.strategies.filter(s => s.kind === 'WORLDWIDE').length,
    0,
    'unresolved region must not become Worldwide'
  );
  return 'PASS';
}

function testCountryTargetDistinction() {
  const input = baseTestInput();
  input.country = 'Nigeria';
  input.targetCountries = ['Germany'];

  const plan = generateQueryPlan(input);

  assertEqual(plan.userIntent.canonical.country, 'Nigeria', 'user country must remain Nigeria');
  assertEqual(plan.userIntent.canonical.targetCountries.length, 1, 'one target country');
  assertEqual(plan.userIntent.canonical.targetCountries[0], 'Germany', 'target country should be Germany');
  assertEqual(plan.geographyResolution.targetCountriesSource, 'EXPLICIT', 'source should be explicit');
  assertEqual(

  );

function testDefaultTargetCountryFromUserCountry() {

  delete input.targetCountries;

  assertEqual(plan.userIntent.canonical.country, 'Nigeria', 'user country');
  assertEqual(plan.userIntent.canonical.targetCountries[0], 'Nigeria', 'default target country');

function testFreshnessInvalidReasons() {
  const cases = [
    { value: 'abc', reason: 'FRESHNESS_NOT_NUMERIC' },
    { value: 7.5, reason: 'FRESHNESS_NOT_INTEGER' },
    { value: 0, reason: 'FRESHNESS_OUT_OF_RANGE_1_TO_90' },

  const tests = [
    testRoleResolutionTiers,
    testRawStringPreservation,
    testNoWorldwideImplicitly,
    testWorldwideOnlyWhenExplicit,
    testMultipleRegionsProduceExactCount,
    testUnresolvedRegionDoesNotBecomeWorldwide,
    testCountryTargetDistinction,
    testDefaultTargetCountryFromUserCountry,
    testFreshnessInvalidReasons,
    testFreshnessValid,
    testAllStrategiesShareSchema,
    testNoDuplicateStrategySignatures,
    testPlanCanonicalRoleInvariant,
    testSiteSyntax,
    testAshbyStrategyPresent,
    testGoogleQueriesDoNotContainCanonicalIDs,
    testRemoteDoesNotCreateWorldwide,
    testNoSkillsMeansNoSkillsLed,
    testInvalidRemoteFailsClosed,
    testApplicationAutomationProhibited,
    testStructuredRetrievalContext,
    testProductionLikePlan
  ];

  const results = [];
  let failures = 0;

  tests.forEach(testFn => {
    try {
      const result = testFn();
      results.push({ test: testFn.name, status: result });
      Logger.log('PASS: ' + testFn.name);
    } catch (error) {
      failures++;
      results.push({
        test: testFn.name,
        status: 'FAIL',
        error: String(error && error.stack ? error.stack : error)
      });
      Logger.log('FAIL: ' + testFn.name + ' :: ' + String(error));
    }
  });

  Logger.log('==============================================');
  Logger.log('G2 QUERY INTELLIGENCE QA SUITE');
  Logger.log('Tests: ' + tests.length);
  Logger.log('Failures: ' + failures);
  Logger.log('Status: ' + (failures === 0 ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'));
  Logger.log('==============================================');

  if (failures > 0) {
    throw new Error('G2 QA SUITE FAILED: ' + failures + ' test(s) failed.');
  }

  return {
    status: 'PASS',
    testsRun: tests.length,
    failures: 0,
    results: results
  };
}

function testQueryEngine() {
  return runQueryEngineQASuite();
}

# 20. WHY THIS TEST SUITE IS DIFFERENT FROM THE ORIGINAL G2 TEST

The original G2 draft relied mainly on a single sample execution and log inspection. That is not sufficient for the frozen architecture.

The final suite checks behavior and invariants, including:

```text
Role resolution tiers
Raw-value preservation
No implicit Worldwide
Explicit Worldwide
Multiple regions
Unresolved geography
User country vs target country
Default target country traceability
Invalid freshness reasons
Valid freshness
Common strategy schema
Duplicate signatures
Plan canonical role
Google syntax
Ashby inclusion
No private canonical IDs in queries
Remote/worldwide separation
No skills-led strategy without skills
Invalid remote fail-closed behavior
Application automation prohibition
Retrieval context completeness
Production-like plan
```

This is the appropriate level for a gate that feeds G3.

# 21. OPTIONAL `Config.gs` PATCH

The taxonomy can live inside `QueryEngine.gs` as shown above. That is the least ambiguous option for a first implementation.

If the existing project already has a centrally managed `Config.gs`, the constants may instead be moved there, provided that:

1. there is exactly one definition of each constant;
2. the global names remain the same;
3. duplicate constant declarations are not introduced;
4. tests still resolve the same objects;
5. the version values remain stable.

Recommended centralized constants:

```javascript
const QUERY_SCHEMA_VERSION = '2.1';
const QUERY_TAXONOMY_VERSION = '1.0';
const QUERY_GEOGRAPHY_VERSION = '1.0';
const QUERY_ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE = 'PUBLIC_JOB_POSTINGS_API';
```

Do not duplicate those constants in both files.
