### Step 2: Create `GreenhouseAdapter.gs`

In your Apps Script project, add a new file named `GreenhouseAdapter.gs` and paste the code below.

```javascript
// ============================================================================
// ESE DIGITALS — G3 — GREENHOUSE ADAPTER
// Fetches public job postings from a Greenhouse board API.
// ============================================================================

// The board token to use. For a real deployment, you might store this in Config.gs.
// We'll use a well-known public board token for testing; replace with your target.
const GREENHOUSE_BOARD_TOKEN = 'example'; // Example board – change to a real one

/**
 * Main entry point: fetch jobs from Greenhouse using a Query Plan strategy.
 * @param {Object} strategy - A single strategy from the Query Plan (should be kind: 'ATS_API', sourceType: 'GREENHOUSE')
 * @returns {Array} Array of normalized job objects.
 */
function fetchGreenhouseJobs(strategy) {
  if (!strategy || strategy.sourceType !== 'GREENHOUSE') {
    throw new Error('Invalid strategy: not a Greenhouse ATS strategy.');
  }

  const roleTitles = strategy.roleResolution?.exactTitles || [];
  const geography = strategy.geography?.country || strategy.geography?.region || '';

  if (!roleTitles.length) {
    Logger.log('No role titles in Greenhouse strategy – skipping fetch.');
    return [];
  }

  // Build the API URL. Greenhouse boards use /v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs?content=true
  const baseUrl = 'https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/' + GREENHOUSE_BOARD_TOKEN + '/jobs';
  const url = baseUrl + '?content=true';

  try {
    const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {
      method: 'get',
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      muteHttpExceptions: true
    });

    const statusCode = response.getResponseCode();
    if (statusCode !== 200) {
      Logger.log('Greenhouse API error: ' + statusCode + ' – ' + response.getContentText());
      return [];
    }

    const data = JSON.parse(response.getContentText());
    const jobs = data.jobs || [];

    // Filter and normalize
    const normalized = [];
    for (const job of jobs) {
      // Basic filtering: only include jobs whose title matches at least one role title (case-insensitive)
      const title = job.title || '';
      const matchesRole = roleTitles.some(role => title.toLowerCase().includes(role.toLowerCase()));
      if (!matchesRole) continue;

      // Build a normalized job object
      const normalizedJob = {
        Job_ID: 'GH-' + job.id,
        Source_ID: 'SRC-002',
        Source_Type: 'ATS',
        Source_Name: 'Greenhouse',
        Title: title,
        Company: job.company?.name || 'Unknown',
        Department: job.departments?.[0]?.name || '',
        Role_Family: strategy.roleResolution?.family || '',
        Description: job.content || '',
        Location: job.location?.name || '',
        Remote_Type: '', // Not directly available; we can parse from description later
        Eligible_Countries: [], // To be filled from evidence later
        Eligible_Regions: [],
        Excluded_Countries: [],
        Work_Authorization: '',
        Timezone: '',
        Employment_Type: '',
        Salary_Min: null,
        Salary_Max: null,
        Currency: '',
        Posted_Date: job.updated_at ? new Date(job.updated_at) : new Date(),
        Updated_Date: job.updated_at ? new Date(job.updated_at) : new Date(),
        First_Seen: new Date(),
        Last_Verified: new Date(),
        Application_URL: job.absolute_url || '',
        Source_URL: job.absolute_url || '',
        Active: true,
        Eligibility_Status: 'UNCLEAR', // will be determined later
        Eligibility_Reason: '',
        Freshness_Status: 'FRESH', // assume fresh if updated recently
        Verification_Status: 'VERIFIED', // from ATS
        Content_Hash: '',
        Match_Keywords: roleTitles.join(','),
        Created_At: new Date(),
        Updated_At: new Date()
      };

      // Generate a simple content hash for deduplication
      normalizedJob.Content_Hash = Utilities.computeDigest(
        Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.MD5,
        normalizedJob.Title + '|' + normalizedJob.Company + '|' + normalizedJob.Location,
        Utilities.Charset.UTF_8
      ).map(b => ('0' + (b & 0xFF).toString(16)).slice(-2)).join('');

      normalized.push(normalizedJob);
    }

    return normalized;

  } catch (e) {
    Logger.log('Greenhouse fetch error: ' + e.message);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Writes fetched jobs to the JOBS tab, deduplicating by Content_Hash.
 * @param {Array} jobs - Array of normalized job objects.
 * @param {string} planId - Optional plan ID for logging.
 * @returns {number} Number of new jobs added.
 */
function writeJobsToSheet(jobs, planId) {
  if (!jobs || jobs.length === 0) return 0;

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(CONFIG.ssId);
  const jobsSheet = ss.getSheetByName('JOBS');
  if (!jobsSheet) throw new Error('JOBS sheet not found');

  // Get existing hashes to avoid duplicates
  const existingData = jobsSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const existingHashes = new Set();
  // Skip header row (row 1)
  for (let i = 1; i < existingData.length; i++) {
    const row = existingData[i];
    // Assuming Content_Hash is column AJ (index 33 if 0-based? careful)
    // Let's find the header index for Content_Hash.
    const headers = existingData[0];
    const hashCol = headers.indexOf('Content_Hash');
    if (hashCol === -1) {
      // If no hash column, we can't dedupe; just append
      break;
    }
    const hash = row[hashCol];
    if (hash) existingHashes.add(hash);
  }

  let added = 0;
  for (const job of jobs) {
    if (existingHashes.has(job.Content_Hash)) continue;
    // Append new row
    // We need to build an array in the order of the JOBS headers.
    // For simplicity, we'll assume the sheet has all columns defined in the G1 schema.
    // We'll map fields to positions; but to avoid misalignment, we'll use the column names.
    const headers = jobsSheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, jobsSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];
    const rowData = headers.map(header => {
      const mapped = {
        'Job_ID': job.Job_ID,
        'Source_ID': job.Source_ID,
        'Source_Type': job.Source_Type,
        'Source_Name': job.Source_Name,
        'Title': job.Title,
        'Company': job.Company,
        'Department': job.Department,
        'Role_Family': job.Role_Family,
        'Description': job.Description,
        'Location': job.Location,
        'Remote_Type': job.Remote_Type,
        'Eligible_Countries': JSON.stringify(job.Eligible_Countries),
        'Eligible_Regions': JSON.stringify(job.Eligible_Regions),
        'Excluded_Countries': JSON.stringify(job.Excluded_Countries),
        'Work_Authorization': job.Work_Authorization,
        'Timezone': job.Timezone,
        'Employment_Type': job.Employment_Type,
        'Salary_Min': job.Salary_Min,
        'Salary_Max': job.Salary_Max,
        'Currency': job.Currency,
        'Posted_Date': job.Posted_Date,
        'Updated_Date': job.Updated_Date,
        'First_Seen': job.First_Seen,
        'Last_Verified': job.Last_Verified,
        'Application_URL': job.Application_URL,
        'Source_URL': job.Source_URL,
        'Active': job.Active,
        'Eligibility_Status': job.Eligibility_Status,
        'Eligibility_Reason': job.Eligibility_Reason,
        'Freshness_Status': job.Freshness_Status,
        'Verification_Status': job.Verification_Status,
        'Content_Hash': job.Content_Hash,
        'Match_Keywords': job.Match_Keywords,
        'Created_At': job.Created_At,
        'Updated_At': job.Updated_At
      };
      // If header not in map, return empty string
      return mapped[header] !== undefined ? mapped[header] : '';
    });
    jobsSheet.appendRow(rowData);
    added++;
    existingHashes.add(job.Content_Hash);
  }

  // Log the action
  logEvent('GREENHOUSE_FETCH', 'Added ' + added + ' jobs' + (planId ? ' for plan ' + planId : ''), 'INFO');
  return added;
}

/**
 * Full workflow: fetch from Greenhouse using a Query Plan and store results.
 * @param {Object} plan - A full Query Plan from G2.
 * @returns {number} Number of new jobs added.
 */
function processGreenhouseStrategy(plan) {
  // Find the Greenhouse strategy (there should be exactly one)
  const strategies = plan.strategies.filter(s => s.sourceType === 'GREENHOUSE' && s.kind === 'ATS_API');
  if (strategies.length === 0) {
    Logger.log('No Greenhouse strategy found in plan.');
    return 0;
  }

  // Use the first one (or loop if multiple)
  const strategy = strategies[0];
  const jobs = fetchGreenhouseJobs(strategy);
  if (jobs.length === 0) return 0;

  const added = writeJobsToSheet(jobs, plan.planId);
  return added;
}

// Optional: test function to run a sample fetch
function testGreenhouseAdapter() {
  // We need a test plan. We'll reuse the production-like plan from G2.
  // If you have a function to generate it, call it.
  // For standalone testing, you can create a minimal plan.
  const testPlan = {
    strategies: [
      {
        sourceType: 'GREENHOUSE',
        kind: 'ATS_API',
        roleResolution: {
          exactTitles: ['Operations Specialist'],
          family: 'Operations'
        },
        geography: { country: 'Nigeria' }
      }
    ],
    planId: 'TEST-GH-001'
  };
  const result = processGreenhouseStrategy(testPlan);
  Logger.log('Test added ' + result + ' jobs.');
  return result;
}
```

---

### Step 3: Test the adapter

Before integrating with the full G3 pipeline, test the adapter with a real Greenhouse board.

1. **Choose a real board token**. For a public company, you can use `"example"` (but that may have no jobs). Better: use `"lever"`? No, Greenhouse boards have specific tokens. You can find one by searching for "Greenhouse careers page" and looking at the URL pattern: `https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{token}/jobs`. For example, `"gitlab"` works? Not sure. You can start with a known token like `"canva"` or `"notion"`. For testing, I'll use `"example"` but we'll note to change.

2. In Apps Script, from the function dropdown, select `testGreenhouseAdapter` and run it.

3. Check the `JOBS` tab to see if new rows appear. Also check `AUDIT_LOG` for entries.

If no jobs appear, verify the board token and the role titles match.

---

### Step 4: Integrate with G3 (later)

After the adapter works, we will create a G3 master function that:
- Takes a Query Plan.
- Iterates over all strategies.
- For each `ATS_API` strategy, calls the respective adapter (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby).
- For each `SEARCH_ENGINE` strategy, we may implement a Google search adapter later.

But for now, focus on making Greenhouse work.

---

## Your immediate actions

1. **Save the Apps Script version** (as described).
2. **Add the `JOB_SOURCES` row** (Step 1).
3. **Create `GreenhouseAdapter.gs`** and paste the code.
4. **Test the adapter** by running `testGreenhouseAdapter()`.
   - You may need to replace `GREENHOUSE_BOARD_TOKEN` with a real board token. For testing, you can use `"example"` – if it returns no jobs, try `"greenhouse"` or search for a public company.
   - Check the `JOBS` sheet for new entries.
5. If the test succeeds, tell me and we will move to the full G3 pipeline that handles all strategies automatically.

---

## Note on rate limits and API keys

Greenhouse public boards do not require an API key. The endpoint is rate‑limited but generally permissive. For production, you may need to respect rate limits and add retries.

Then we will integrate it into a full G3 orchestrator that processes any Query Plan.

# G9 Architecture Boundaries v1.1

G9 observes and evaluates the public funnel. It does not publish content, edit GitHub, deploy Cloudflare, read private analytics, access payment credentials, or mutate PDE_OS_MASTER.

`UrlFetchApp` is permitted only inside the explicit live-verification function so the evidence boundary remains visible and auditable.

Website surfaces and the LinkedIn distribution asset remain distinct evidence classes. Eligibility/ranking logic remains outside G9.
```

- Homepage
- Engine
- Project

- Internal links

Attention → Landing → Engine Use → Relationship → Next Action.

```markdown
# G9 Decision Rules v1.1

## Surface readiness
Website surfaces (Homepage, Engine, Project, Thinking, Article) require URL + live HTTP success + public-safe status + a usable CTA.

LinkedIn Version is treated as a **distribution content asset**, not as a claim that LinkedIn publication has occurred. It requires content-ready evidence and a LinkedIn reference.

Internal Links requires a live homepage and at least three discovered internal links, or an equivalent linked-map observation.

## Gate decision
`PASS` only when all seven checklist surfaces are ready, internal linking evidence exists, next-action/CTA evidence exists, and no private/publishing/credential mutation occurred.

Missing, non-live, private, URL-less, or content-unready surfaces force `REVIEW_REQUIRED`.

Synthetic unit-test URLs never constitute production evidence.
```

```markdown
# G9 Evidence Model v1.1

Evidence classes:

- `LIVE_PAGE`: HTTP-observed public website surface.
- `CONTENT_ASSET`: prepared LinkedIn distribution version.
- `LINK_MAP`: observed internal linking structure.
- `UNIT_FIXTURE`: synthetic test data used only for deterministic unit tests.

The authoritative live verifier records the production base URL, HTTP outcomes, discovered route URLs, internal link count, content markers, and read-only safety flags.

Unit fixtures are deliberately separated from production evidence and must never be reported as proof of publication or deployment.
```

# G9 Installation and Execution Guide v1.1

**Main gate:** G9 Website / Content
**Manual Go condition:** Public funnel works.

## Required checklist
1. Homepage
2. Engine
3. Project
4. Thinking
5. Article
6. LinkedIn version
7. Internal links

## Authoritative execution
Install all five `.gs` files into the authoritative Apps Script project, then run:

1. `G9_runPreflight`
2. `G9_runTests`
3. `G9_runLiveVerification`

The unit fixture intentionally uses non-production test URLs and is **not** website proof.
`G9_runLiveVerification` is the only function that checks the historical production base URL recorded in the project baseline.

## Stop rule
Do not close G9 from unit tests alone. Closure requires:

- 29/29 preflight
- 120/120 tests
- live verification `Status: PASS`

A `REVIEW_REQUIRED` live result means the missing/incorrect website surface(s) must be fixed and the full sequence rerun.
```

# G9 Traceability Matrix v1.1

| Manual item | Evidence path |
|---|---|
| Homepage | Live HTTP observation of recorded base URL |
| Engine | Discovered public engine route + HTTP/CTA checks |
| Project | Discovered project route + HTTP/CTA checks |
| Thinking | Discovered thinking route + HTTP/CTA checks |
| Article | Discovered canonical article route + HTTP/CTA checks |
| LinkedIn version | Prepared distribution asset markers + LinkedIn reference |
| Internal links | Discovered internal links + link-map readiness |

The formal Phase 4 exit additionally requires the website to be updated, engine landing page live, project explanation live, canonical article published, authority layer ready and CTAs installed.

```markdown
# LinkedIn Distribution Version

I have been thinking about the difference between finding jobs and finding the right opportunities. A vacancy can say “remote” and still exclude a country. A search result can be stale. Multiple sites can show the same role.

That led me from better search queries toward opportunity intelligence: discovery + verification + eligibility + freshness + relevance + prioritisation.

The idea is simple: the query should be the beginning of the process, not the product itself.

Read the canonical article: https://ese-digitals-platform.legaldept-nrc.workers.dev/thinking/article/
Explore the Engine: https://ese-digitals-platform.legaldept-nrc.workers.dev/engine/

Status: Prepared — not claimed as published.
```

# 17. CRITICAL GEOGRAPHY RULE

Never conflate:

```text
Remote

```

with:

```text
Worldwide

```

The canonical architecture deliberately keeps remote preference separate from geography.

```text
Remote + United States only

```

is valid.

```text

```

is valid.

```text
Remote + Nigeria

```

is valid as search intent.

```text
Nigeria eligible

```

or:

```text
Worldwide

```

Eligibility remains downstream.

into:

Worldwide

Do not silently broaden:

```text
Remote

into:

```text
Worldwide

Build and publish the canonical flagship article defined by the current Phase 4 architecture:

**“What Are You Made Of? From Job Searching to Opportunity Intelligence.”**

The article's purpose is to:

1. establish authority
2. frame the problem
3. explain limitations of conventional job searching
4. introduce opportunity intelligence
5. introduce the Engine
6. drive Engine use
7. create a useful conversion path

- canonical URL

- introduction
- structured headings
- explanatory content
- examples where factually supported
- limitations
- Engine CTA
- Project link
- Thinking link

- Open Graph data
- canonical URL
- structured data where justified

Do not invent performance results.

Do not invent customer outcomes.

Do not invent traffic.

Do not invent revenue.

Do not invent placement figures.

# G9 Decision Rules v1.1

## Surface readiness
Website surfaces (Homepage, Engine, Project, Thinking, Article) require URL + live HTTP success + public-safe status + a usable CTA.

LinkedIn Version is treated as a **distribution content asset**, not as a claim that LinkedIn publication has occurred. It requires content-ready evidence and a LinkedIn reference.

Internal Links requires a live homepage and at least three discovered internal links, or an equivalent linked-map observation.

## Gate decision
`PASS` only when all seven checklist surfaces are ready, internal linking evidence exists, next-action/CTA evidence exists, and no private/publishing/credential mutation occurred.

Missing, non-live, private, URL-less, or content-unready surfaces force `REVIEW_REQUIRED`.

Synthetic unit-test URLs never constitute production evidence.
```

Evidence classes:

- `LIVE_PAGE`: HTTP-observed public website surface.
- `CONTENT_ASSET`: prepared LinkedIn distribution version.
- `LINK_MAP`: observed internal linking structure.
- `UNIT_FIXTURE`: synthetic test data used only for deterministic unit tests.

The authoritative live verifier records the production base URL, HTTP outcomes, discovered route URLs, internal link count, content markers, and read-only safety flags.

Unit fixtures are deliberately separated from production evidence and must never be reported as proof of publication or deployment.
```

**Main gate:** G9 Website / Content
**Manual Go condition:** Public funnel works.

## Required checklist
1. Homepage
2. Engine
3. Project
4. Thinking
5. Article

Install all five `.gs` files into the authoritative Apps Script project, then run:

1. `G9_runPreflight`

Do not close G9 from unit tests alone. Closure requires:

- 29/29 preflight
- 120/120 tests
- live verification `Status: PASS`

A `REVIEW_REQUIRED` live result means the missing/incorrect website surface(s) must be fixed and the full sequence rerun.

# 17. CRITICAL GEOGRAPHY RULE

Never conflate:

```text
Remote

```

with:

```text
Worldwide

```

The canonical architecture deliberately keeps remote preference separate from geography.

Examples:

```text
Remote + United States only

```

is valid.

```text
Remote + EMEA

```

is valid.

```text
Remote + Nigeria

```

is valid as search intent.

None of those automatically proves:

```text
Nigeria eligible

```

or:

```text
Worldwide

```

Eligibility remains downstream.

---

# 18. WORLDWIDE SAFETY RULE

Do not silently broaden:

```text
Nigeria

```

into:

```text
Worldwide

```

Do not silently broaden:

```text
Remote

```

into:

```text
Worldwide

```

A worldwide strategy must only be produced when explicitly authorized by the user.

---

```text
QUERY PLAN

Role
Canonical Role
Country
Target Countries
Regions
Remote Preference
Freshness

STRATEGIES

Validation
Warnings
Errors

```

Do not expose inappropriate internal implementation details.

Do not expose private source records.

Do not expose internal control-plane data.

---

# 20. G9.5 — CANONICAL BACKEND / API INTEGRATION

The website UI must integrate with the established canonical intelligence.

Do not recreate Query Intelligence in frontend JavaScript.

Do not recreate role taxonomy in frontend JavaScript.

Do not recreate geography strategy logic in frontend JavaScript.

Do not recreate ranking or eligibility rules in the browser.

The website should send structured inputs.

The canonical backend should make the intelligence decision.

---

# 21. DETERMINE THE ACTUAL INTEGRATION PATH

Inspect the real system and choose the appropriate integration route.

Possible architectures include:

```text
Website UI
  ↓
Existing public API
  ↓
Canonical service

```

or:

```text
Website UI
  ↓
Secure public proxy
  ↓
Canonical service

```

or:

```text
Website UI
  ↓
Approved Apps Script web endpoint
  ↓
Canonical Query Intelligence

```

Do not choose based solely on convenience.

Evaluate:

- security
- reliability
- CORS
- latency
- rate limiting
- authentication
- observability
- maintainability
- future API evolution
- public/private boundary

---

# 22. NO SECRETS IN BROWSER

Never place in frontend code:

- API keys
- private tokens

## Purpose

Estimating renovation costs for a Lagos property.

This is a major find — NRC already has a working precedent right there in the same compound. Let me dig into current details on it.

Searched the web

That's completely fair, and it's smart to stop and ask before you're the one standing in front of the MD trying to defend numbers you can't explain. Let me do two things: translate the jargon into plain terms, and go find real numbers to replace my placeholders. I did the second one already — and found something big.

### The big thing first: NRC already did this, at this exact compound

Before anything else — in 2021, NRC opened a 40-bed commercial Railway Guest House at its Ebute-Metta station, costing about ₦320 million. Sixty percent of that was funded from the replacement value of NRC structures demolished for the Lagos–Ibadan standard gauge line, with Railway Property covering the rest, and management was awarded — after more than 30 companies bid for the contract — to a hospitality operator called Ojez Group. It now trades as **Ojez Hotel & Suites**, still on the same NRC compound. [Pulse Nigeriasvg](https://www.pulse.ng/news/local/nrc-builds-40-bed-hotel-worth-n320m-at-ebute-metta-station/hdzxq3v)[Nigeriagalleriasvg](https://www.nigeriagalleria.com/nrc-opens-railway-guest-house-in-ebute-metta-lagos/)

This matters enormously for how you pitch this, because it means you're not asking the MD to approve something NRC has never tried. You can say: *"NRC already ran exactly this playbook — refurbish an under-used railway asset, competitively appoint a hospitality manager — at this same compound in 2021. I'm proposing we do it again with the chalets."* That's a completely different, much stronger conversation than pitching a hypothetical.

### Now, the jargon — in plain terms, using your own numbers

| **TermWhat it actually meansIn your proposal** |                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| **ADR** (Average Daily Rate)                   | The average price charged per room, per night                                                                                                                                        | We guessed ₦55,000/night                              |
| **Occupancy**                                  | % of nights actually sold, out of all nights available                                                                                                                               | We guessed 40% in Year 1, rising to 60%               |
| **CAPEX**                                      | The one-time renovation/setup cost                                                                                                                                                   | We guessed ₦9.3m per unit                             |
| **NOI** (Net Operating Income)                 | Money left over each year after running costs, before counting back the renovation cost                                                                                              | This is your "profit" number                          |
| **Payback period**                             | How many years of NOI it takes to earn back the CAPEX                                                                                                                                | We calculated \~1.1 years                             |
| **NPV**                                        | All future years of profit, added up, but "discounted" — a naira next year is worth less than a naira today because of inflation/risk, so this shrinks future money to today's terms | \~₦175m                                               |
| **IRR**                                        | The annual % return the project effectively pays you, like an interest rate                                                                                                          | \~67%                                                 |
| **Break-even occupancy**                       | The minimum occupancy needed just to cover costs, before any profit                                                                                                                  | \~18%                                                 |
| **Management Contract**                        | NRC keeps ownership; hires a hotel operator to run it for a fee                                                                                                                      | This is exactly what happened with Ojez               |
| **Concession**                                 | A private company takes over operation (and more control) for a long period, usually investing their own capital                                                                     | Higher risk to NRC's control, more complex to approve |

The one-line version you can say out loud: *"We renovate it, an operator runs it under contract, NRC keeps the asset and the revenue, and the operator gets a fee. That's the model. Everything else in the report is just working out whether the numbers make sense."*

### Real market data vs. what I guessed

**Nightly rate comparison: what real listings show vs. our placeholder**

₦ per night

Here's what that chart is telling us, and why the range is wide:

- **Ojez Hotel & Suites** (the sister property, right there at Ebute Metta) currently lists rooms around **₦15,000–₦27,500/night**. But that's a basic hotel room — no kitchen, no living room, no self-catering.
- **Yaba serviced apartments** (self-contained, 1-bedroom, kitchen included — closer to what your chalets would actually be) average **₦90,000/night**, ranging ₦30,000–₦300,000 depending on quality.
- Your chalets sit *between* these two comparables: better-equipped than a hotel room (they have a kitchen, living room, the whole "walk-in" layout), but Ebute Metta is a less fashionable address than Yaba proper, and this would be NRC's first attempt at this specific product.

My ₦55,000 placeholder actually sits in a defensible spot between those two real comparables — not a wild guess, but not verified either. A market study would tell you exactly where in that ₦15k–₦90k band your specific product should land.

**On renovation cost:** current Lagos renovation pricing (tiling, painting, fittings, not ground-up construction) supports something in the ₦150,000–₦250,000 per square metre range for a decent mid-range finish. For a \~45–55 sqm one-bedroom unit, that lines up reasonably close to the ₦9.3m/unit we modelled — so that number isn't as shaky as the tariff figure.

**On occupancy:** Lagos short-let occupancy citywide averages around 51%, and market reports specifically flag the *mainland* (Ikeja, Yaba, Ebute Metta's neighbourhood) as the area currently gaining momentum, precisely because of its transit-hub character — which is your exact pitch for Ebute Metta. Our 40%→60% assumption is actually conservative against that citywide average, which is a good place to be sitting when you present to the MD.
```

# NRC Chalet Asset Commercialisation Programme — Toolkit

**Railway Compound, Ebute Metta, Lagos — 12 Units**
Status: DRAFT — for internal review and discussion prior to MD presentation.

This toolkit contains everything needed to take the chalet commercialisation
concept from idea to a fundable, governed pilot programme. Start with the
Master Business Case, use the Executive Presentation to brief the MD, and use
the Financial Model as the live, editable source of truth for every number
that appears in the other documents.

## What's in this folder

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **NRC_Chalet_Master_Business_Case.docx** | The full 22-section blueprint: legal framework, asset assessment, product, market, operating models, financial model summary, procurement, governance, risk, roadmap, pilot, KPIs and the specific approval being requested. Start here. |
| **NRC_Chalet_Financial_Model.xlsx** | The live financial model — Assumptions, Asset Register (12 units), CAPEX Plan, Pilot Programme Model, 5-Year Financial Model (Conservative/Base/Upside), Break-even & Investment Returns, KPI Dashboard, Risk Register, Implementation Roadmap. All yellow cells are editable inputs; everything else is a formula. |
| **NRC_Chalet_Draft_MD_Memorandum.docx** | A short, two-page covering memorandum for routing the proposal to the Managing Director, in standard NRC memo format. |
| **NRC_Chalet_Operating_SOPs_Governance_Charter.docx** | Housekeeping SOP, guest journey standards, financial/discount governance and fraud controls, and the Project Steering Committee charter. |
| **NRC_Chalet_Executive_Presentation.pptx** | A 16-slide deck for presenting the proposal verbally to the MD and Steering Committee. |
| **layout_diagram.png / photo_placeholder_exterior.png / photo_placeholder_interior.png** | Placeholder visuals used in the documents above — replace with real site photography and a measured architectural drawing once available. |

## Read this before presenting to the MD

Every financial figure in this toolkit (tariffs, occupancy, refurbishment
cost, operating costs, and therefore NOI, NPV, IRR and payback) is an
**indicative placeholder**, clearly flagged throughout. They exist to show
the shape and mechanics of the business case, not to be relied on for a
funding decision. Before this toolkit is used to ask for capital, three
things must happen:

1. A Quantity Surveyor's physical condition survey of all 12 units at Ebute
   Metta (replacing the placeholder ₦9.295m/unit refurbishment estimate).
2. A market/competitor tariff benchmarking study for the Ebute Metta /
   Lagos-mainland serviced-accommodation market (replacing the placeholder
   ₦55,000 Base ADR).
3. Confirmed utility, staffing, security and insurance costs from NRC Estate
   and Finance (replacing the placeholder operating-cost assumptions).

The Financial Model's Base Scenario currently shows an unusually strong
return profile (NPV ≈ ₦175m, IRR ≈ 67%, payback ≈ 1.1 years on ~₦111.5m of
total CAPEX). Precisely because this looks this strong, treat it as a
hypothesis for the 5-unit pilot to test — not a number to present as
verified. This caution is repeated throughout the Master Business Case and
the Executive Presentation.

## Also still needed (not something a document can supply)

- Exact GPS coordinates and boundary description for the site.
- Actual site photographs and a measured floor-plan survey (the images in
  this toolkit are clearly labelled placeholders).
- Confirmation of title/land-use status from NRC Legal and Estate/RPMCL.
- Any existing furniture/equipment inventory, and historical tariff or
  revenue data for the facility, if any exists.

## Suggested next step

Route the **Draft MD Memorandum** (with the Master Business Case attached)
through the normal NRC approval channel, requesting only the four items it
asks for: in-principle approval of the concept, a mandate for the Phase 1
physical/legal/market discovery, constitution of the Project Steering
Committee, and in-principle support for a 5-unit pilot — not approval of any
lease, concession or management contract at this stage.
```

    if (!clean || seen.has(key)) return;

    out.push(clean);
  });

}

    return { value: null, valid: false, reason: 'FRESHNESS_NOT_INTEGER' };
  }
  if (n < 1 || n > 90) {
    return { value: null, valid: false, reason: 'FRESHNESS_OUT_OF_RANGE_1_TO_90' };
  }
  return { value: n, valid: true, reason: 'VALID' };
}

function resolveRole(rawRole) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawRole);
  const normalized = normalizeString(rawRole);
  const key = normalizeKey(normalized);

  if (!key) {
    return {
      tier: 'EMPTY', family: null, canonicalRole: null, raw: raw,
      normalized: normalized, exactTitles: [], relatedTitles: [], adjacentRoles: [],
      reason: 'ROLE_EMPTY'
    };
  }

  const families = Object.keys(ROLE_TAXONOMY);

  for (const family of families) {
    if (normalizeKey(family) === key) {
      const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
      return {
        tier: 'FAMILY', family: family, canonicalRole: family, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_FAMILY'
      };
    }
  }

  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.exact.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'EXACT_TITLE', family: family, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_EXACT_TITLE'
      };
    }
  }

  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.related.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'RELATED_TITLE', family: family, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_RELATED_TITLE'
      };
    }
  }

  for (const family of families) {
    const tax = ROLE_TAXONOMY[family];
    if (tax.adjacent.some(title => normalizeKey(title) === key)) {
      return {
        tier: 'ADJACENT_ROLE', family: family, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
        normalized: normalized, exactTitles: tax.exact.slice(),
        relatedTitles: tax.related.slice(), adjacentRoles: tax.adjacent.slice(),
        reason: 'ROLE_MATCHED_ADJACENT_ROLE'
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    tier: 'CUSTOM_ROLE', family: null, canonicalRole: normalized, raw: raw,
    normalized: normalized, exactTitles: [normalized], relatedTitles: [],
    adjacentRoles: [], reason: 'ROLE_TREATED_AS_CUSTOM_ROLE'
  };
}

function normalizeCountry(rawCountry) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawCountry);
  const text = normalizeString(rawCountry);
  const key = normalizeKey(text);

  if (!key) {
    return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'COUNTRY_EMPTY' };
  }

  for (const [canonical, model] of Object.entries(COUNTRY_MODEL)) {
    const aliases = [canonical].concat(model.terms || []);
    if (aliases.some(term => normalizeKey(term) === key)) {
      return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: canonical, resolved: true, reason: 'COUNTRY_RESOLVED' };
    }
  }

  return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'COUNTRY_UNRESOLVED' };
}

function normalizeRegion(rawRegion) {
  const raw = cloneRawValue(rawRegion);
  const text = normalizeString(rawRegion);
  const key = normalizeKey(text);

  if (!key) {
    return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'REGION_EMPTY' };
  }

  for (const [canonical, model] of Object.entries(REGION_MODEL)) {
    const aliases = [canonical].concat(model.terms || []);
    if (aliases.some(term => normalizeKey(term) === key)) {
      return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: canonical, resolved: true, reason: 'REGION_RESOLVED' };
    }
  }

  return { raw: raw, normalized: text, canonical: null, resolved: false, reason: 'REGION_UNRESOLVED' };
}

function quoteIfNeeded(value) {
  const text = normalizeString(value);
  if (!text) return '';
  if (/^".*"$/.test(text)) return text;
  if (/\s/.test(text)) return '"' + text.replace(/"/g, '') + '"';
  return text;
}

function buildRoleClause(roleTerms) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(roleTerms);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildGeographyClause(geographyTerms) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(geographyTerms);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildRemoteClause(remotePreference) {
  const remote = normalizeString(remotePreference);
  if (remote === 'Fully Remote') return '(remote OR "work from anywhere" OR "work remotely")';
  if (remote === 'Remote-First') return '(remote-first OR remote)';
  if (remote === 'Hybrid') return '(hybrid OR remote)';
  if (remote === 'On-site') return '(on-site OR onsite)';
  return '';
}

function buildExclusionClause(exclusions) {
  return normalizeStringArray(exclusions).map(term => '-' + quoteIfNeeded(term)).join(' ');
}

function buildKeywordClause(keywords) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(keywords);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return quoteIfNeeded(terms[0]);
  return '(' + terms.map(quoteIfNeeded).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildSiteClause(domains) {
  const terms = normalizeStringArray(domains);
  if (!terms.length) return '';
  if (terms.length === 1) return 'site:' + terms[0];
  return '(' + terms.map(d => 'site:' + d).join(' OR ') + ')';
}

function buildGoogleQuery(options) {
  const parts = [];
  const roleClause = buildRoleClause(options.roleTerms || []);
  const geoClause = buildGeographyClause(options.geographyTerms || []);
  const remoteClause = buildRemoteClause(options.remotePreference || '');
  const keywordClause = buildKeywordClause(options.keywords || []);
  const exclusionClause = buildExclusionClause(options.exclusions || []);
  const siteClause = buildSiteClause(options.siteDomains || []);

  if (roleClause) parts.push(roleClause);
  if (geoClause) parts.push(geoClause);
  if (remoteClause) parts.push(remoteClause);
  if (keywordClause) parts.push(keywordClause);
  if (exclusionClause) parts.push(exclusionClause);
  if (siteClause) parts.push(siteClause);

  return parts.join(' ').trim();
}

function makeStrategySignature(parts) {
  return [
    parts.kind || '',
    parts.sourceType || '',
    normalizeString(parts.role || ''),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.roleTerms || [])),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.geographyTerms || [])),
    normalizeString(parts.remote || ''),
    normalizeString(parts.employmentType || ''),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.keywords || [])),
    JSON.stringify(normalizeStringArray(parts.exclusions || [])),
    String(parts.freshnessDays || '')
  ].join('|').toLowerCase();
}

function buildStrategy(options) {
  return {
    id: options.id,
    kind: options.kind,
    purpose: options.purpose,
    sourceType: options.sourceType,
    role: options.role,
    roleResolution: options.roleResolution,
    geography: options.geography,
    remote: options.remote,
    employmentType: options.employmentType,
    keywords: options.keywords,
    exclusions: options.exclusions,
    freshnessDays: options.freshnessDays,
    retrieval: options.retrieval,
    query: options.query,
    enabled: options.enabled !== false,
    signature: options.signature
  };
}

function validateStrategySchema(strategy) {
  const required = [
    'id', 'kind', 'purpose', 'sourceType', 'role', 'roleResolution',
    'geography', 'remote', 'employmentType', 'keywords', 'exclusions',
    'freshnessDays', 'retrieval', 'query', 'enabled', 'signature'
  ];

  const missing = required.filter(key => !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(strategy, key));
  return {
    valid: missing.length === 0,
    missing: missing
  };
}

function resolveTargetCountries(inputs, countryResolution) {
  const rawTarget = cloneRawValue(inputs.targetCountries);
  const items = splitRawToItems(rawTarget);

  if (items.length === 0 && countryResolution.resolved) {
    return {
      source: 'DEFAULTED_FROM_USER_COUNTRY',
      raw: [countryResolution.raw],
      canonical: [countryResolution.canonical],
      unresolved: []
    };
  }

  const canonical = [];
  const unresolved = [];
  const seen = new Set();

  items.forEach(item => {
    const res = normalizeCountry(item);
    if (res.resolved) {
      const key = normalizeKey(res.canonical);
      if (!seen.has(key)) {
        seen.add(key);
        canonical.push(res.canonical);
      }
    } else {
      unresolved.push(res);
    }
  });

  return {
    source: items.length ? 'EXPLICIT' : 'NONE',
    raw: rawTarget,
    canonical: canonical,
    unresolved: unresolved
  };
}

function buildGeographyResolution(inputs, countryResolution) {
  const regionRaw = cloneRawValue(inputs.regions);
  const regionItems = splitRawToItems(regionRaw);
  const regionCanonical = [];
  const unresolvedRegions = [];
  const regionSeen = new Set();

  regionItems.forEach(item => {
    const res = normalizeRegion(item);
    if (res.resolved) {
      const key = normalizeKey(res.canonical);
      if (!regionSeen.has(key)) {
        regionSeen.add(key);
        regionCanonical.push(res.canonical);
      }
    } else {
      unresolvedRegions.push(res);
    }
  });

  const targetCountries = resolveTargetCountries(inputs, countryResolution);

  return {
    userCountry: countryResolution,
    targetCountries: targetCountries,
    regions: {
      raw: regionRaw,
      canonical: regionCanonical,
      unresolved: unresolvedRegions
    },
    allowWorldwide: inputs.allowWorldwide === true,
    remoteDoesNotExpandGeography: true,
    targetCountriesSource: targetCountries.source
  };
}

function targetCountryTerms(country) {
  const model = COUNTRY_MODEL[country];
  return model ? [model.label].concat(model.terms || []) : [country];
}

function regionTerms(region) {
  const model = REGION_MODEL[region];
  return model ? model.terms.slice() : [region];
}

function makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution) {
  const role = roleResolution.canonicalRole;
  return role ? [role] : [];
}

function makeFamilyTerms(roleResolution) {
  const terms = [];
  terms.push.apply(terms, roleResolution.exactTitles || []);
  terms.push.apply(terms, roleResolution.relatedTitles || []);
  return normalizeStringArray(terms);
}

function makeSkillsTerms(keywords) {
  return normalizeStringArray(keywords);
}

function createCommonRetrieval(sourceType) {
  if (sourceType === 'GOOGLE') {
    return {
      mode: 'GOOGLE_SEARCH',
      endpointMode: null,
      directApiCall: false
    };
  }

  return {
    mode: 'ATS_API',
    endpointMode: QUERY_ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE,
    directApiCall: false
  };
}

function strategySignatureFor(strategyParts) {
  const roleTerms = strategyParts.roleTerms || (
    strategyParts.roleResolution && strategyParts.roleResolution.exactTitles
      ? [strategyParts.role]
      : []
  );
  const geographyTerms = strategyParts.geographyTerms || (
    strategyParts.geography && Array.isArray(strategyParts.geography.terms)
      ? strategyParts.geography.terms
      : []
  );

  return makeStrategySignature(Object.assign({}, strategyParts, {
    roleTerms: roleTerms,
    geographyTerms: geographyTerms
  }));
}

function generateQueryPlan(inputs) {
  inputs = inputs || {};

  const rawRole = cloneRawValue(inputs.role);
  const rawCountry = cloneRawValue(inputs.country);
  const rawTargetCountries = cloneRawValue(inputs.targetCountries);
  const rawRegions = cloneRawValue(inputs.regions);
  const rawKeywords = cloneRawValue(inputs.keywords);
  const rawExclusions = cloneRawValue(inputs.exclusions);
  const rawEmploymentType = cloneRawValue(inputs.employmentType);
  const rawRemotePreference = cloneRawValue(inputs.remotePreference);
  const rawWorkAuthorization = cloneRawValue(inputs.workAuthorization);
  const rawTimezone = cloneRawValue(inputs.timezone);
  const rawMode = cloneRawValue(inputs.mode);

  const roleResolution = resolveRole(rawRole);
  const countryResolution = normalizeCountry(rawCountry);
  const geographyResolution = buildGeographyResolution(inputs, countryResolution);

  const role = roleResolution.canonicalRole;
  const remotePreference = normalizeString(rawRemotePreference) || 'Fully Remote';
  const employmentType = normalizeString(rawEmploymentType);
  const keywords = normalizeStringArray(rawKeywords);
  const exclusions = normalizeStringArray(rawExclusions);
  const freshness = normalizeFreshnessDays(inputs.freshnessDays, 7);

  const validationErrors = [];
  const validationWarnings = [];

  if (!roleResolution.canonicalRole) {
    validationErrors.push({ code: 'ROLE_REQUIRED', message: 'Role is required.' });
  }

  if (!REMOTE_TYPES[remotePreference]) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: 'INVALID_REMOTE_PREFERENCE',
      message: 'Remote preference must be one of the supported remote types.'
    });
  }

  if (!freshness.valid) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: freshness.reason,
      message: 'Freshness input is invalid.'
    });
  }

  if (!countryResolution.resolved && geographyResolution.targetCountries.canonical.length === 0) {
    validationWarnings.push({
      code: 'COUNTRY_UNRESOLVED',
      message: 'User country could not be resolved; no country target strategy will be created from it.'
    });
  }

  if (geographyResolution.regions.unresolved.length) {
    validationWarnings.push({
      code: 'REGION_UNRESOLVED',
      message: 'One or more region inputs could not be resolved and were not converted to Worldwide.'
    });
  }

  if (inputs.allowWorldwide === true && !REMOTE_TYPES[remotePreference]) {
    validationWarnings.push({
      code: 'WORLDWIDE_WITH_INVALID_REMOTE',
      message: 'Worldwide was explicitly requested, but remote preference is invalid.'
    });
  }

  const strategies = [];

  function addStrategy(options) {
    const signature = strategySignatureFor(options);
    const strategy = buildStrategy(Object.assign({}, options, { signature: signature }));
    const schemaResult = validateStrategySchema(strategy);
    if (!schemaResult.valid) {
      validationErrors.push({
        code: 'INVALID_STRATEGY_SCHEMA',
        strategyId: strategy.id,
        missing: schemaResult.missing
      });
      return;
    }
    strategies.push(strategy);
  }

  const countryTargets = geographyResolution.targetCountries.canonical;
  const regionTargets = geographyResolution.regions.canonical;

  // 1. EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY — one per country target.
  countryTargets.forEach(country => {
    const geoTerms = targetCountryTerms(country);
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const parts = {
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: [country],
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY_' + normalizeKey(country).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_'),
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_COUNTRY',
      purpose: 'High-precision discovery using the resolved role and target country.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: {
        type: 'country',
        country: country,
        terms: geoTerms,
        status: 'RESOLVED'
      },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: geoTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  });

  // 2. EXACT_ROLE_REGION — exactly one per resolved region.
  regionTargets.forEach(region => {
    const geoTerms = regionTerms(region);
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const parts = {
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_REGION',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: geoTerms,
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'EXACT_ROLE_REGION_' + normalizeKey(region).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_'),
      kind: 'EXACT_ROLE_REGION',
      purpose: 'Broader regional discovery using the resolved role and one explicit target region.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: {
        type: REGION_MODEL[region].type,
        region: region,
        terms: geoTerms,
        status: 'RESOLVED'
      },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: geoTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  });

  // 3. FAMILY_COUNTRY — only when a controlled family has extra terms.
  if (roleResolution.family && makeFamilyTerms(roleResolution).length > 1 && countryTargets.length) {
    countryTargets.forEach(country => {
      const familyTerms = makeFamilyTerms(roleResolution);
      const geoTerms = targetCountryTerms(country);
      const options = {
        kind: 'FAMILY_COUNTRY',
        sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
        role: roleResolution.family,
        roleTerms: familyTerms,
        geographyTerms: [country],
        remote: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        freshnessDays: freshness.value
      };

      addStrategy({
        id: 'FAMILY_COUNTRY_' + normalizeKey(country).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_'),
        kind: 'FAMILY_COUNTRY',
        purpose: 'Controlled recall expansion across the selected role family.',
        sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
        role: roleResolution.family,
        roleResolution: roleResolution,
        geography: { type: 'country', country: country, terms: geoTerms, status: 'RESOLVED' },
        remote: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        freshnessDays: freshness.value,
        retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
        query: buildGoogleQuery({
          roleTerms: familyTerms,
          geographyTerms: geoTerms,
          remotePreference: remotePreference,
          employmentType: employmentType,
          keywords: keywords,
          exclusions: exclusions,
          siteDomains: []
        }),
        enabled: true,
        signature: null
      });
    });
  }

  // 4. SKILLS_LED — only when meaningful keywords exist and a country target exists.
  if (keywords.length && countryTargets.length) {
    const country = countryTargets[0];
    const geoTerms = targetCountryTerms(country);
    const options = {
      kind: 'SKILLS_LED',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: null,
      roleTerms: [],
      geographyTerms: [country],
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'SKILLS_LED',
      kind: 'SKILLS_LED',
      purpose: 'Discovery led primarily by user skills and tools rather than title.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: null,
      roleResolution: { tier: 'SKILLS_ONLY', family: null, canonicalRole: null },
      geography: { type: 'country', country: country, terms: geoTerms, status: 'RESOLVED' },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: [],
        geographyTerms: geoTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  }

  // 5. ATS_API — exactly one strategy per ATS source.
  ATS_SOURCES.forEach(ats => {
    const baseRoleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const geoTerms = countryTargets.length ? targetCountryTerms(countryTargets[0]) : [];
    const options = {
      kind: 'ATS_API',
      sourceType: ats.sourceType,
      role: role,
      roleTerms: baseRoleTerms,
      geographyTerms: geoTerms,
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'ATS_API_' + ats.id,
      kind: 'ATS_API',
      purpose: 'Structured source strategy for ' + ats.id + ' public job postings.',
      sourceType: ats.sourceType,
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: {
        type: countryTargets.length ? 'country' : 'unresolved',
        country: countryTargets.length ? countryTargets[0] : null,
        terms: geoTerms,
        status: countryTargets.length ? 'RESOLVED' : 'UNRESOLVED'
      },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: {
        mode: 'ATS_API',
        endpointMode: QUERY_ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE,
        provider: ats.id,
        domain: ats.domain,
        directApiCall: false
      },
      query: '',
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  });

  // 6. WORLDWIDE — only when explicitly allowed.
  if (inputs.allowWorldwide === true) {
    const worldTerms = REGION_MODEL.Worldwide.terms.slice();
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const options = {
      kind: 'WORLDWIDE',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: worldTerms,
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'WORLDWIDE_EXPLICIT',
      kind: 'WORLDWIDE',
      purpose: 'Explicitly requested worldwide discovery; not inferred from remote preference.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: { type: 'global', region: 'Worldwide', terms: worldTerms, status: 'EXPLICIT' },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: worldTerms,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  }

  // 7. Safe unresolved discovery path.
  if (roleResolution.canonicalRole && !countryTargets.length && !regionTargets.length && inputs.allowWorldwide !== true) {
    const roleTerms = makeRoleTermsForExact(roleResolution);
    const options = {
      kind: 'UNRESOLVED_DISCOVERY',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleTerms: roleTerms,
      geographyTerms: [],
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value
    };

    addStrategy({
      id: 'UNRESOLVED_DISCOVERY',
      kind: 'UNRESOLVED_DISCOVERY',
      purpose: 'Fail-safe discovery when no country or region resolved; no geography is invented.',
      sourceType: 'GOOGLE',
      role: role,
      roleResolution: roleResolution,
      geography: { type: 'unresolved', country: null, region: null, terms: [], status: 'UNRESOLVED' },
      remote: remotePreference,
      employmentType: employmentType,
      keywords: keywords,
      exclusions: exclusions,
      freshnessDays: freshness.value,
      retrieval: createCommonRetrieval('GOOGLE'),
      query: buildGoogleQuery({
        roleTerms: roleTerms,
        geographyTerms: [],
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        siteDomains: []
      }),
      enabled: true,
      signature: null
    });
  }

  // Post-generation invariant checks.
  const strategySignatures = strategies.map(s => s.signature);
  const duplicateSignatures = strategySignatures.filter((sig, i) => strategySignatures.indexOf(sig) !== i);
  if (duplicateSignatures.length) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: 'DUPLICATE_STRATEGY_SIGNATURE',
      signatures: Array.from(new Set(duplicateSignatures))
    });
  }

  strategies.forEach(strategy => {
    const schema = validateStrategySchema(strategy);
    if (!schema.valid) {
      validationErrors.push({
        code: 'INVALID_STRATEGY_SCHEMA',
        strategyId: strategy.id,
        missing: schema.missing
      });
    }
  });

  // Canonical role must be present at the plan level whenever a role resolves.
  const canonicalRoleInvariant = !roleResolution.canonicalRole || (
    roleResolution.canonicalRole === role
  );

  if (!canonicalRoleInvariant) {
    validationErrors.push({
      code: 'CANONICAL_ROLE_MISMATCH',
      message: 'Plan-level role does not match the canonical role resolver output.'
    });
  }

  const plan = {
    schemaVersion: QUERY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    taxonomyVersion: QUERY_TAXONOMY_VERSION,
    geographyVersion: QUERY_GEOGRAPHY_VERSION,
    planId: 'PLAN-' + new Date().getTime(),
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    generatedBy: 'QueryEngine.gs',
    compatibleWith: ['G3'],
    status: validationErrors.length ? 'INVALID' : 'VALID',
    executable: validationErrors.length === 0 && strategies.length > 0,
    userIntent: {
      raw: {
        role: rawRole,
        country: rawCountry,
        targetCountries: rawTargetCountries,
        regions: rawRegions,
        remotePreference: rawRemotePreference,
        employmentType: rawEmploymentType,
        keywords: rawKeywords,
        exclusions: rawExclusions,
        freshnessDays: inputs.freshnessDays,
        allowWorldwide: inputs.allowWorldwide,
        preferredRegions: cloneRawValue(inputs.preferredRegions),
        workAuthorization: rawWorkAuthorization,
        timezone: rawTimezone,
        mode: rawMode
      },
      canonical: {
        role: role,
        roleResolution: roleResolution,
        country: countryResolution.canonical,
        targetCountries: geographyResolution.targetCountries.canonical,
        regions: geographyResolution.regions.canonical,
        remotePreference: remotePreference,
        employmentType: employmentType,
        keywords: keywords,
        exclusions: exclusions,
        freshnessDays: freshness.value,
        allowWorldwide: inputs.allowWorldwide === true,
        workAuthorization: normalizeString(rawWorkAuthorization),
        timezone: normalizeString(rawTimezone),
        mode: normalizeString(rawMode)
      }
    },
    retrievalContext: {
      requestedFreshnessDays: freshness.value,
      freshnessResolution: freshness,
      sourceClasses: ['GOOGLE_SEARCH', 'GREENHOUSE', 'LEVER', 'ASHBY'],
      atsEndpointMode: QUERY_ATS_ENDPOINT_MODE,
      googleDiscoveryAllowed: true,
      canonicalIdAllowedInGoogleQuery: false,
      verificationRequiredDownstream: true,
      eligibilityRequiredDownstream: true,
      applicationAutomation: 'PROHIBITED'
    },
    geographyResolution: geographyResolution,
    strategies: strategies,
    totalStrategies: strategies.length,
    validation: {
      errors: validationErrors,
      warnings: validationWarnings,
      executionPolicy: {
        failClosedOnErrors: true,
        allowInvalidPlanExecution: false,
        allowWorldwideOnlyWhenExplicit: true,
        unresolvedGeographyMayNotBecomeWorldwide: true,
        noAutomaticJobApplication: true
      }
    }
  };

  return plan;
}

// Backward-compatible function name retained for callers that already use it.
function buildQueryPlan(inputs) {
  return generateQueryPlan(inputs);
}
```

function leadScore_(record) {
  const weights = { problem:20, budget:20, service:20, urgency:15, access:15, source:10 };
  return Math.min(100, Number(record.problem || 0)*weights.problem/5 + Number(record.budget || 0)*weights.budget/5 + Number(record.service || 0)*weights.service/5 + Number(record.urgency || 0)*weights.urgency/5 + Number(record.access || 0)*weights.access/5 + Number(record.source || 0)*weights.source/5);
}

Drive.js:
function ensureFolderPath_(names) {
  let parent = DriveApp.getRootFolder();
  names.forEach(name => {
    const it = parent.getFoldersByName(name);
    parent = it.hasNext() ? it.next() : parent.createFolder(name);
  });
  return parent;
}

function createClientFolder(clientId, clientName) {
  const root = ensureFolderPath_(['ESE DIGITALS OS','04_CLIENTS']);
  const folder = root.createFolder(clientId + ' — ' + clientName);
  ['01_Onboarding','02_Contract','03_Source_Materials','04_Working','05_Deliverables','06_Finance','07_Closeout'].forEach(n => folder.createFolder(n));
  logEvent('CLIENT_FOLDER_CREATED', clientId, 'INFO');
  return folder.getId();
}

FormHandler.js:
function processFormSubmission(e) {
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(CONFIG.ssId);
    const formSheet = ss.getSheetByName('FORM_LEADS');
    const leadsSheet = ss.getSheetByName('LEADS');
    if (!formSheet || !leadsSheet) throw new Error('FORM_LEADS or LEADS sheet not found');
    const lastRow = formSheet.getLastRow();
    const rowData = formSheet.getRange(lastRow, 1, 1, formSheet.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];
    const timestamp = rowData[0];
    const name = rowData[1] || '';
    const email = rowData[2] || '';
    const organization = rowData[3] || '';
    const interest = rowData[4] || '';
    const problem = rowData[5] || '';
    const source = rowData[6] || 'Website Form';
    if (!email || !name) {
      logEvent('FORM_SKIPPED', 'Missing name or email at row ' + lastRow, 'WARN');
      return;
    }
    const leadId = 'ES-LEAD-' + new Date().getFullYear() + '-' + String(leadsSheet.getLastRow() - 1).padStart(4, '0');
    leadsSheet.appendRow([leadId,new Date(),name,organization,email,'',source,interest,problem,'','', '', 'NEW','', 'Send welcome email', new Date(Date.now() + 24*60*60*1000), 'Auto-created from Google Form']);
    logEvent('LEAD_CREATED', leadId + ' - ' + email, 'INFO');
    const leadData = {name, email, organization, interest, problem};
    sendLeadAck(leadId, leadData);
  } catch (err) {
    logEvent('FORM_PROCESS_ERROR', err.message, 'ERROR');
    throw err;
  }
}

  const brand = CONFIG.brandName;
  const fromEmail = CONFIG.businessEmail;

  try {

}

Leads.js:
function createLead(lead) {
  if (!lead || !lead.email || !lead.name) throw new Error('Lead name and email are required');
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(CONFIG.ssId);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName('LEADS');
  if (!sheet) throw new Error('LEADS sheet not found');
  const id = nextId_(sheet, 'ES-LEAD');
  sheet.appendRow([id, new Date(), lead.name, lead.organization || '', lead.email, lead.phone || '', lead.source || 'Website', lead.interest || '', lead.problem || '', lead.budget || '', lead.timeline || '', '', 'NEW', '', '', lead.notes || '']);
  logEvent('LEAD_CREATED', id, 'INFO');
  return id;
}

function doPost(e) {
  // For the first live version, keep this endpoint private or protected.
  // Add authentication, request validation and abuse controls before making it public.

}

  const settings = ss.getSheetByName('SETTINGS');

  logEvent('HEALTH_CHECK', 'Workbook=' + ss.getName(), 'INFO');
  Logger.log('PDE-OS healthy: ' + ss.getName());
  return { ok: true, spreadsheet: ss.getName(), at: new Date().toISOString() };
}

}

# ESE DIGITALS / RELATED WORK — MIGRATION TIMELINE

## Foundation
The work began as a broad digital-business / professional operating-system build under Ese Digitals: a commercial brand/platform separate from the personal-life layer, with a private control plane and reusable automation.

## Core OS
Created:
- Personal Digital Enterprise OS technical specification
- Beginner end-to-end implementation manual
- PDE_OS_MASTER control-plane template
- website/Apps Script starter pack

Baseline operating pattern established:
website + GitHub + Cloudflare + Google Workspace + Apps Script + private master control plane + CRM/workflow + public/private boundary.

## NRC proactive workstream
A separate but related professional proof-of-work stream developed an NRC chalet commercialisation concept for the Ebute Metta Railway Compound. The work was explicitly framed as an NRC-owned asset initiative, not a personal operating-right request.

## Phase 4 Opportunity Intelligence Engine
The opportunity-discovery project was elevated into a formal gated intelligence system. G0 and G1 were completed; G2 was redesigned from naive search strings into Query Intelligence producing a machine-readable Query Plan; the user-facing Perchance layer was retained while Apps Script remained the intelligence engine.

## G2 freeze
An authoritative final G2 implementation record was produced/frozen. Core rules include controlled role taxonomy and strict geography/remote separation.

## G3 discovery architecture
G3 was separated into adapter contract, source verification, raw-source-record envelope, normalization and later identity/deduplication. This sequencing exists to prevent source adapters from making downstream business decisions.

## G3.1
Common adapter contract defined for Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby. Actual prior result: 30 tests, 0 failures, PASS.

## G3.2
Live Stripe Greenhouse verification performed. API returned 618 jobs; sample record 8172510. No credentials, application, spreadsheet writes or G2 mutation. Recorded PASS.

## G3.3
Raw source record envelope contract v1.2 defined and executed. Actual prior result: 15 tests, 0 failures, PASS.

## G3.4
A prior draft was scrutinized and rejected before execution. The corrected v1.1 contract was then produced. Key corrections: preserve source-native Source_ID, leave Job_ID null, do not import G2 Role_Family, do not infer downstream statuses, strict numeric conversion, explicit Posted_Date only, SHA-256 fingerprint, structural tests.

## 10 September 2026 — migration point
Latest task before migration: create a complete V2 migration ZIP so the next chat can continue seamlessly. Immediately before this request, G3.4 remained READY / NOT EXECUTED; corrected 60-test implementation is the next technical action.

## Video intelligence parallel stream
The project also developed a Video Value Intelligence Studio and then an Interest/Desire/Emotion Video Intelligence Engine. The latest v1.1 manual extends it into an AI-first production compiler with strict rights, QA, approval, telemetry and public/private boundaries.

## Separate historical work
Football prediction and job-application work exists in the wider Library but is not assumed to be part of the active Ese Digitals V2 architecture unless explicitly revived.

# Migration Kit Inventory and Provenance

This package is assembled from:
1. The prior Ese Digitals V2 migration kit from 2026-09-10, retained as the historical baseline.
2. The controlling Phase 4 Opportunity Intelligence Engine Master Build Manual v2.2.
3. The current G9 execution directive `Pasted markdown(20260911-154331).md`.
4. Current G4–G8 gate packs and latest G311–G320 component packs available in the conversation workspace.
5. Current G9 website implementation and corrected G9 rollup artifacts available in the workspace.
6. Current website screenshots/evidence available in the workspace.
7. The current full uploaded QueryEngine source snapshot.
8. Current 2026-09-11 PDE OS source audit transcripts and continuity records generated from the user’s local Windows repository outputs.
9. Earlier supporting NRC, video and platform materials inherited from the prior migration kit.

## Deliberate exclusions
- Local OAuth credentials such as `.clasprc.json` are not packaged.
- No passwords, private keys, payment secrets, webhook secrets, or other authentication credentials are intentionally included.
- The actual local PDE OS working `.git` directory is not packaged; only source/control documentation available in the conversation workspace is included.

## Important limitation
A migration kit cannot reproduce invisible application state that was never exported or attached. This package preserves the known conversational and artifact state available to the assistant, plus the prior migration package, current source snapshot, evidence notes, and continuation instructions. The next chat must treat source artifacts and the current local/GitHub repository as the authoritative implementation source when available.
```

## About

[svg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/eseoghene-g-128733130/edit/forms/summary/new/)

I support leaders, teams, customers and stakeholders by turning requests into organized, trackable work.
My background cuts across administrative coordination, stakeholder communication, logistics, HR/facility support, records and documentation, research, follow-up and workflow improvement. I work best where accuracy, responsiveness and ownership matter - especially when there are multiple moving parts and someone needs to keep the work visible and progressing.
I’m currently focused on remote opportunities in Administrative Support, Executive Support, Operations Coordination and Customer Operations.
What I bring:
• Administrative and stakeholder coordination
• Scheduling and follow-through
• Records, documentation and information verification
• Logistics and vendor coordination
• Research and practical problem-solving
• Process tracking, checklists and workflow improvement
• Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace
• AI-assisted research, drafting and workflow support using tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
I also build personal proof-of-work projects around executive operations, AI-assisted workflows, research intelligence and lightweight automation. These are self-directed projects used to demonstrate how I think, build and verify workflows; they are not presented as client deployments.
Open to remote opportunities supporting U.S., UK and international teams.

  [9 Brutal Career Truths:](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [(and how to actually avoid them)](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [1. No One Is Tracking Your Accomplishments](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Your wins are forgotten the moment they happen ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Decision-makers remember 10% of what you've actually achieved ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [2. Your Potential Means Nothing](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ What you could do gets you zero credit in the real world ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Only executed potential has value in the marketplace ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [3. Loyalty Will Be Punished, Not Rewarded](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Staying too long guarantees you'll be underpaid](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Companies exploit commitment while rewarding new arrivals ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [4. No One Cares About Your Effort](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Working hard impresses absolutely nobody who matters ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Only tangible outcomes create career capital ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [5. Your Skills Are Becoming Obsolete Right Now](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ The half-life of professional capabilities is shrinking yearly ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ What got you here will leave you unemployable soon ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [6. Your Network Determines Your Ceiling](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Individual performance can't overcome relationship deficits](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Who knows you matters more than what you know ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [7. Your Discomfort Is The Path, Not The Problem](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Avoiding career pain guarantees stagnation ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Growth happens exclusively through voluntary difficulty ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [8. No One Will Create Opportunities For You](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Waiting to be discovered ensures you never will be ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Permission-seeking guarantees mediocrity ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [9. Your Career Story Exists Only In Your Head](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Nobody understands your value unless you articulate it clearly ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)
  [↳ Your narrative must be crafted, not assumed ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [The market doesn't care about your intentions, your potential, or your excuses. It rewards execution, results, and value—nothing else.](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [Which of these truths hit hardest for you?](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:activity:7310823944335298561/)

  [🌍 ](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn\:li\:share:7254087657545207808/)[**BYU-Pathway Worldwide**](https://www.linkedin.com/school/byupathway/): Revolutionizing Education for Everyone 🌍

  In a world where education often feels out of reach, [**BYU-Pathway Worldwide**](https://www.linkedin.com/school/byupathway/) has been a beacon of hope and opportunity for thousands of individuals across the globe. 🎓

  What makes it so powerful?

  ✅ Accessible to All: Whether you're a working professional, a parent, or someone facing financial challenges, BYU-Pathway provides affordable and flexible education that fits into your life, no matter your circumstances.

  ✅ Career-Focused: The programs are designed with a purpose—helping students gain practical skills through certificates and degrees that lead directly to job opportunities. Education here is not just about learning; it’s about improving lives and opening doors to better futures.

  ✅ Holistic Development: It’s more than academic growth—BYU-Pathway integrates spiritual and personal development as a core part of the journey, creating well-rounded individuals ready to make a difference in the world.

  ✅ Global Impact: This initiative has touched lives in every corner of the world including mine 🌎. No matter where you live, no matter your background, BYU-Pathway’s innovative approach breaks down barriers and builds bridges to success.

  It’s incredible to witness the stories of students who, against all odds, are now earning degrees, building careers, and changing the course of their families' futures. I’m proud to be part of a community that believes in the power of education and lifting others.

  If you’re looking for a path to personal and professional growth, [**BYU-Pathway Worldwide**](https://www.linkedin.com/school/byupathway/) is the way forward.

  [**#please**](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?keywords=%23please\&origin=HASH_TAG_FROM_FEED) [**#share**](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?keywords=%23share\&origin=HASH_TAG_FROM_FEED)
  The degree program supports 100 to 200 Master’s students and 300 PhD students every year to pursue postgraduate education at the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) and institutes of Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) around China.

  Benefits
  FULL TUITION WAIVER
  MONTHLY STIPEND
  ONE FLIGHT TICKET
  HEALTH INSURANCE
  APPLICATION FEE WAIVER. 
  ONE TIME VISA ALLOWANCE. 

  Procedure:
  To Apply is very simple, just follow the procedure below, gather all documents and apply on any of the portals. 

  The 2024 ANSO Scholarship is open for application on 20th October 2023 (The exact dates might be slightly different for USTC and UCAS, please check their websites for details). 
  Deadline for Applicants and Referees: 15 February 2025 (Beijing Time).

  There are two portals that you can apply from, (choose only one)

  1\. Application Materials
  For USTC applicants, please refer to Application Guideline and documents required for Graduate Applicants to USTC
